detail.description: **"Attack surface against the MCP protocol itself" becomes the biggest enterprise AI adoption bottleneck by Q3 2026.** Nginx UI's **CVE-2026-33032 (MCPwn, CVSS 9.8)** — a structural defect where the `/mcp_message` endpoint, with its empty default IP allowlist, exposes 12 unauthenticated tool calls — was added to VulnCheck KEV after a 2-request real-world takeover in production. That tells us the MCP protocol itself needs to be redesigned as a web standard if it's going to scale. By Q3 2026, OWASP MCP Top 10 will be officially published, **MCP-over-mTLS / standardized OAuth scope specs by Anthropic / Microsoft / Google / Cisco / Cloudflare** will become industry standard, and Keycard / Okta for AI Agents / Wiz / Levo.ai / Pillar Security will roll out "MCP Gateway / MCP Firewall" products through Q4. Enterprise compliance audits will start tracking "number of MCP-connected tools / endpoints / authorization policies" as a new audit category. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.es: **"La superficie de ataque contra el protocolo MCP en sí" se convierte en el mayor cuello de botella de adopción empresarial de IA para el Q3 2026.** **CVE-2026-33032 (MCPwn, CVSS 9.8)** de Nginx UI — un defecto estructural donde el endpoint `/mcp_message`, con su lista de IPs permitidas vacía por defecto, expone 12 llamadas a herramientas no autenticadas — fue añadido a VulnCheck KEV tras una toma de control real de 2 solicitudes en producción. Eso nos dice que el protocolo MCP en sí necesita ser rediseñado como un estándar web si va a escalar. Para el Q3 2026, OWASP MCP Top 10 se publicará oficialmente, **MCP-over-mTLS / especificaciones estandarizadas de alcance OAuth por Anthropic / Microsoft / Google / Cisco / Cloudflare** se convertirán en estándar de la industria, y Keycard / Okta for AI Agents / Wiz / Levo.ai / Pillar Security lanzarán productos "MCP Gateway / MCP Firewall" durante el Q4. Las auditorías de cumplimiento empresarial comenzarán a rastrear "número de herramientas conectadas a MCP / endpoints / políticas de autorización" como una nueva categoría de auditoría. Sinasabi nito sa atin na ang MCP protocol mismo ay kailangang muling i-design bilang web standard kung lalaki ito. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, opisyal na ilalathala ang OWASP MCP Top 10, **ang MCP-over-mTLS / standardized OAuth scope specs ng Anthropic / Microsoft / Google / Cisco / Cloudflare** ay magiging industry standard, at ang Keycard / Okta for AI Agents / Wiz / Levo.ai / Pillar Security ay maglulunsad ng "MCP Gateway / MCP Firewall" products hanggang Q4. Ang enterprise compliance audits ay magsisimulang magsubaybay ng "number of MCP-connected tools / endpoints / authorization policies" bilang bagong audit category. description.en: **Inference servers become the new "primitive supply chain" — Q3 2026 sees the first AI Infra-specific CVE class (LLM-INFRA-CWE) with mandatory NVD tagging.** The Apr 19-26 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m exploited)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + the Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot — composes a clear "inference-runtime + agentic-CI" attack-surface category. By Q3 2026, NIST/NVD adds a dedicated **"AI-Infra"** tag to its CVE schema, OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes **"Inference Server Template / Loader RCE"** to a top-3 entry, and supply-chain SBOM tooling (Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera) ships **per-engine signature feeds for vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollama** as standard SKUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **推論サーバーが新たな「プリミティブ・サプライチェーン」となる ― Q3 2026に最初のAIインフラ専用CVEクラス(LLM-INFRA-CWE)がNVD強制タグ付きで登場する。** 4月19-26日のシーケンス ― **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF(12時間31分で悪用)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760(CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **PillarのAntigravityサンドボックス・エスケープ via `find_by_name -X`** + 4月21日のClaude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot横断のComment-and-Controlプロンプト・インジェクション・チェーン ― が、明確な「推論ランタイム + エージェンティックCI」の攻撃面カテゴリーを構成する。Q3 2026までに、NIST/NVDがCVEスキーマに専用の**「AI-Infra」**タグを追加し、OWASPのLLM Top 10 v2026が**「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」**をトップ3エントリーに格上げし、サプライチェーンSBOMツール(Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera)が**vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollamaのエンジン別シグネチャ・フィード**を標準SKUとして出荷する。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los servidores de inferencia se convierten en la nueva "cadena de suministro primitiva" — Q3 2026 ve la primera clase de CVE específica de infraestructura de IA (LLM-INFRA-CWE) con etiquetado obligatorio en NVD.** La secuencia del 19-26 de abril — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m explotado)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **escape de sandbox de Antigravity de Pillar mediante `find_by_name -X`** + la cadena Comment-and-Control de inyección de prompts del 21 de abril a través de Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot — compone una clara categoría de superficie de ataque "runtime de inferencia + CI agéntico". Para Q3 2026, NIST/NVD añade una etiqueta dedicada **"AI-Infra"** a su esquema CVE, el OWASP LLM Top 10 v2026 promueve **"RCE en Plantilla / Cargador de Servidor de Inferencia"** a una entrada top-3, y las herramientas SBOM de cadena de suministro (Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera) lanzan **feeds de firmas por motor para vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollama** como SKUs estándar. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Nagiging bagong "primitive supply chain" ang mga inference servers — sa Q3 2026 makikita ang unang AI Infra-specific CVE class (LLM-INFRA-CWE) na may mandatory NVD tagging.** Ang Apr 19-26 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m exploited)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + ang Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain sa Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot — ay bumubuo ng malinaw na "inference-runtime + agentic-CI" attack-surface category. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, magdadagdag ang NIST/NVD ng dedicated **"AI-Infra"** tag sa CVE schema nito, ang OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 ay magpo-promote ng **"Inference Server Template / Loader RCE"** sa top-3 entry, at ang supply-chain SBOM tooling (Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera) ay magpapadala ng **per-engine signature feeds para sa vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollama** bilang standard SKUs. title_locales.en: Inference servers form supply chain, triggering AI-Infra CVE class by Q3 2026
title_locales.ja: 推論サーバーがサプライチェーンを形成し、Q3 2026までにAIインフラCVEクラスを引き起こす
title_locales.es: Los servidores de inferencia conforman una cadena de suministro y desencadenan una clase de CVE de AI-Infra para Q3 2026
title_locales.fil: Bumubuo ng supply chain ang inference servers, nagti-trigger ng AI-Infra CVE class pagsapit ng Q3 2026

detail.summary_short: The Apr 19-26 LMDeploy SSRF, SGLang CVE-2026-5760 Jinja2 SSTI RCE, Antigravity sandbox escape, and Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain compose an inference-runtime plus agentic-CI attack-surface category. By Q3 2026, NIST/NVD is expected to add an AI-Infra CVE tag, OWASP LLM Top 10 is expected to promote Inference Server Template RCE to top-3, and SBOM vendors are expected to ship per-engine signature feeds.

summary_short_locales.en: The Apr 19-26 LMDeploy SSRF, SGLang CVE-2026-5760 Jinja2 SSTI RCE, Antigravity sandbox escape, and Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain compose an inference-runtime plus agentic-CI attack-surface category. By Q3 2026, NIST/NVD is expected to add an AI-Infra CVE tag, OWASP LLM Top 10 is expected to promote Inference Server Template RCE to top-3, and SBOM vendors are expected to ship per-engine signature feeds.
summary_short_locales.ja: 4月19-26日のLMDeploy SSRF、SGLang CVE-2026-5760 Jinja2 SSTI RCE、Antigravityサンドボックス・エスケープ、Comment-and-Controlプロンプト・インジェクション・チェーンが、推論ランタイムとエージェンティックCIの攻撃面カテゴリーを構成する。Q3 2026までに、NIST/NVDがAI-Infra CVEタグを追加し、OWASP LLM Top 10がInference Server Template RCEをトップ3に格上げし、SBOMベンダーがエンジン別シグネチャ・フィードを出荷することが予想される。
summary_short_locales.es: La secuencia del 19-26 de abril de LMDeploy SSRF, SGLang CVE-2026-5760 Jinja2 SSTI RCE, escape de sandbox de Antigravity, y la cadena de inyección de prompts Comment-and-Control compone una categoría de superficie de ataque de runtime de inferencia más CI agéntico. Para Q3 2026, se espera que NIST/NVD añada una etiqueta CVE AI-Infra, que OWASP LLM Top 10 promueva RCE en Plantilla de Servidor de Inferencia al top-3, y que los proveedores SBOM lancen feeds de firmas por motor.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Apr 19-26 LMDeploy SSRF, SGLang CVE-2026-5760 Jinja2 SSTI RCE, Antigravity sandbox escape, at Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain ay bumubuo ng inference-runtime plus agentic-CI attack-surface category. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, inaasahang magdadagdag ang NIST/NVD ng AI-Infra CVE tag, inaasahang ipo-promote ng OWASP LLM Top 10 ang Inference Server Template RCE sa top-3, at inaasahang magpapadala ang SBOM vendors ng per-engine signature feeds.

bridges.text: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sitting unpatched at 14 days, LiteLLM key-leak SQLi, and the May 1 Copy Fail kernel LPE add to the original Apr 19-26 chain that motivated the AI-Infra CVE class claim. The precondition keeps strengthening: each new advisory looks like the same template, which is exactly the cluster a dedicated NVD tag is meant to catch.

text_locales.en: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sitting unpatched at 14 days, LiteLLM key-leak SQLi, and the May 1 Copy Fail kernel LPE add to the original Apr 19-26 chain that motivated the AI-Infra CVE class claim. The precondition keeps strengthening: each new advisory looks like the same template, which is exactly the cluster a dedicated NVD tag is meant to catch.
text_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760が14日間未パッチで滞留、LiteLLM鍵漏洩SQLi、5月1日のCopy Failカーネル LPEが、AI-Infra CVEクラス主張を動機付けた元々の4月19-26日チェーンに加わる。前提条件は強化を続けている。各新規アドバイザリーが同じテンプレートに見え、これは正に専用NVDタグが捕捉することを意図したクラスタだ。
text_locales.es: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sin parchar a 14 días, el SQLi de fuga de claves de LiteLLM, y el LPE de kernel Copy Fail del 1 de mayo se suman a la cadena original del 19-26 de abril que motivó la afirmación sobre la clase CVE de AI-Infra. La precondición sigue fortaleciéndose: cada nuevo aviso parece la misma plantilla, que es exactamente el cluster que un tag dedicado del NVD pretende capturar.
text_locales.fil: Ang SGLang CVE-2026-5760 na nakaupong unpatched sa 14 araw, LiteLLM key-leak SQLi, at ang May 1 Copy Fail kernel LPE ay nagdaragdag sa orihinal na Apr 19-26 chain na nag-udyok sa AI-Infra CVE class claim. Patuloy na lumalakas ang precondition: ang bawat bagong advisory ay parang parehong template, na siyang eksaktong cluster na hinahangad ng dedicated NVD tag.

bridges.text: SGLang still unpatched plus the May 1 IBM Langflow and UTT HiPER additions and CISA's Linux-kernel KEV update give the AI-Infra CVE class three more in-the-wild data points — the precondition cadence the prediction expects an AI-Infra NVD tag to absorb.

text_locales.en: SGLang still unpatched plus the May 1 IBM Langflow and UTT HiPER additions and CISA's Linux-kernel KEV update give the AI-Infra CVE class three more in-the-wild data points — the precondition cadence the prediction expects an AI-Infra NVD tag to absorb.
text_locales.ja: SGLang未パッチに加えて、5月1日のIBM LangflowとUTT HiPER追加、そしてCISAのLinuxカーネルKEV更新が、AIインフラCVEクラスにさらに3件の実環境データポイントを与える — 予測がAIインフラNVDタグが吸収すると期待する前提条件のケイデンスである。
text_locales.es: SGLang aún sin parchear más las adiciones del 1 mayo de IBM Langflow y UTT HiPER y la actualización KEV del kernel Linux de CISA dan a la clase CVE de AI-Infra tres puntos de datos más en el mundo real — la cadencia de precondiciones que la predicción espera que un tag NVD de AI-Infra absorba.
text_locales.fil: Ang SGLang na unpatched pa rin kasama ang May 1 IBM Langflow at UTT HiPER additions at ang Linux-kernel KEV update ng CISA ay nagbibigay sa AI-Infra CVE class ng tatlo pang in-the-wild data points — ang precondition cadence na inaasahan ng prediction na sasaluhin ng AI-Infra NVD tag.

bridges.text: LiteLLM is now the canonical 2026 LLM-gateway-as-blast-radius case — one row leak compromises OpenAI org keys, Anthropic admin tokens, and AWS Bedrock IAM credentials simultaneously, which is the same model-tooling-layer-injection shape SGLang and Spring AI exposed. The CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the disclosure-regime side of the same primitive-supply-chain thesis. Moderate-to-strong signal across both legs.

text_locales.en: LiteLLM is now the canonical 2026 LLM-gateway-as-blast-radius case — one row leak compromises OpenAI org keys, Anthropic admin tokens, and AWS Bedrock IAM credentials simultaneously, which is the same model-tooling-layer-injection shape SGLang and Spring AI exposed. The CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the disclosure-regime side of the same primitive-supply-chain thesis. Moderate-to-strong signal across both legs.
text_locales.ja: LiteLLMは現在、典型的な2026年LLMゲートウェイ・アズ・ブラスト・ラディウスケースとなった ― 1行のリークがOpenAI組織キー、Anthropic管理者トークン、AWS Bedrock IAM認証情報を同時に侵害する。これはSGLangとSpring AIが露呈したのと同じモデルツールレイヤー注入形状である。CSAIのMITRE-CNA認定は、同じプリミティブサプライチェーンテーゼの開示体制側である。両側で中程度から強いシグナル。
text_locales.es: LiteLLM es ahora el caso canónico 2026 de LLM-gateway-as-blast-radius — la fuga de una fila compromete claves de org de OpenAI, tokens admin de Anthropic, y credenciales IAM de AWS Bedrock simultáneamente, que es la misma forma de inyección en la capa model-tooling que SGLang y Spring AI expusieron. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI es el lado régimen-de-disclosure de la misma tesis de primitive-supply-chain. Señal moderada-a-fuerte en ambos legs.
text_locales.fil: Ang LiteLLM ay ngayon ang canonical 2026 LLM-gateway-as-blast-radius case — isang row leak ay nag-co-compromise ng OpenAI org keys, Anthropic admin tokens, at AWS Bedrock IAM credentials nang sabay-sabay, na siyang parehong model-tooling-layer-injection shape na inilantad ng SGLang at Spring AI. Ang CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ay ang disclosure-regime side ng parehong primitive-supply-chain thesis. Moderate-to-strong signal sa magkabilang leg.

bridges.text: The Spring AI FilterExpressionConverter CVE is the first 2026 LLM-tooling-supply-chain CVE at the RAG query plane, and the same Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape that produced SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched) is now confirmed across vLLM and LMDeploy. Five distinct inference-stack-injection CVEs in a 14-day window is exactly the cluster the prediction projected.

text_locales.en: The Spring AI FilterExpressionConverter CVE is the first 2026 LLM-tooling-supply-chain CVE at the RAG query plane, and the same Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape that produced SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched) is now confirmed across vLLM and LMDeploy. Five distinct inference-stack-injection CVEs in a 14-day window is exactly the cluster the prediction projected.
text_locales.ja: Spring AI FilterExpressionConverter CVEは、RAGクエリプレーンでの初の2026年LLMツーリングサプライチェーンCVEであり、SGLang CVE-2026-5760(まだ未パッチ)を生じさせたのと同じJinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironmentの形がvLLMとLMDeployにわたって確認されている。14日間の窓内で5つの異なる推論スタックインジェクションCVEは、まさに予測が投影したクラスタである。
text_locales.es: El CVE FilterExpressionConverter de Spring AI es el primer CVE 2026 de cadena de suministro de LLM-tooling en el plano de query de RAG, y la misma forma Jinja2-sin-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment que produjo SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (todavía sin parche) se confirma ahora a través de vLLM y LMDeploy. Cinco CVEs distintos de inyección en stack de inferencia en una ventana de 14 días son exactamente el clúster que proyectaba la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Ang Spring AI FilterExpressionConverter CVE ay ang unang 2026 LLM-tooling-supply-chain CVE sa RAG query plane, at ang parehong Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape na nagluwal ng SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched) ay kumpirmado na ngayon sa vLLM at LMDeploy. Limang magkakaibang inference-stack-injection CVEs sa 14-day window ay eksaktong cluster na inaasahan ng prediction.

bridges.text: SGLang CVE-2026-5760's 10-day-unpatched persistence with public PoC, CISA's Apr 28 KEV adds with May-12 federal deadline, and the Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster directly materialize the precondition that inference-runtime + agentic-CI codepaths are reaching Patch-Tuesday-grade severity at a sustained cadence. The CVE-class category continues to crystallize on the ground.

text_locales.en: SGLang CVE-2026-5760's 10-day-unpatched persistence with public PoC, CISA's Apr 28 KEV adds with May-12 federal deadline, and the Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster directly materialize the precondition that inference-runtime + agentic-CI codepaths are reaching Patch-Tuesday-grade severity at a sustained cadence. The CVE-class category continues to crystallize on the ground.
text_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760の10日間未パッチ持続性(公開PoCあり)、CISAの4月28日KEV追加(5月12日連邦期限)、Milesight + Totolink 9.8クラスタが、推論ランタイム + agentic CIコードパスがPatch-Tuesday級重大度に持続的なケイデンスで到達しているという前提条件を直接物質化する。CVEクラス・カテゴリは現場で結晶化し続けている。
text_locales.es: La persistencia de 10-dias-sin-parchear de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 con PoC publico, los KEV adds del 28 de abril de CISA con deadline federal del 12 de mayo, y el cluster Milesight + Totolink 9.8 extienden directamente la precondicion de que los codepaths inference-runtime + agentic-CI estan alcanzando severidad de Patch-Tuesday-grade a una cadencia sostenida. La categoria de clase-CVE continua cristalizando en el terreno.
text_locales.fil: Ang 10-araw-unpatched persistence ng SGLang CVE-2026-5760 kasama ang public PoC, ang Apr 28 CISA KEV adds na may May-12 federal deadline, at ang Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster ay direktang nag-mamaterialize ng precondition na ang inference-runtime + agentic-CI codepaths ay umaabot sa Patch-Tuesday-grade severity sa sustained cadence. Ang CVE-class category ay patuloy na nag-cri-crystallize sa lupa.

bridges.text: The unpatched SGLang RCE plus the Totolink quad and the in-the-wild indirect-injection ramp continue to compose the inference-runtime-plus-agentic-CI primitive the prediction names — the underlying premise that this is one supply-chain category is loading further this week.

text_locales.en: The unpatched SGLang RCE plus the Totolink quad and the in-the-wild indirect-injection ramp continue to compose the inference-runtime-plus-agentic-CI primitive the prediction names — the underlying premise that this is one supply-chain category is loading further this week.
text_locales.ja: 未パッチの SGLang RCE に Totolink 4 連発と野生の間接インジェクション ランプが加わることで、予測が指す推論ランタイム + エージェンティック CI のプリミティブを構成し続ける — これがひとつのサプライチェーン カテゴリだという根底前提は今週さらに積み上がっている。
text_locales.es: El RCE SGLang sin parchear más el cuádruple Totolink y la rampa de inyección indirecta in-the-wild continúan componiendo la primitiva inference-runtime-más-agentic-CI que nombra la predicción — la premisa subyacente de que esta es una categoría de supply-chain está cargándose más esta semana.
text_locales.fil: Ang unpatched SGLang RCE plus ang Totolink quad at ang in-the-wild indirect-injection ramp ay patuloy na bumubuo sa inference-runtime-plus-agentic-CI primitive na pinangalanan ng prediction — ang underlying premise na ito ay isang supply-chain category ay lalong tumitindi linggong ito.

bridges.text: Unpatched SGLang plus simple-git RCE in the foundational CI dep plus the cross-vendor copy-paste-vulnerability framing all reinforce the underlying premise that inference-runtime + agentic-CI is one supply-chain category.

text_locales.en: Unpatched SGLang plus simple-git RCE in the foundational CI dep plus the cross-vendor copy-paste-vulnerability framing all reinforce the underlying premise that inference-runtime + agentic-CI is one supply-chain category.
text_locales.ja: 未パッチの SGLang、基盤的な CI 依存性での simple-git RCE、ベンダーをまたぐコピーアンドペースト脆弱性のフレーミングは、いずれも推論ランタイム + エージェンティック CI が一つのサプライチェーン カテゴリであるという根底前提を補強している。
text_locales.es: SGLang sin parchear más el RCE de simple-git en la dependencia fundacional CI más el encuadre de copy-paste-vulnerability cross-vendor refuerzan todos la premisa subyacente de que inference-runtime + agentic-CI son una sola categoría de cadena de suministro.
text_locales.fil: Ang hindi na-patch na SGLang kasama ang simple-git RCE sa foundational CI dep at ang cross-vendor copy-paste-vulnerability framing ay lahat nagpapatibay sa underlying premise na ang inference-runtime + agentic-CI ay isang supply-chain category.

detail.description: **Inference servers become the new "primitive supply chain" — Q3 2026 sees the first AI Infra-specific CVE class (LLM-INFRA-CWE) with mandatory NVD tagging.** The Apr 19-26 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m exploited)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + the Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot — composes a clear "inference-runtime + agentic-CI" attack-surface category. description.en: **The "AI-Infra CVE class" graduates into a regulatory primitive — Q4 2026 sees CISA / NIST publish a sub-catalog for inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, separate from KEV.** The Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — is no longer a "category emerging." NIST's Apr ops update (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) plus Google's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise in the wild** force CISA/NVD to ship a **dedicated inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging by Q4 2026. OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「AI インフラ CVE クラス」が規制プリミティブへ昇格する — Q4 2026 までに CISA / NIST が KEV とは別の、推論サーバ + エージェンティック CI ランタイム向けサブカタログを公表する。** 4/19-27 のシーケンス — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12 時間 31 分)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (依然として未パッチ)** + **Pillar による Antigravity の `find_by_name -X` 経由サンドボックス エスケープ** + **基盤的な CI/CD 依存性における simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE** + **4/21 の Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot をまたぐ Comment-and-Control プロンプトインジェクション連鎖** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 サンドボックス回避** — はもはや「カテゴリーが立ち現れている」段階ではない。NIST の 4 月運用アップデート (CVE 公表数の記録的増加、AI 駆動の評価サポート) と Google の **野生の間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 前年比増** が CISA / NVD に対し、Q4 2026 までに **SBOM タグ付け必須化を伴う、推論サーバ + エージェンティックツール専用の CVE サブカタログ**を出荷するよう迫る。OWASP の LLM Top 10 v2026 は「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」をトップ 3 へ格上げする。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La "clase CVE de AI-Infra" se gradúa como primitiva regulatoria — el Q4 2026 ve a CISA / NIST publicar un sub-catálogo para runtimes de inference-server + agentic-CI, separado de KEV.** La secuencia del 19-27 de abril — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (todavía sin parchear)** + **escape de sandbox de Pillar Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en una dependencia fundacional de CI/CD** + **cadena de prompt-injection Comment-and-Control del 21 de abril a través de Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **bypass de sandbox OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329** — ya no es una "categoría emergente". La actualización ops de NIST de abril (crecimiento récord de publicación de CVE, soporte de evaluación impulsado por IA) más el **aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecto en la naturaleza** de Google fuerzan a CISA/NVD a entregar un **sub-catálogo CVE dedicado a inference-server + agentic-tool** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio para el Q4 2026. El OWASP LLM Top 10 v2026 promueve "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" al top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "AI-Infra CVE class" ay magiging regulatory primitive — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ilalathala ng CISA / NIST ang sub-catalog para sa inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, hiwalay sa KEV.** Ang Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (hindi pa rin na-patch)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape sa pamamagitan ng `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE sa foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain sa Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — ay hindi na isang "category emerging." Ang Apr ops update ng NIST (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) kasama ang **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise sa wild ng Google** ay pumipilit sa CISA/NVD na magpadala ng **dedikadong inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** na may mandatory SBOM tagging pagsapit ng Q4 2026. Ang LLM Top 10 v2026 ng OWASP ay mag-aangat sa "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" sa top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

summary_short_locales.ja: 4/19-27 の 6 件の推論サーバおよびエージェンティック CI 攻撃 (LMDeploy SSRF、未パッチの SGLang SSTI、Antigravity サンドボックス エスケープ、simple-git RCE、マルチエージェント プロンプトインジェクション、OpenClaw 回避) と Google の間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 増が、CISA / NVD に対し Q4 2026 までに SBOM タグ付け必須化を伴う AI インフラ専用 CVE サブカタログを公表させる。

bridges.text: SGLang CVE-2026-5760's Apr 24 fix confirmed in the NVD detail today closes the longest-running 2026 LLM-tooling vulnerability, while the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers and the 2,800-3,600 AI-CVE forecast for 2026 (31-69% YoY) keep the precondition warm: inference-server + agentic-tool CVEs are now operationally distinguishable as their own sub-corpus.

text_locales.en: SGLang CVE-2026-5760's Apr 24 fix confirmed in the NVD detail today closes the longest-running 2026 LLM-tooling vulnerability, while the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers and the 2,800-3,600 AI-CVE forecast for 2026 (31-69% YoY) keep the precondition warm: inference-server + agentic-tool CVEs are now operationally distinguishable as their own sub-corpus.
text_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760の4月24日修正が本日NVD詳細で確認されたことは、最長稼働の2026年LLMツーリング脆弱性を閉じる一方、約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーおよび2026年AI-CVE予測の2,800〜3,600件(+31〜69% YoY)が前提条件を温存している: 推論サーバー + エージェンティック・ツールCVEは現在、独自のサブコーパスとして運用上区別可能である。
text_locales.es: El fix del 24 de abril de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 confirmado en el detalle NVD hoy cierra la vulnerabilidad de herramientas LLM más larga corriendo de 2026, mientras que los ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet y el pronóstico AI-CVE 2,800-3,600 para 2026 (31-69% YoY) mantienen caliente la precondición: los CVEs de servidor de inferencia + herramienta agéntica ahora son operativamente distinguibles como su propio sub-corpus.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 24 fix ng SGLang CVE-2026-5760 na kinumpirma sa NVD detail ngayon ay nagsasara sa pinakamatagal na 2026 LLM-tooling vulnerability, habang ang ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers at ang 2,800-3,600 AI-CVE forecast para sa 2026 (31-69% YoY) ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition: ang inference-server + agentic-tool CVEs ay operationally distinguishable na ngayon bilang sariling sub-corpus.

detail.description: **The "AI-Infra CVE class" graduates into a regulatory primitive — Q4 2026 sees CISA / NIST publish a sub-catalog for inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, separate from KEV.** The Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — is no longer a "category emerging." NIST's Apr ops update (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) plus Google's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise in the wild** force CISA/NVD to ship a **dedicated inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging by Q4 2026. OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **「AI インフラ CVE クラス」が規制プリミティブへ昇格する — Q4 2026 までに CISA / NIST が KEV とは別の、推論サーバ + エージェンティック CI ランタイム向けサブカタログを公表する。** 4/19-27 のシーケンス — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12 時間 31 分)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (依然として未パッチ)** + **Pillar による Antigravity の `find_by_name -X` 経由サンドボックス エスケープ** + **基盤的な CI/CD 依存性における simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE** + **4/21 の Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot をまたぐ Comment-and-Control プロンプトインジェクション連鎖** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 サンドボックス回避** — はもはや「カテゴリーが立ち現れている」段階ではない。NIST の 4 月運用アップデート (CVE 公表数の記録的増加、AI 駆動の評価サポート) と Google の **野生の間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 前年比増** が CISA / NVD に対し、Q4 2026 までに **SBOM タグ付け必須化を伴う、推論サーバ + エージェンティックツール専用の CVE サブカタログ**を出荷するよう迫る。OWASP の LLM Top 10 v2026 は「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」をトップ 3 へ格上げする。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **La "clase CVE de AI-Infra" se gradúa como primitiva regulatoria — el Q4 2026 ve a CISA / NIST publicar un sub-catálogo para runtimes de inference-server + agentic-CI, separado de KEV.** La secuencia del 19-27 de abril — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (todavía sin parchear)** + **escape de sandbox de Pillar Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en una dependencia fundacional de CI/CD** + **cadena de prompt-injection Comment-and-Control del 21 de abril a través de Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **bypass de sandbox OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329** — ya no es una "categoría emergente". La actualización ops de NIST de abril (crecimiento récord de publicación de CVE, soporte de evaluación impulsado por IA) más el **aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecto en la naturaleza** de Google fuerzan a CISA/NVD a entregar un **sub-catálogo CVE dedicado a inference-server + agentic-tool** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio para el Q4 2026. El OWASP LLM Top 10 v2026 promueve "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" al top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang "AI-Infra CVE class" ay magiging regulatory primitive — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ilalathala ng CISA / NIST ang sub-catalog para sa inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, hiwalay sa KEV.** Ang Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (hindi pa rin na-patch)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape sa pamamagitan ng `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE sa foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain sa Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — ay hindi na isang "category emerging." Ang Apr ops update ng NIST (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) kasama ang **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise sa wild ng Google** ay pumipilit sa CISA/NVD na magpadala ng **dedikadong inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** na may mandatory SBOM tagging pagsapit ng Q4 2026. Ang LLM Top 10 v2026 ng OWASP ay mag-aangat sa "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" sa top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.description: **Inference-server SSTI graduates from one-off CVE to OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry; CISA ships an "AI-Infra KEV" sub-catalog by Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **remains unpatched into Apr 28** (10+ days post-disclosure), with a public PoC and the same Jinja2-without-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` shape now flagged as a copy-paste class spanning vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent inference servers. Combined with the **Apr 27-28 Totolink CVE quad (7153/7154/7156/7202, all 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in CI/CD**, **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`**, and Google/Forcepoint's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise** with 10 in-the-wild payloads — pressure on NIST/CISA crystallizes. **By Q3 2026 CISA ships a dedicated "AI-Infra" KEV sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging on inference servers (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) and agentic-CI runtimes (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.ja: 5月5日のNVD確認のSGLang CVE-2026-5760修正は、最長稼働の2026年LLMツーリングRCEを閉じるが、サプライチェーンGGUFベクトル、約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバー(およそ半数が未認証)、+31〜69% YoYのAI-CVE予測が、推論サーバー / テンプレートローダー脅威クラスをSBOMカバレッジを伴う専用KEVサブカタログに値するほど温存している。
text_locales.es: El fix de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 confirmado por NVD del 5 de mayo cierra el RCE LLM-tooling más largo corriendo de 2026, pero el vector GGUF de cadena de suministro y los ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (aproximadamente la mitad sin autenticación) más un pronóstico AI-CVE de 31-69% YoY mantienen la clase de amenaza servidor-de-inferencia / cargador-de-plantillas suficientemente caliente como para merecer un sub-catálogo KEV dedicado con cobertura SBOM.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 5 NVD-confirmed SGLang CVE-2026-5760 fix ay nagsasara sa pinakamatagal na 2026 LLM-tooling RCE, ngunit ang supply-chain GGUF vector at ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (humigit-kumulang kalahati ay walang authentication) plus ang 31-69% YoY AI-CVE forecast ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang inference-server / template-loader threat-class na sapat upang maging karapat-dapat sa dedicated KEV sub-catalog na may SBOM coverage.

text_locales.es: El SQLi pre-auth de LiteLLM es la extensión más limpia hasta ahora de la forma SSTI Jinja2-sin-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment que SGLang expuso, aplicada al tier gateway con blast radius de claves multi-vendor. La telemetría de CVE está convergiendo exactamente donde la predicción dijo, pero la entrada OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 y el sub-catálogo CISA AI-Infra KEV todavía están upstream del deadline Q3 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang pre-auth SQLi ng LiteLLM ay ang pinaka-malinis na extension hanggang ngayon ng Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI shape na inilantad ng SGLang, na inilapat sa gateway tier na may multi-vendor key blast radius. text_locales.en: SGLang's 10+ day unpatched window with shipping-exploitable v0.5.10, the cross-server SSTI copy-paste class spanning vLLM and LMDeploy, and Apr 28's CISA KEV adds plus the Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster directly extend the precondition the prediction names. text_locales.ja: SGLangの10日以上の未パッチ・ウィンドウ(悪用可能v0.5.10を出荷)、vLLMとLMDeployにまたがるクロスサーバーSSTIコピペ・クラス、4月28日のCISA KEV追加、Milesight + Totolink 9.8クラスタが、予測が指摘する前提条件を直接拡大する。NIST / CISAへの圧力は、予測が投影する推論サーバーSSTI軸に沿ってまさに構築されている。
text_locales.es: La ventana de 10+ dias sin parchear de SGLang con v0.5.10 explotable enviada, la clase SSTI cross-server copy-paste spanning vLLM y LMDeploy, y los KEV adds del 28 de abril de CISA mas el cluster Milesight + Totolink 9.8 extienden directamente la precondicion que la prediccion nombra. La presion sobre NIST / CISA esta construyendose exactamente a lo largo del eje SSTI de inference-server que la prediccion proyecta.
text_locales.fil: Ang 10+ araw unpatched window ng SGLang kasama ang shipping-exploitable v0.5.10, ang cross-server SSTI copy-paste class na sumasaklaw sa vLLM at LMDeploy, at ang Apr 28 CISA KEV adds kasama ang Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster ay direktang nagpapalawak sa precondition na pinapangalanan ng hula. Ang pressure sa NIST / CISA ay nabubuo nang eksakto sa inference-server SSTI axis na ipino-project ng hula.

detail.description: **Inference-server SSTI graduates from one-off CVE to OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry; CISA ships an "AI-Infra KEV" sub-catalog by Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **remains unpatched into Apr 28** (10+ days post-disclosure), with a public PoC and the same Jinja2-without-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` shape now flagged as a copy-paste class spanning vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent inference servers. Combined with the **Apr 27-28 Totolink CVE quad (7153/7154/7156/7202, all 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in CI/CD**, **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`**, and Google/Forcepoint's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise** with 10 in-the-wild payloads — pressure on NIST/CISA crystallizes. **By Q3 2026 CISA ships a dedicated "AI-Infra" KEV sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging on inference servers (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) and agentic-CI runtimes (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.description: **By H2 2026 the agent-skills attack surface lands its own MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ships an enforced signing + provenance gate.** ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills + Cisco's **36% prompt-injection rate across the OpenClaw skill marketplace** is no longer a one-off — Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. With Corpus2Skill making **"skills as a navigable artifact"** mainstream and the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) calling skills/harness/protocol the dominant 2026 design layer, the attack surface is now **first-class infrastructure**, not a side-channel. By H2 2026 we see (a) a published agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style or NIST-led) covering skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, and (b) at least one major marketplace mandating signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish — with Anthropic's 17-skill repo, ClawHub, Multica's marketplace, and Hugging Face's agent-trace surface as the first candidates. description.es: **Para el H2 2026 la superficie de ataque de agent-skills aterriza su propia sub-matriz estilo MITRE-ATT&CK y al menos un mercado de skills importante (skills oficiales de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face / trazas de agente) envia una puerta de firma + procedencia obligatoria.** Las 1,184 skills maliciosas de ClawHub de ClawHavoc + el **36% de tasa de prompt-injection a traves del mercado de skills de OpenClaw** de Cisco ya no es algo aislado — el Novita Sandbox del 28 de abril es el primer producto comercial de mitigacion construido a proposito para runtimes OpenClaw + Hermes + agente-autonomo. Con Corpus2Skill haciendo mainstream **"skills como artefacto navegable"** y el survey Externalization-in-LLM-Agents (arxiv 2604.08224) llamando skills/harness/protocol la capa de diseno dominante de 2026, la superficie de ataque ahora es **infraestructura de primera clase**, no un canal lateral. Para el H2 2026 vemos (a) una matriz de amenazas de agent-skills publicada (estilo MITRE o liderada por NIST) cubriendo envenenamiento de skills + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cadenas de privilegio entre-skills, y (b) al menos un mercado importante mandando skills firmadas-y-con-procedencia-atestada antes de publicar — con el repo de 17-skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, el mercado de Multica, y la superficie de trazas de agente de Hugging Face como los primeros candidatos. description.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang agent-skills attack surface ay magkakaroon ng sariling MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix at kahit isang major skill marketplace (opisyal na skills ng Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ay maglalabas ng enforced signing + provenance gate.** Ang 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills ng ClawHavoc + ang **36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco sa kabuuan ng OpenClaw skill marketplace** ay hindi na one-off — ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox ang unang commercial mitigation product na purpose-built para sa OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. summary.ja: **2026年H2までに、エージェント・スキルの攻撃面が独自のMITRE-ATT&CK様式のサブマトリクスを獲得し、少なくとも1つの主要スキル・マーケットプレイス(Anthropicの公式スキル、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Faceスキル/エージェント・トレース)が強制署名+来歴ゲートを出荷する。** ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるClawHubスキル + Ciscoの**OpenClawスキル・マーケットプレイス全体での36%のプロンプト・インジェクション率**は、もはや単発ではない — 4月28日のNovita Sandboxは、OpenClaw + Hermes + 自律エージェント・ランタイム向けに構築された最初の商用緩和製品だ。Corpus2Skillが**「ナビゲート可能な成果物としてのスキル」**を主流化し、Externalization-in-LLM-Agentsサーベイ(arxiv 2604.08224)がスキル/ハーネス/プロトコルを2026年の支配的な設計レイヤーと呼ぶことで、攻撃面は今や**サイドチャネルではなくファーストクラスのインフラ**となった。2026年H2までに、(a) スキル・ポイズニング + スキル経由の間接プロンプト・インジェクション + クロススキル特権チェーンをカバーする公開エージェント・スキル脅威マトリクス(MITRE様式またはNIST主導)、および (b) 公開前に署名済みかつ来歴認証済みのスキルを義務付ける少なくとも1つの主要マーケットプレイス — Anthropicの17スキル・リポジトリ、ClawHub、Multicaのマーケットプレイス、Hugging Faceのエージェント・トレース面が最初の候補となる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

detail.description: **By H2 2026 the agent-skills attack surface lands its own MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ships an enforced signing + provenance gate.** ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills + Cisco's **36% prompt-injection rate across the OpenClaw skill marketplace** is no longer a one-off — Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. With Corpus2Skill making **"skills as a navigable artifact"** mainstream and the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) calling skills/harness/protocol the dominant 2026 design layer, the attack surface is now **first-class infrastructure**, not a side-channel. By H2 2026 we see (a) a published agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style or NIST-led) covering skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, and (b) at least one major marketplace mandating signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish — with Anthropic's 17-skill repo, ClawHub, Multica's marketplace, and Hugging Face's agent-trace surface as the first candidates. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年H2までに、エージェント・スキルの攻撃面が独自のMITRE-ATT&CK様式のサブマトリクスを獲得し、少なくとも1つの主要スキル・マーケットプレイス(Anthropicの公式スキル、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Faceスキル/エージェント・トレース)が強制署名+来歴ゲートを出荷する。** ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるClawHubスキル + Ciscoの**OpenClawスキル・マーケットプレイス全体での36%のプロンプト・インジェクション率**は、もはや単発ではない — 4月28日のNovita Sandboxは、OpenClaw + Hermes + 自律エージェント・ランタイム向けに構築された最初の商用緩和製品だ。Corpus2Skillが**「ナビゲート可能な成果物としてのスキル」**を主流化し、Externalization-in-LLM-Agentsサーベイ(arxiv 2604.08224)がスキル/ハーネス/プロトコルを2026年の支配的な設計レイヤーと呼ぶことで、攻撃面は今や**サイドチャネルではなくファーストクラスのインフラ**となった。2026年H2までに、(a) スキル・ポイズニング + スキル経由の間接プロンプト・インジェクション + クロススキル特権チェーンをカバーする公開エージェント・スキル脅威マトリクス(MITRE様式またはNIST主導)、および (b) 公開前に署名済みかつ来歴認証済みのスキルを義務付ける少なくとも1つの主要マーケットプレイス — Anthropicの17スキル・リポジトリ、ClawHub、Multicaのマーケットプレイス、Hugging Faceのエージェント・トレース面が最初の候補となる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el H2 2026 la superficie de ataque de agent-skills aterriza su propia sub-matriz estilo MITRE-ATT&CK y al menos un mercado de skills importante (skills oficiales de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face / trazas de agente) envia una puerta de firma + procedencia obligatoria.** Las 1,184 skills maliciosas de ClawHub de ClawHavoc + el **36% de tasa de prompt-injection a traves del mercado de skills de OpenClaw** de Cisco ya no es algo aislado — el Novita Sandbox del 28 de abril es el primer producto comercial de mitigacion construido a proposito para runtimes OpenClaw + Hermes + agente-autonomo. Con Corpus2Skill haciendo mainstream **"skills como artefacto navegable"** y el survey Externalization-in-LLM-Agents (arxiv 2604.08224) llamando skills/harness/protocol la capa de diseno dominante de 2026, la superficie de ataque ahora es **infraestructura de primera clase**, no un canal lateral. Para el H2 2026 vemos (a) una matriz de amenazas de agent-skills publicada (estilo MITRE o liderada por NIST) cubriendo envenenamiento de skills + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cadenas de privilegio entre-skills, y (b) al menos un mercado importante mandando skills firmadas-y-con-procedencia-atestada antes de publicar — con el repo de 17-skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, el mercado de Multica, y la superficie de trazas de agente de Hugging Face como los primeros candidatos. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang agent-skills attack surface ay magkakaroon ng sariling MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix at kahit isang major skill marketplace (opisyal na skills ng Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ay maglalabas ng enforced signing + provenance gate.** Ang 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills ng ClawHavoc + ang **36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco sa kabuuan ng OpenClaw skill marketplace** ay hindi na one-off — ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox ang unang commercial mitigation product na purpose-built para sa OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. Sa Corpus2Skill na ginagawang **"skills bilang navigable artifact"** mainstream at ang Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) na tumatawag sa skills/harness/protocol bilang dominant 2026 design layer, ang attack surface ay ngayon **first-class infrastructure**, hindi side-channel. Pagsapit ng H2 2026, makikita natin ang (a) inilathalang agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style o NIST-led) na sumasaklaw sa skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, at (b) kahit isang major marketplace na nag-mamandato ng signed-and-provenance-attested skills bago mag-publish — kasama ang 17-skill repo ng Anthropic, ClawHub, marketplace ng Multica, at agent-trace surface ng Hugging Face bilang unang mga kandidato. nodes.description: By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. **By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 + v5.4 framework already names AI-agent context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, and malicious agent deployment as techniques; Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes runtimes; Apr 28 SuiteCloud Agent Skills (Oracle NetSuite, SuiteConnect SF) is the first major non-foundation-lab vendor shipping skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the security frame; Apr 28 arxiv 2604.24026 (SSL representation for skills) + Apr 24 arxiv 2604.23374 NeuroTaint provide the academic scaffolding. The forcing function is the Cisco RSAC 2026 36%-prompt-injection-rate finding + ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills + Apr 23-29 Google +32% IPI uptick; combined this is the same governance-gap arc that produced MITRE ATT&CK Mobile in 2017 and MITRE ATLAS in 2021. The first of these mandates likely originates from CISA / NIST or directly from the marketplace operators under enterprise-customer pressure rather than from a foundation lab.

detail.summary_short: ATT&CK v19's named techniques (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) plus ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills, Cisco's 36% prompt-injection rate, and a +32% IPI uptick force a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix and an enforced signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate by Q3 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named techniques (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) plus ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills, Cisco's 36% prompt-injection rate, and a +32% IPI uptick force a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix and an enforced signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名された技法(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出しの濫用、MCP侵害、悪意あるエージェントのデプロイ)に加え、ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるスキル、Ciscoの36%プロンプトインジェクション率、+32%のIPI急増が、2026年Q3までに公開されたエージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクスと強制的な署名+来歴認証マーケットプレイスゲートを強制する。
summary_short_locales.es: Las técnicas nombradas en ATT&CK v19 (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos) más los 1.184 skills maliciosos de ClawHavoc, la tasa del 36% de prompt-injection de Cisco y un alza del +32% en IPI fuerzan una sub-matriz publicada de amenazas de agent-skills y un gate obligatorio de firma + provenance en marketplaces para Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang mga pinangalanang technique ng ATT&CK v19 (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) kasama ang 1,184 malicious skills ng ClawHavoc, 36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco, at +32% IPI uptick ay pumipilit ng nailathalang agent-skills threat sub-matrix at ipinatutupad na signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: The May 7 wave — n8n KEV plus LangGraph SSRF (control-plane to cloud-metadata pivot) plus LiteLLM identity-impersonation plus MCP-server exposure telemetry plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — delivers ~5x the empirical corpus the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) baseline assumed, spanning webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, and identity-impersonation in 24 hours.

text_locales.en: The May 7 wave — n8n KEV plus LangGraph SSRF (control-plane to cloud-metadata pivot) plus LiteLLM identity-impersonation plus MCP-server exposure telemetry plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — delivers ~5x the empirical corpus the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) baseline assumed, spanning webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, and identity-impersonation in 24 hours.
text_locales.ja: 5月7日の波──n8n KEV、LangGraph SSRF(コントロールプレーンからクラウドメタデータへのピボット)、LiteLLMアイデンティティ偽装、MCPサーバー露出テレメトリ、Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP検出GA──は、エージェントスキルMITRE/NIST拡張予測(4月30日)のベースライン想定の約5倍の経験的コーパスを24時間以内に提供し、Webhook濫用、コントロールプレーンSSRF、アイデンティティ偽装に及んでいる。
text_locales.es: La oleada del 7 de mayo — n8n KEV más SSRF de LangGraph (pivote de plano de control a metadatos en la nube) más suplantación de identidad de LiteLLM más telemetría de exposición de servidor MCP más GA de detección MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud — entrega ~5x el corpus empírico que la base de la predicción de extensión MITRE/NIST de habilidades de agente (30 de abril) asumió, abarcando abuso de webhook, SSRF de plano de control y suplantación de identidad en 24 horas.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 7 wave — n8n KEV kasama ang LangGraph SSRF (control-plane sa cloud-metadata pivot) kasama ang LiteLLM identity-impersonation kasama ang MCP-server exposure telemetry kasama ang Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — ay nagdedeliver ng ~5x ng empirical corpus na inakala ng agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Abr 30) baseline, sumasaklaw sa webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, at identity-impersonation sa loob ng 24 oras.

bridges.text: The n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus the standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline tighten the structural force the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) names: the LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus is now ~5x richer than the prediction baseline assumed, hardening the empirical case for a curated standards-body extension.

text_locales.en: The n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus the standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline tighten the structural force the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) names: the LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus is now ~5x richer than the prediction baseline assumed, hardening the empirical case for a curated standards-body extension.
text_locales.ja: n8n + Flowise + LMDeployのCVEウェーブと、標準のSGLang jinja2 SSTIベースラインは、エージェントスキルMITRE/NIST拡張予測(4月30日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する: LLMプラットフォーム固有の攻撃パターン・コーパスは、予測のベースラインが想定したよりも約5倍リッチであり、キュレートされた標準化団体拡張への経験的ケースを硬化させている。
text_locales.es: La ola de CVEs n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy más la línea base estándar SGLang jinja2 SSTI tensan la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción de extensión agent-skills MITRE/NIST (30 abr): el corpus de patrones de ataque específicos de plataforma LLM es ~5x más rico de lo que asumió la línea base, endureciendo el caso empírico para una extensión curada de cuerpo de estándares.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus ang standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Abr 30): ang LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus ay ~5x richer kaysa sa inakala ng prediction baseline, na nagpapatibay ng empirical case para sa curated standards-body extension.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. **By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 + v5.4 framework already names AI-agent context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, and malicious agent deployment as techniques; Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes runtimes; Apr 28 SuiteCloud Agent Skills (Oracle NetSuite, SuiteConnect SF) is the first major non-foundation-lab vendor shipping skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the security frame; Apr 28 arxiv 2604.24026 (SSL representation for skills) + Apr 24 arxiv 2604.23374 NeuroTaint provide the academic scaffolding. The forcing function is the Cisco RSAC 2026 36%-prompt-injection-rate finding + ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills + Apr 23-29 Google +32% IPI uptick; combined this is the same governance-gap arc that produced MITRE ATT&CK Mobile in 2017 and MITRE ATLAS in 2021. The first of these mandates likely originates from CISA / NIST or directly from the marketplace operators under enterprise-customer pressure rather than from a foundation lab.

La función forzante es el hallazgo de Cisco RSAC 2026 de 36% de tasa de prompt-injection + los 1.184 skills maliciosos de ClawHavoc + el alza del +32% en IPI de Google del 23-29 abr; combinado, este es el mismo arco de brecha-de-gobernanza que produjo MITRE ATT&CK Mobile en 2017 y MITRE ATLAS en 2021. Es probable que el primero de estos mandatos se origine en CISA / NIST o directamente en los operadores de marketplace bajo presión de clientes empresariales en lugar de en un laboratorio de fundación. nodes.description: **By H2 2026 the May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + the Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + the unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 trio makes "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" the dominant attacker pattern — at least one major IR firm publishes a public post-mortem of a real intrusion that pairs an LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE with a Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail or its successor) for full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, and at least one CSAI-CNA-issued advisory explicitly carves out the LLM-tooling + kernel chain as a named technique within ATT&CK v19's Defense Impairment.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 already names the agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); the May 1 Copy Fail wave gives attackers a universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); the LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent gives them the lateral-movement vector. CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization is the disclosure-issuance side; the path of least resistance for an IR firm Q3 incident report is one cloud-multi-tenant intrusion stitched together this exact way. description.en: **By H2 2026 the May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + the Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + the unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 trio makes "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" the dominant attacker pattern — at least one major IR firm publishes a public post-mortem of a real intrusion that pairs an LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE with a Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail or its successor) for full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, and at least one CSAI-CNA-issued advisory explicitly carves out the LLM-tooling + kernel chain as a named technique within ATT&CK v19's Defense Impairment.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 already names the agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); the May 1 Copy Fail wave gives attackers a universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); the LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent gives them the lateral-movement vector. CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization is the disclosure-issuance side; the path of least resistance for an IR firm Q3 incident report is one cloud-multi-tenant intrusion stitched together this exact way. In plain language: Hackers can chain an AI-tooling bug with a Linux-kernel bug to take over shared AI servers. In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、5月1日のCopy Fail(CVE-2026-31431)BOD-22-01の14日期限 + 4月30日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208の26時間悪用ウィンドウ + 5月1日まで未パッチのSGLang CVE-2026-5760という3点セットが、「LLMツーリング層CVEのサプライチェーン武器化」を支配的な攻撃パターンにする — 少なくとも1つの大手IRファームが、LLMゲートウェイ/エージェントハーネス/推論ランタイムのCVEとLinuxカーネルLPE(Copy Failまたはその後継)を組み合わせて、マルチテナント推論基盤上でフルチェーンrootを取得した実際の侵入の公開ポストモーテムを発表する;少なくとも1つのCSAI-CNA発行のアドバイザリーが、ATT&CK v19のDefense Impairment内で、LLMツーリング+カーネル連鎖を名前付きテクニックとして明示的に切り出す。** 4月28日のATT&CK v19はすでにエージェント関連テクニック(コンテキストポイズニング、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェントデプロイ)を命名している;5月1日のCopy Failの波が、攻撃者にクラウドサービスプロバイダーへの実環境利用が確認された(Microsoft Security Blog開示による)汎用Linux LPEを与えた;LiteLLMのSQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keysの先例が、横展開ベクトルを与える。CSAIの4月29日CNA認可は開示発行側であり、IRファームのQ3インシデントレポートにとって最も抵抗の少ない経路は、まさにこの形で組み立てられた1件のクラウドマルチテナント侵入である。In plain language: ハッカーはAIツーリングのバグとLinuxカーネルのバグを連鎖させて、共有AIサーバーを乗っ取れる。In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el H2 2026, el plazo de 14 días BOD-22-01 del Copy Fail del 1 mayo (CVE-2026-31431) + la ventana de explotación de 26 horas del LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 30 abr + el trío SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sin parchear hasta el 1 mayo convierte la "weaponización de la cadena de suministro de CVEs de la capa de tooling-LLM" en el patrón dominante de los atacantes — al menos una firma importante de respuesta a incidentes publicará un post-mortem público de una intrusión real que combine un CVE de gateway-LLM / agent-harness / inference-runtime con un LPE del kernel Linux (Copy Fail o su sucesor) para obtener root de cadena completa en inferencia multi-inquilino, y al menos un aviso emitido por CSAI-CNA destacará explícitamente la cadena tooling-LLM + kernel como técnica nombrada dentro del Defense Impairment de ATT&CK v19.** ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr ya nombra las técnicas agénticas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agente malicioso); la ola Copy Fail del 1 mayo da a los atacantes un LPE Linux universal con uso confirmado en el mundo real contra proveedores de servicios cloud (según divulgación del Microsoft Security Blog); el precedente de SQLi-fuga-de-claves-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock de LiteLLM les da el vector de movimiento lateral. La autorización CNA del 29 abr de CSAI es el lado de emisión de divulgaciones; la ruta de menor resistencia para un informe de incidentes Q3 de una firma IR es una intrusión cloud multi-inquilino unida exactamente de esta forma. En lenguaje claro: Los hackers pueden encadenar un bug de tooling de IA con un bug del kernel Linux para tomar el control de servidores de IA compartidos. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
description.fil: **Sa H2 2026 ang trio ng May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + ang unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay magpapakahulugan sa "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" bilang dominanteng attacker pattern — hindi bababa sa isang major IR firm ang maglalathala ng pampublikong post-mortem ng totoong intrusion na pinagsasama ang LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE sa Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail o ang successor nito) para sa full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, at hindi bababa sa isang CSAI-CNA-issued advisory ang explicitly mag-cha-carve out sa LLM-tooling + kernel chain bilang named technique sa loob ng Defense Impairment ng ATT&CK v19.** Pinangalanan na ng Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ang agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang May 1 Copy Fail wave ay nagbibigay sa attackers ng universal-Linux LPE na may confirmed in-the-wild use laban sa cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); ang LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent ang nagbibigay sa kanila ng lateral-movement vector. Ang Apr 29 CSAI CNA authorization ay ang disclosure-issuance side; ang pinakamadaling daan para sa Q3 incident report ng IR firm ay isang cloud-multi-tenant intrusion na pinagsama-sama nang ganito.

title_locales.ja: LLMツーリング+LinuxカーネルのCVE連鎖が2026年下半期までに支配的な攻撃パターンに
title_locales.es: El encadenamiento de CVEs de tooling LLM + kernel Linux se convertirá en patrón de ataque dominante para el H2 2026
title_locales.fil: Ang LLM-tooling + Linux-kernel CVE chain ay magiging dominanteng pattern ng pag-atake pagsapit ng H2 2026

detail.summary_short: May 1 Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with cloud-provider in-the-wild use, layered onto the Apr 30 LiteLLM 26-hour SQLi-key-leak and unpatched SGLang RCE, plus ATT&CK v19's agentic technique names and CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization, set up at least one IR-firm public post-mortem and one CSAI CNA advisory naming the LLM-tooling + kernel chain by H2 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: May 1 Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with cloud-provider in-the-wild use, layered onto the Apr 30 LiteLLM 26-hour SQLi-key-leak and unpatched SGLang RCE, plus ATT&CK v19's agentic technique names and CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization, set up at least one IR-firm public post-mortem and one CSAI CNA advisory naming the LLM-tooling + kernel chain by H2 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: 5月1日のCopy Failのクラウドプロバイダー実環境利用付き汎用Linux LPEが、4月30日のLiteLLM 26時間SQLi-key-leakと未パッチのSGLang RCEに重なり、さらにATT&CK v19のエージェント関連テクニック命名とCSAIの4月29日CNA認可が加わって、2026年下半期までに少なくとも1つのIRファーム公開ポストモーテムと、LLMツーリング+カーネル連鎖を命名する1つのCSAI CNAアドバイザリーが整う。
summary_short_locales.es: El LPE Linux universal del Copy Fail del 1 mayo con uso confirmado en proveedores cloud en el mundo real, sumado a la SQLi-fuga-de-claves de 26 horas de LiteLLM del 30 abr y al RCE sin parchear de SGLang, más los nombres de técnicas agénticas de ATT&CK v19 y la autorización CNA del 29 abr de CSAI, montan al menos un post-mortem público de firma IR y un aviso CNA de CSAI nombrando la cadena tooling-LLM + kernel para el H2 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang universal-Linux LPE ng May 1 Copy Fail na may cloud-provider in-the-wild use, na nilagyan ng layer ng Apr 30 LiteLLM 26-hour SQLi-key-leak at unpatched SGLang RCE, kasama ng ATT&CK v19 agentic technique names at ng Apr 29 CNA authorization ng CSAI, ay nagse-set up ng hindi bababa sa isang IR-firm pampublikong post-mortem at isang CSAI CNA advisory na nagpapangalan sa LLM-tooling + kernel chain pagsapit ng H2 2026.

bridges.text: The n8n RCE landing arbitrary commands on the underlying host plus Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency confirm exactly the precondition the LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (May 2) names: LLM-tooling vulnerabilities now reliably reach host OS execution within hours of disclosure. The kernel-CVE half of the chain has not yet been demonstrated.

text_locales.en: The n8n RCE landing arbitrary commands on the underlying host plus Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency confirm exactly the precondition the LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (May 2) names: LLM-tooling vulnerabilities now reliably reach host OS execution within hours of disclosure. The kernel-CVE half of the chain has not yet been demonstrated.
text_locales.ja: 基盤ホストへ任意コマンドを着地させるn8n RCEに加え、FlowiseのプロンプトインジェクションRCE、LMDeployの12時間31分の悪用レイテンシは、LLMツーリング・Linuxカーネル・チェーン予測(5月2日)が指摘する前提条件を確認する: LLMツーリング脆弱性は現在、開示から数時間以内に確実にホストOS実行に到達する。チェーンのカーネルCVE側はまだ実証されていない。
text_locales.es: La RCE de n8n aterrizando comandos arbitrarios en el host subyacente más la RCE impulsada por prompt-injection de Flowise más la latencia de 12h-31m de LMDeploy confirman exactamente la condición previa que nombra la predicción de cadena CVE LLM-tooling + Linux-kernel (2 may): las vulnerabilidades de tooling LLM ahora alcanzan de forma fiable ejecución en SO host en horas tras la divulgación. La mitad kernel-CVE de la cadena aún no se ha demostrado.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n RCE na naglalanding ng arbitrary commands sa underlying host plus ang Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus ang LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency ay nagkukumpirma sa eksaktong precondition na pinapangalanan ng LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (Mayo 2): ang LLM-tooling vulnerabilities ay reliably na nakaka-reach ng host OS execution sa loob ng oras pagkatapos ng disclosure. Hindi pa na-demonstrate ang kernel-CVE half ng chain.

bridges.text: The Stellar Cyber survey treating SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain as the operative late-2026 threat class extends the LLM-tooling-layer leg of the predicted chain; the kernel leg stays quiet today.

text_locales.en: The Stellar Cyber survey treating SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain as the operative late-2026 threat class extends the LLM-tooling-layer leg of the predicted chain; the kernel leg stays quiet today.
text_locales.ja: Stellar Cyber調査がSGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agentサイレント流出チェーンを運用上の2026年後半脅威クラスとして扱うことが、予測されたチェーンのLLMツール層レッグを延長する; カーネル・レッグは本日も静かなままである。
text_locales.es: La encuesta de Stellar Cyber tratando SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + cadena de exfiltración silenciosa Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent como la clase de amenaza operativa de finales de 2026 extiende la pierna de capa de herramientas LLM de la cadena predicha; la pierna de kernel permanece silenciosa hoy.
text_locales.fil: Ang Stellar Cyber survey na nagtatrato sa SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain bilang operative late-2026 threat class ay nagpapahaba sa LLM-tooling-layer leg ng predicted chain; ang kernel leg ay nananatiling tahimik ngayon.

bridges.text: Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers stacked on the still-unpatched SGLang and LiteLLM key-leak SQLi gives attackers a complete LLM-tooling-plus-kernel template. The chain the prediction names is now visible across the May 1-3 advisory window.

text_locales.en: Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers stacked on the still-unpatched SGLang and LiteLLM key-leak SQLi gives attackers a complete LLM-tooling-plus-kernel template. The chain the prediction names is now visible across the May 1-3 advisory window.
text_locales.ja: Copy Failのユニバーサル-Linux LPEがクラウドサービスプロバイダに対する野生での使用が確認され、未だ未パッチのSGLangとLiteLLM鍵漏洩SQLiと積層して、攻撃者に完全なLLMツーリングプラスカーネルテンプレートを与える。予測が命名するチェーンは今や5月1-3日のアドバイザリーウィンドウを通じて可視化されている。
text_locales.es: El LPE Linux universal de Copy Fail con uso confirmado in-the-wild contra proveedores de servicio de nube apilado sobre el SGLang aún sin parchar y LiteLLM key-leak SQLi da a los atacantes una plantilla LLM-tooling-más-kernel completa. La cadena que la predicción nombra ahora es visible a través de la ventana de avisos del 1-3 de mayo.

Ang chain na pinapangalanan ng prediction ay nakikita na ngayon sa kabuuan ng May 1-3 advisory window.

detail.description: **By H2 2026 the May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + the Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + the unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 trio makes "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" the dominant attacker pattern — at least one major IR firm publishes a public post-mortem of a real intrusion that pairs an LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE with a Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail or its successor) for full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, and at least one CSAI-CNA-issued advisory explicitly carves out the LLM-tooling + kernel chain as a named technique within ATT&CK v19's Defense Impairment.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 already names the agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); the May 1 Copy Fail wave gives attackers a universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); the LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent gives them the lateral-movement vector. CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization is the disclosure-issuance side; the path of least resistance for an IR firm Q3 incident report is one cloud-multi-tenant intrusion stitched together this exact way. nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).

description.ja: 2026年Q3までに、同じウィンドウ内で着地したLLMワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEのクラスター—n8n CVE-2026-21858(CVSS 10.0、ウェブフックcontent-type混乱経由の未認証RCE、Cyera Research Labsが「Ni8mare」と命名、1.121.0でパッチ、カナダ・サイバーセキュリティセンター + 豪ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security全てがアドバイザリーを公表)、Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264(プロンプト・インジェクション駆動のRCEで、チャットフロー・ユーザーがLLMに攻撃者制御Pythonを発出させる)、LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF(Sysdigハニーポット艦隊で開示後12時間31分以内に最初のエクスプロイト試行)、Georgia Techの Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in 2026年3月にAIコーディング・ツール直接起因(オープンソース・エコシステム全体で5-10倍の真の数のアンダーカウントと研究者推定)—がSGLang CVE-2026-5760パッチと~7,000のインターネット露出MCPサーバー(約半数が未認証)のベースラインと組み合わさり、CISAをして、n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Difyクラス・プラットフォームをカテゴリーで命名し、ウェブフックcontent-type検証 + プロンプト・インジェクション認識最小権限 + MCP-tool-call audit-trailコントロール・ファミリーを規定する専用エージェンティックAIワークフロー・プラットフォーム・セキュア展開ガイドを発出させる。フォーシング・ファンクションは、Tier-2エンタープライズで広く展開されているノーコードAIワークフロー・ハーネスでのNi8mare CVSS-10スコアが、既存のCISA AIガイダンス(モデル・プロバイダーと大規模展開層バイヤーをターゲット)を運用上の現実に対して狭すぎるものにすること。ガイドはCISA Cybersecurity AdvisoryまたはSecure-by-Design補足が最も可能性高い;FBI + NSA + 国際Five Eyesカウンターパートがn8nに関するCCCS / ASDのAL26-001ジョイント・パターンをディスパッチ形状の前例として、一サイクル以内に共同署名する。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 el cluster de CVEs de plataformas LLM-workflow aterrizando en la misma ventana — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 RCE no autenticado vía confusión content-type en webhook, codenombrado Ni8mare por Cyera Research Labs, parchado en 1.121.0, con avisos de Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (RCE driven por inyección de prompt donde un usuario chatflow induce al LLM a emitir Python controlado por atacante), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (primero explotado dentro de 12 horas 31 minutos de divulgación per flota honeypot Sysdig), el conteo Vibe Security Radar de Georgia Tech de 35 CVEs en marzo 2026 directamente atribuibles a herramientas AI coding (con investigadores estimando subconteo 5-10x a través del ecosistema open-source) — combinado con el parche standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + la baseline de ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (~mitad sin autenticación) fuerza a CISA a publicar una guía dedicada de despliegue seguro de plataformas de workflow agentic-AI nombrando plataformas clase n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify por categoría y prescribiendo familias de control de validación content-type webhook + least-privilege consciente de inyección de prompts + audit-trail MCP-tool-call. plain_language.es: Tras varias herramientas no-code de flujos de trabajo de IA recibir fallos serios de seguridad este mes, la agencia cyber de EE.UU. publicará una guía de despliegue nombrando esas herramientas por categoría.

bridges.text: Sunday compounds the agentic-platform CVE wave that anchors the prediction: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) extend the Microsoft agent stack; Trail of Bits names a shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; Shadowserver day-ten drops exposed n8n to ~5,700; CISA refreshes KEV ahead of the May 21 deadline.

text_locales.en: Sunday compounds the agentic-platform CVE wave that anchors the prediction: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) extend the Microsoft agent stack; Trail of Bits names a shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; Shadowserver day-ten drops exposed n8n to ~5,700; CISA refreshes KEV ahead of the May 21 deadline.
text_locales.ja: 日曜は予測をアンカーするエージェンティック・プラットフォームCVEの波を複合化させる: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612(CVSS 8.9 チェックポイント・デシリアライゼーション)とSemantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638(CVSS 8.4 プラグイン・マニフェストSSRF)がMicrosoftエージェント・スタックを拡張する;Trail of Bitsは共有チェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・ローダー曝露パターンを命名する;Shadowserverの10日目は曝露n8nを~5,700へ低下させる;CISAは5月21日期限に先立ってKEVをリフレッシュする。
text_locales.es: El domingo compone la ola de CVE de plataforma agéntica que ancla la predicción: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 deserialización de checkpoint) y Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 SSRF de plugin-manifest) extienden el stack de agente Microsoft; Trail of Bits nombra un patrón compartido de exposición checkpoint-y-manifest-loader; el día diez de Shadowserver baja n8n expuesto a ~5,700; CISA refresca KEV antes de la fecha límite del 21 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Nagdadagdag ang Linggo sa agentic-platform CVE wave na nag-aanchor sa prediksyon: pinapalawig ng AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) at Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) ang Microsoft agent stack; pinapangalanan ng Trail of Bits ang shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; bumababa ang Shadowserver day-ten exposed n8n sa ~5,700; nire-refresh ng CISA ang KEV bago ang Mayo 21 deadline.

bridges.text: Shadowserver day-nine n8n exposed instances drop to ~6,800 (44% unpatched) ahead of the CISA May 21 federal-civilian deadline; NHS England's five-CVE blocklist now functions as the de-facto allied reference, and Sysdig's 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction puts a measurable cost on absent secure-deployment guidance — the exact predicate set a CISA guide would consolidate.
