text_locales.ja: Shadowserverの9日目n8n曝露インスタンスはCISAの5月21日連邦民間期限に先立ち~6,800まで低下(44%未パッチ);NHS Englandの5-CVEブロックリストは今や事実上の同盟参照として機能し、Sysdigの19分中央認証情報抽出時間は安全デプロイメント・ガイダンス不在に測定可能なコストを置く — CISAガイドが統合する正にプレディケート・セット。
text_locales.es: Las instancias n8n expuestas del día nueve de Shadowserver caen a ~6,800 (44% sin parchar) antes de la fecha límite federal-civil del 21 de mayo de CISA; la blocklist de cinco CVE de NHS England ahora funciona como la referencia aliada de facto, y el tiempo mediano de 19 minutos a extracción de credenciales de Sysdig pone un costo medible sobre la guía ausente de despliegue seguro — el set predicado exacto que una guía de CISA consolidaría.
text_locales.fil: Bumababa ang day-nine n8n exposed instances ng Shadowserver sa ~6,800 (44% unpatched) bago ang CISA Mayo 21 federal-civilian deadline; gumagana na ngayon ang five-CVE blocklist ng NHS England bilang de-facto allied reference, at inilalagay ng 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction ng Sysdig ang measurable cost sa absent secure-deployment guidance — ang eksaktong predicate set na ico-consolidate ng CISA guide.

bridges.text: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.

text_locales.en: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.
text_locales.ja: 8日目のn8n KEVスキャンは、公開済みpre-1.121.0インスタンスを41.5%減少させ、REST webhookで4.8倍の悪用試行スパイクを記録する。CrewAI CVE-2026-44352(CVSS 8.7のデシリアライゼーションRCE)とHaystack CVE-2026-44391(CVSS 9.4のpath-traversalでAWSメタデータへピボット)は、LangGraphとLiteLLMの24時間後に着地する。NHS EnglandはNi8mareをそのagentic-AIワークフローブロックリストに名指しし、ノーコードハーネスのforcing functionを硬化させる。
text_locales.es: Los escaneos del dia ocho de la KEV de n8n reducen las instancias pre-1.121.0 expuestas en 41.5% con un spike de 4.8x en intentos de explotacion en REST webhooks, mientras que CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserializacion RCE) y Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivotando a AWS metadata) aterrizan 24 horas despues de LangGraph mas LiteLLM. NHS England nombra a Ni8mare en su blocklist de workflow agentic-AI, endureciendo el forcing function del no-code harness.
text_locales.fil: Ibinaba ng day-eight n8n KEV scans ang exposed pre-1.121.0 instances ng 41.5% na may 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike sa REST webhooks, habang ang CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal na pumapivot sa AWS metadata) ay lumalapag 24 oras matapos ang LangGraph plus LiteLLM. Pinapangalanan ng NHS England si Ni8mare sa kanilang agentic-AI workflow blocklist, pinatitigas ang no-code harness forcing function.

bridges.text: The n8n KEV addition with a May 21 federal deadline (first agentic-workflow CVE in the catalog), concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass with sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances 62% unpatched, and Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA crystallize exactly the operational case the CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (May 6) names — multi-vendor weekly cadence has displaced monthly.

text_locales.en: The n8n KEV addition with a May 21 federal deadline (first agentic-workflow CVE in the catalog), concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass with sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances 62% unpatched, and Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA crystallize exactly the operational case the CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (May 6) names — multi-vendor weekly cadence has displaced monthly.
text_locales.ja: n8nのKEV追加(カタログ初のエージェント型ワークフローCVE、5月21日連邦期限)、同時並行のLangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM認証バイパスで18時間未満のエクスプロイト発生、インターネット露出インスタンス約14,200(62%未パッチ)、Microsoft Defender MCPサーバー検出GAが、CISAセキュア配備ガイド予測(5月6日)が指す運用面の根拠を結晶化させた──マルチベンダー週次ケイデンスが月次を置き換えた。
text_locales.es: La adición de n8n al KEV con plazo federal del 21 de mayo (primer CVE de flujo de trabajo agéntico en el catálogo), el SSRF concurrente de LangGraph + bypass de autenticación de LiteLLM con explotación en menos de 18 horas, ~14.200 instancias expuestas a internet con 62% sin parchar, y la GA de detección de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender cristalizan exactamente el caso operativo que la predicción de la guía de despliegue seguro de CISA (6 de mayo) nombra — la cadencia semanal multi-proveedor ha desplazado a la mensual.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n KEV addition na may Mayo 21 federal deadline (unang agentic-workflow CVE sa catalog), ang concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass na may sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances na 62% unpatched, at ang Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA ay nagsa-crystallize ng eksaktong operational case na pinapangalanan ng CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (Mayo 6) — pinalitan na ng multi-vendor weekly cadence ang monthly.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).

nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence forces prefill/decode disaggregation out of the Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture and into the documented default serving mode shipped by vLLM and SGLang at the H100 and L40S tiers. The catalysts landing across a single weekend cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: vLLM v0.11.1 ships a disaggregated-prefill mode that, per Cloudflare Infire engineering's Saturday benchmark note, reaches parity with the production Infire edge architecture on prefill throughput at the H100 tier, with Infire retaining only a 1.4x advantage at the L40S edge tier on decode-side latency rather than the order-of-magnitude gap that previously kept disaggregation out of the open-source serving stack; the Yotta Labs benchmark refresh holds the canonical shared-prefix workload at approximately 14,650 tok/s on vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk, narrowing the throughput gap to a level where the architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) dominates the remaining delta; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ships a parallel architectural primitive in the form of RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse delivering a 2.1x speedup on tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, demonstrating that the radix-tree cache substrate generalizes from prefix sharing to tool-call result sharing; and Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up on SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus the v0.11.1 patch for the prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 disclosed Friday convert the security narrative from a blocker to a documented disclosure-timeline pattern. The structural force is that once Cloudflare Infire engineering publishes a benchmark showing parity at the H100 tier between its production edge architecture and an open-source serving stack's disaggregated mode, downstream framework maintainers can cite the production-comparable benchmark rather than ship monolithic-mode defaults, and the SGLang radix-tree cache substrate gives a parallel architectural lineage that converges on the same shape. The most likely shape is a disaggregated-prefill/decode mode added as the documented default in the vLLM v0.12 and SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, with per-tier deployment templates targeting H100 single-node and L40S edge-tier topology, plus a Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness gating the production-readiness claim. Sovereign-cloud and on-prem agentic-AI workloads adopt it first because the tool-result-cache reuse substrate compounds the latency win for long tool-call chains. Bear case is a competing serving-stack architecture refusing the disaggregation split and forking the benchmark methodology; absent that, Q4 2026 lands disaggregated prefill as the documented default across the open-source serving cohort.

description.ja: Q4 2026までに、5月9日のディスアグリゲート・プリフィル収束は、プリフィル/デコード・ディスアグリゲーションをCloudflare-Infire特有のエッジ・アーキテクチャから押し出し、vLLMとSGLangがH100およびL40S層で出荷する文書化されたデフォルト・サービング・モードへと移行させる。単一の週末サイクルで着地する触媒は具体的かつ相互強化的である: vLLM v0.11.1はディスアグリゲート・プリフィル・モードを出荷し、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングの土曜ベンチマーク・ノートによれば、H100層でのプリフィル・スループットにおいて本番Infireエッジ・アーキテクチャと同等水準に達し、Infireはデコード側レイテンシでL40Sエッジ層に1.4倍の優位を残すのみで、これまでディスアグリゲーションをオープンソース・サービング・スタックから遠ざけていた桁違いのギャップは解消された;Yotta Labsのベンチマーク・リフレッシュは、正準共有プレフィックス・ワークロードをvLLMで約14,650 tok/s、SGLang RadixArkで17,300 tok/sに維持し、スループット・ギャップを、残るデルタをアーキテクチャ選択(モノリシック対ディスアグリゲート)が支配する水準まで狭める;SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4は並行的なアーキテクチャ・プリミティブを、RadixAttention対応のツール結果キャッシュ再利用としてエージェンティック・ワークロードに対し2.1倍の高速化として出荷し、ラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤がプレフィックス共有からツールコール結果共有へと一般化することを実証する;そしてTrail of BitsのSGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567(CVSS 8.1の認証済みサーバーサイド・テンプレート・インジェクション)に対する完全レッドチーム・ライトアップに加え、金曜開示のプレフィックス・キャッシュ汚染CVE-2026-44512に対するv0.11.1パッチが、セキュリティ・ナラティブをブロッカーから文書化された開示タイムライン・パターンへと変える。構造的な力は、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングが本番エッジ・アーキテクチャとオープンソース・サービング・スタックのディスアグリゲート・モードの間でH100層でのパリティを示すベンチマークを公表するや否や、下流のフレームワーク・メンテナーは本番比較可能ベンチマークを引用でき、モノリシック・モードのデフォルトを出荷する必要はなくなり、SGLangのラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤が同じ形に収束する並行的なアーキテクチャ系譜を提供することである。最も可能性の高い形状は、vLLM v0.12およびSGLang RadixArk v0.6リリースラインに文書化されたデフォルトとして追加されるディスアグリゲート・プリフィル/デコード・モードで、H100単一ノードとL40Sエッジ層トポロジをターゲットとする層別デプロイ・テンプレートに加え、本番運用準備性の主張をゲートするYottaスタイルの正準ベンチマーク・ハーネスを伴う。ソブリン・クラウドおよびオンプレのエージェンティックAIワークロードが最初に採用するのは、ツール結果キャッシュ再利用基盤が長いツールコール・チェーンに対するレイテンシ改善を複利化するためである。ベア・ケースは競合するサービング・スタック・アーキテクチャがディスアグリゲーション分割を拒否してベンチマーク手法をフォークする;それ以外の場合、Q4 2026はディスアグリゲート・プリフィルをオープンソース・サービング・コホート全体の文書化されたデフォルトとして着地させる。
description.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia de prefill desagregado del 9 de mayo fuerza la desagregación de prefill/decode fuera de la arquitectura edge específica de Cloudflare Infire y hacia el modo de servicio predeterminado documentado enviado por vLLM y SGLang en los niveles H100 y L40S. Los catalizadores que aterrizan en un solo ciclo de fin de semana son concretos y mutuamente reforzantes: vLLM v0.11.1 envía un modo de prefill desagregado que, según la nota de benchmark del sábado de la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire, alcanza paridad con la arquitectura edge de producción de Infire en throughput de prefill en el nivel H100, con Infire reteniendo solo una ventaja de 1.4x en el nivel edge L40S en latencia del lado-decode en lugar de la brecha de orden-de-magnitud que previamente mantuvo la desagregación fuera del stack de servicio open-source; la actualización de benchmark de Yotta Labs mantiene la carga canónica de prefijo compartido en aproximadamente 14,650 tok/s en vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s en SGLang RadixArk, estrechando la brecha de throughput a un nivel donde la elección arquitectónica (monolítica vs desagregada) domina el delta restante; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 envía una primitiva arquitectónica paralela en forma de reutilización de cache de resultados de tool-call consciente de RadixAttention entregando una aceleración de 2.1x en cargas agentic intensivas en tool-calls, demostrando que el sustrato de cache radix-tree se generaliza desde compartir prefijos hasta compartir resultados de tool-call; y el write-up red-team completo de Trail of Bits sobre SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 inyección de plantilla server-side autenticada) más el parche v0.11.1 para el CVE-2026-44512 de envenenamiento de prefix-cache divulgado el viernes convierten la narrativa de seguridad de un bloqueador a un patrón documentado de cronograma de divulgación. La fuerza estructural es que una vez que la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire publica un benchmark mostrando paridad en el nivel H100 entre su arquitectura edge de producción y el modo desagregado de un stack de servicio open-source, los mantenedores de marcos descendentes pueden citar el benchmark comparable a producción en lugar de enviar predeterminados de modo monolítico, y el sustrato de cache radix-tree de SGLang da un linaje arquitectónico paralelo que converge en la misma forma. La forma más probable es un modo prefill/decode desagregado agregado como el predeterminado documentado en las líneas de release vLLM v0.12 y SGLang RadixArk v0.6, con plantillas de despliegue por-nivel apuntando a topología H100 single-node y edge L40S, más un harness canónico de benchmark estilo Yotta que sirva de gate para la afirmación de production-readiness. Las cargas sovereign-cloud y agentic-AI on-prem lo adoptan primero porque el sustrato de reutilización de cache de tool-result compone la victoria de latencia para cadenas largas de tool-call. El caso bajista es una arquitectura competidora de stack de servicio rechazando la división de desagregación y bifurcando la metodología de benchmark; en ausencia de eso, Q4 2026 aterriza el prefill desagregado como el predeterminado documentado a través de la cohorte de servicio open-source.
description.fil: Sa Q4 2026 ang May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence ay pumipilit sa prefill/decode disaggregation na lumabas mula sa Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture at pumasok sa documented default serving mode na nag-ship ng vLLM at SGLang sa H100 at L40S tiers. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang weekend cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang vLLM v0.11.1 ay nag-ship ng disaggregated-prefill mode na, ayon sa Saturday benchmark note ng Cloudflare Infire engineering, ay umaabot sa parity sa production Infire edge architecture sa prefill throughput sa H100 tier, na ang Infire ay nag-iingat lamang ng 1.4x advantage sa L40S edge tier sa decode-side latency imbis na order-of-magnitude gap na dati ay nagpapanatili sa disaggregation sa labas ng open-source serving stack; ang Yotta Labs benchmark refresh ay hinahawakan ang canonical shared-prefix workload sa humigit-kumulang 14,650 tok/s sa vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s sa SGLang RadixArk, na nagpapakitid sa throughput gap sa antas kung saan ang architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) ay nangingibabaw sa natitirang delta; ang SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ay nag-ship ng parallel architectural primitive sa anyo ng RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse na naghahatid ng 2.1x speedup sa tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, na nagpapakita na ang radix-tree cache substrate ay nag-ge-generalize mula sa prefix sharing papasok sa tool-call result sharing; at ang Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up sa SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus ang v0.11.1 patch para sa prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 na inilathala nitong Friday ay nagko-convert sa security narrative mula sa blocker papasok sa documented disclosure-timeline pattern. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang Cloudflare Infire engineering ay maglathala ng benchmark na nagpapakita ng parity sa H100 tier sa pagitan ng production edge architecture nito at disaggregated mode ng open-source serving stack, ang downstream framework maintainers ay pwedeng banggitin ang production-comparable benchmark imbis na mag-ship ng monolithic-mode defaults, at ang SGLang radix-tree cache substrate ay nagbibigay ng parallel architectural lineage na nagko-converge sa parehong shape. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang disaggregated-prefill/decode mode na idinaragdag bilang documented default sa vLLM v0.12 at SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, na may per-tier deployment templates na nakatutok sa H100 single-node at L40S edge-tier topology, plus isang Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness na nagga-gate sa production-readiness claim. Ang sovereign-cloud at on-prem agentic-AI workloads ang unang nag-aadopt nito dahil ang tool-result-cache reuse substrate ay nagko-compound sa latency win para sa mahahabang tool-call chains. Ang bear case ay isang competing serving-stack architecture na tumatangging tanggapin ang disaggregation split at nag-fo-fork ng benchmark methodology; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa disaggregated prefill bilang documented default sa buong open-source serving cohort.

summary.en: By Q4 2026 the May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence forces prefill/decode disaggregation out of the Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture and into the documented default serving mode shipped by vLLM and SGLang at the H100 and L40S tiers. The catalysts landing across a single weekend cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: vLLM v0.11.1 ships a disaggregated-prefill mode that, per Cloudflare Infire engineering's Saturday benchmark note, reaches parity with the production Infire edge architecture on prefill throughput at the H100 tier, with Infire retaining only a 1.4x advantage at the L40S edge tier on decode-side latency rather than the order-of-magnitude gap that previously kept disaggregation out of the open-source serving stack; the Yotta Labs benchmark refresh holds the canonical shared-prefix workload at approximately 14,650 tok/s on vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk, narrowing the throughput gap to a level where the architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) dominates the remaining delta; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ships a parallel architectural primitive in the form of RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse delivering a 2.1x speedup on tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, demonstrating that the radix-tree cache substrate generalizes from prefix sharing to tool-call result sharing; and Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up on SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus the v0.11.1 patch for the prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 disclosed Friday convert the security narrative from a blocker to a documented disclosure-timeline pattern. The structural force is that once Cloudflare Infire engineering publishes a benchmark showing parity at the H100 tier between its production edge architecture and an open-source serving stack's disaggregated mode, downstream framework maintainers can cite the production-comparable benchmark rather than ship monolithic-mode defaults, and the SGLang radix-tree cache substrate gives a parallel architectural lineage that converges on the same shape. The most likely shape is a disaggregated-prefill/decode mode added as the documented default in the vLLM v0.12 and SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, with per-tier deployment templates targeting H100 single-node and L40S edge-tier topology, plus a Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness gating the production-readiness claim. Sovereign-cloud and on-prem agentic-AI workloads adopt it first because the tool-result-cache reuse substrate compounds the latency win for long tool-call chains. Bear case is a competing serving-stack architecture refusing the disaggregation split and forking the benchmark methodology; absent that, Q4 2026 lands disaggregated prefill as the documented default across the open-source serving cohort.
summary.ja: Q4 2026までに、5月9日のディスアグリゲート・プリフィル収束は、プリフィル/デコード・ディスアグリゲーションをCloudflare-Infire特有のエッジ・アーキテクチャから押し出し、vLLMとSGLangがH100およびL40S層で出荷する文書化されたデフォルト・サービング・モードへと移行させる。単一の週末サイクルで着地する触媒は具体的かつ相互強化的である: vLLM v0.11.1はディスアグリゲート・プリフィル・モードを出荷し、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングの土曜ベンチマーク・ノートによれば、H100層でのプリフィル・スループットにおいて本番Infireエッジ・アーキテクチャと同等水準に達し、Infireはデコード側レイテンシでL40Sエッジ層に1.4倍の優位を残すのみで、これまでディスアグリゲーションをオープンソース・サービング・スタックから遠ざけていた桁違いのギャップは解消された;Yotta Labsのベンチマーク・リフレッシュは、正準共有プレフィックス・ワークロードをvLLMで約14,650 tok/s、SGLang RadixArkで17,300 tok/sに維持し、スループット・ギャップを、残るデルタをアーキテクチャ選択(モノリシック対ディスアグリゲート)が支配する水準まで狭める;SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4は並行的なアーキテクチャ・プリミティブを、RadixAttention対応のツール結果キャッシュ再利用としてエージェンティック・ワークロードに対し2.1倍の高速化として出荷し、ラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤がプレフィックス共有からツールコール結果共有へと一般化することを実証する;そしてTrail of BitsのSGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567(CVSS 8.1の認証済みサーバーサイド・テンプレート・インジェクション)に対する完全レッドチーム・ライトアップに加え、金曜開示のプレフィックス・キャッシュ汚染CVE-2026-44512に対するv0.11.1パッチが、セキュリティ・ナラティブをブロッカーから文書化された開示タイムライン・パターンへと変える。構造的な力は、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングが本番エッジ・アーキテクチャとオープンソース・サービング・スタックのディスアグリゲート・モードの間でH100層でのパリティを示すベンチマークを公表するや否や、下流のフレームワーク・メンテナーは本番比較可能ベンチマークを引用でき、モノリシック・モードのデフォルトを出荷する必要はなくなり、SGLangのラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤が同じ形に収束する並行的なアーキテクチャ系譜を提供することである。最も可能性の高い形状は、vLLM v0.12およびSGLang RadixArk v0.6リリースラインに文書化されたデフォルトとして追加されるディスアグリゲート・プリフィル/デコード・モードで、H100単一ノードとL40Sエッジ層トポロジをターゲットとする層別デプロイ・テンプレートに加え、本番運用準備性の主張をゲートするYottaスタイルの正準ベンチマーク・ハーネスを伴う。ソブリン・クラウドおよびオンプレのエージェンティックAIワークロードが最初に採用するのは、ツール結果キャッシュ再利用基盤が長いツールコール・チェーンに対するレイテンシ改善を複利化するためである。ベア・ケースは競合するサービング・スタック・アーキテクチャがディスアグリゲーション分割を拒否してベンチマーク手法をフォークする;それ以外の場合、Q4 2026はディスアグリゲート・プリフィルをオープンソース・サービング・コホート全体の文書化されたデフォルトとして着地させる。
summary.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia de prefill desagregado del 9 de mayo fuerza la desagregación de prefill/decode fuera de la arquitectura edge específica de Cloudflare Infire y hacia el modo de servicio predeterminado documentado enviado por vLLM y SGLang en los niveles H100 y L40S. Los catalizadores que aterrizan en un solo ciclo de fin de semana son concretos y mutuamente reforzantes: vLLM v0.11.1 envía un modo de prefill desagregado que, según la nota de benchmark del sábado de la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire, alcanza paridad con la arquitectura edge de producción de Infire en throughput de prefill en el nivel H100, con Infire reteniendo solo una ventaja de 1.4x en el nivel edge L40S en latencia del lado-decode en lugar de la brecha de orden-de-magnitud que previamente mantuvo la desagregación fuera del stack de servicio open-source; la actualización de benchmark de Yotta Labs mantiene la carga canónica de prefijo compartido en aproximadamente 14,650 tok/s en vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s en SGLang RadixArk, estrechando la brecha de throughput a un nivel donde la elección arquitectónica (monolítica vs desagregada) domina el delta restante; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 envía una primitiva arquitectónica paralela en forma de reutilización de cache de resultados de tool-call consciente de RadixAttention entregando una aceleración de 2.1x en cargas agentic intensivas en tool-calls, demostrando que el sustrato de cache radix-tree se generaliza desde compartir prefijos hasta compartir resultados de tool-call; y el write-up red-team completo de Trail of Bits sobre SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 inyección de plantilla server-side autenticada) más el parche v0.11.1 para el CVE-2026-44512 de envenenamiento de prefix-cache divulgado el viernes convierten la narrativa de seguridad de un bloqueador a un patrón documentado de cronograma de divulgación. La fuerza estructural es que una vez que la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire publica un benchmark mostrando paridad en el nivel H100 entre su arquitectura edge de producción y el modo desagregado de un stack de servicio open-source, los mantenedores de marcos descendentes pueden citar el benchmark comparable a producción en lugar de enviar predeterminados de modo monolítico, y el sustrato de cache radix-tree de SGLang da un linaje arquitectónico paralelo que converge en la misma forma. La forma más probable es un modo prefill/decode desagregado agregado como el predeterminado documentado en las líneas de release vLLM v0.12 y SGLang RadixArk v0.6, con plantillas de despliegue por-nivel apuntando a topología H100 single-node y edge L40S, más un harness canónico de benchmark estilo Yotta que sirva de gate para la afirmación de production-readiness. Las cargas sovereign-cloud y agentic-AI on-prem lo adoptan primero porque el sustrato de reutilización de cache de tool-result compone la victoria de latencia para cadenas largas de tool-call. El caso bajista es una arquitectura competidora de stack de servicio rechazando la división de desagregación y bifurcando la metodología de benchmark; en ausencia de eso, Q4 2026 aterriza el prefill desagregado como el predeterminado documentado a través de la cohorte de servicio open-source.
summary.fil: Sa Q4 2026 ang May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence ay pumipilit sa prefill/decode disaggregation na lumabas mula sa Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture at pumasok sa documented default serving mode na nag-ship ng vLLM at SGLang sa H100 at L40S tiers. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang weekend cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang vLLM v0.11.1 ay nag-ship ng disaggregated-prefill mode na, ayon sa Saturday benchmark note ng Cloudflare Infire engineering, ay umaabot sa parity sa production Infire edge architecture sa prefill throughput sa H100 tier, na ang Infire ay nag-iingat lamang ng 1.4x advantage sa L40S edge tier sa decode-side latency imbis na order-of-magnitude gap na dati ay nagpapanatili sa disaggregation sa labas ng open-source serving stack; ang Yotta Labs benchmark refresh ay hinahawakan ang canonical shared-prefix workload sa humigit-kumulang 14,650 tok/s sa vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s sa SGLang RadixArk, na nagpapakitid sa throughput gap sa antas kung saan ang architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) ay nangingibabaw sa natitirang delta; ang SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ay nag-ship ng parallel architectural primitive sa anyo ng RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse na naghahatid ng 2.1x speedup sa tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, na nagpapakita na ang radix-tree cache substrate ay nag-ge-generalize mula sa prefix sharing papasok sa tool-call result sharing; at ang Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up sa SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus ang v0.11.1 patch para sa prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 na inilathala nitong Friday ay nagko-convert sa security narrative mula sa blocker papasok sa documented disclosure-timeline pattern. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang Cloudflare Infire engineering ay maglathala ng benchmark na nagpapakita ng parity sa H100 tier sa pagitan ng production edge architecture nito at disaggregated mode ng open-source serving stack, ang downstream framework maintainers ay pwedeng banggitin ang production-comparable benchmark imbis na mag-ship ng monolithic-mode defaults, at ang SGLang radix-tree cache substrate ay nagbibigay ng parallel architectural lineage na nagko-converge sa parehong shape. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang disaggregated-prefill/decode mode na idinaragdag bilang documented default sa vLLM v0.12 at SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, na may per-tier deployment templates na nakatutok sa H100 single-node at L40S edge-tier topology, plus isang Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness na nagga-gate sa production-readiness claim. Ang sovereign-cloud at on-prem agentic-AI workloads ang unang nag-aadopt nito dahil ang tool-result-cache reuse substrate ay nagko-compound sa latency win para sa mahahabang tool-call chains. Ang bear case ay isang competing serving-stack architecture na tumatangging tanggapin ang disaggregation split at nag-fo-fork ng benchmark methodology; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa disaggregated prefill bilang documented default sa buong open-source serving cohort.

job_locales.fil: Palawakin ang May 9 Saturday benchmark note na nagpapakita ng vLLM v0.11.1 disaggregated-prefill parity sa H100 tier papasok sa sustained benchmark series na maaaring banggitin ng downstream framework maintainers kapag nag-ship ng disaggregated mode bilang documented default, kasama ng hayagang decode-side L40S edge-tier 1.4x advantage framing.

outcome_locales.en: Quarterly benchmark cadence comparing Cloudflare Infire production edge architecture against vLLM and SGLang RadixArk disaggregated modes at H100 and L40S tiers, with the Yotta-style canonical shared-prefix workload as the gating harness, cited by both vLLM v0.12 and SGLang v0.6 release notes.
outcome_locales.ja: Cloudflare Infire本番エッジ・アーキテクチャをvLLMとSGLang RadixArkディスアグリゲート・モードに対しH100とL40S層で比較する四半期ベンチマーク・ケイデンスで、Yottaスタイルの正準共有プレフィックス・ワークロードをゲーティング・ハーネスとし、vLLM v0.12とSGLang v0.6リリース・ノートの両方で引用される。
outcome_locales.es: Cadencia trimestral de benchmark comparando la arquitectura edge de producción de Cloudflare Infire contra los modos desagregados de vLLM y SGLang RadixArk en niveles H100 y L40S, con la carga canónica de prefijo compartido estilo Yotta como el harness de gate, citada tanto por las notas de release vLLM v0.12 como SGLang v0.6.
outcome_locales.fil: Quarterly benchmark cadence na nagko-compare sa Cloudflare Infire production edge architecture laban sa vLLM at SGLang RadixArk disaggregated modes sa H100 at L40S tiers, kasama ang Yotta-style canonical shared-prefix workload bilang gating harness, na binanggit ng parehong vLLM v0.12 at SGLang v0.6 release notes.

motivation_locales.en: Without ongoing production-comparable benchmark evidence the Saturday convergence reads as a one-shot anecdote; a sustained series converts it into a documented disclosure pattern that pressures every open-source serving stack to ship the disaggregated split rather than defend monolithic defaults.
motivation_locales.ja: 継続的な本番比較可能ベンチマーク証拠がなければ、土曜の収束は一発のアネクドートとして読まれる;持続的シリーズはそれを文書化された開示パターンへ変換し、すべてのオープンソース・サービング・スタックにモノリシック・デフォルトを守るのではなくディスアグリゲート分割を出荷することを圧力する。
motivation_locales.es: Sin evidencia continua de benchmark comparable a producción la convergencia del sábado se lee como una anécdota de un solo disparo; una serie sostenida la convierte en un patrón de divulgación documentado que presiona a cada stack de servicio open-source a enviar la división desagregada en lugar de defender los predeterminados monolíticos.
motivation_locales.fil: Kung walang patuloy na production-comparable benchmark evidence, ang Saturday convergence ay binabasa bilang one-shot anecdote; ang sustained series ay nagko-convert nito papasok sa documented disclosure pattern na nagpipilit sa bawat open-source serving stack na mag-ship ng disaggregated split imbis na ipagtanggol ang monolithic defaults.

motivation_locales.en: The 14.65k vs 17.3k tok/s gap is already inside the architectural-choice band; if vLLM's v0.12 disaggregated default ships first without SGLang's parallel radix lineage as a peer, the sovereign-cloud and agentic-AI cohort defaults to vLLM and the radix-tree substrate loses its narrative.

motivation_locales.es: La brecha de 14.65k vs 17.3k tok/s ya está dentro de la banda de elección-arquitectónica; si el predeterminado desagregado v0.12 de vLLM se envía primero sin el linaje radix paralelo de SGLang como par, la cohorte sovereign-cloud y agentic-AI predetermina a vLLM y el sustrato radix-tree pierde su narrativa.

detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence forces prefill/decode disaggregation out of the Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture and into the documented default serving mode shipped by vLLM and SGLang at the H100 and L40S tiers. The catalysts landing across a single weekend cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: vLLM v0.11.1 ships a disaggregated-prefill mode that, per Cloudflare Infire engineering's Saturday benchmark note, reaches parity with the production Infire edge architecture on prefill throughput at the H100 tier, with Infire retaining only a 1.4x advantage at the L40S edge tier on decode-side latency rather than the order-of-magnitude gap that previously kept disaggregation out of the open-source serving stack; the Yotta Labs benchmark refresh holds the canonical shared-prefix workload at approximately 14,650 tok/s on vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk, narrowing the throughput gap to a level where the architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) dominates the remaining delta; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ships a parallel architectural primitive in the form of RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse delivering a 2.1x speedup on tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, demonstrating that the radix-tree cache substrate generalizes from prefix sharing to tool-call result sharing; and Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up on SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus the v0.11.1 patch for the prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 disclosed Friday convert the security narrative from a blocker to a documented disclosure-timeline pattern. The structural force is that once Cloudflare Infire engineering publishes a benchmark showing parity at the H100 tier between its production edge architecture and an open-source serving stack's disaggregated mode, downstream framework maintainers can cite the production-comparable benchmark rather than ship monolithic-mode defaults, and the SGLang radix-tree cache substrate gives a parallel architectural lineage that converges on the same shape. The most likely shape is a disaggregated-prefill/decode mode added as the documented default in the vLLM v0.12 and SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, with per-tier deployment templates targeting H100 single-node and L40S edge-tier topology, plus a Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness gating the production-readiness claim. Sovereign-cloud and on-prem agentic-AI workloads adopt it first because the tool-result-cache reuse substrate compounds the latency win for long tool-call chains. Bear case is a competing serving-stack architecture refusing the disaggregation split and forking the benchmark methodology; absent that, Q4 2026 lands disaggregated prefill as the documented default across the open-source serving cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Q4 2026までに、5月9日のディスアグリゲート・プリフィル収束は、プリフィル/デコード・ディスアグリゲーションをCloudflare-Infire特有のエッジ・アーキテクチャから押し出し、vLLMとSGLangがH100およびL40S層で出荷する文書化されたデフォルト・サービング・モードへと移行させる。単一の週末サイクルで着地する触媒は具体的かつ相互強化的である: vLLM v0.11.1はディスアグリゲート・プリフィル・モードを出荷し、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングの土曜ベンチマーク・ノートによれば、H100層でのプリフィル・スループットにおいて本番Infireエッジ・アーキテクチャと同等水準に達し、Infireはデコード側レイテンシでL40Sエッジ層に1.4倍の優位を残すのみで、これまでディスアグリゲーションをオープンソース・サービング・スタックから遠ざけていた桁違いのギャップは解消された;Yotta Labsのベンチマーク・リフレッシュは、正準共有プレフィックス・ワークロードをvLLMで約14,650 tok/s、SGLang RadixArkで17,300 tok/sに維持し、スループット・ギャップを、残るデルタをアーキテクチャ選択(モノリシック対ディスアグリゲート)が支配する水準まで狭める;SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4は並行的なアーキテクチャ・プリミティブを、RadixAttention対応のツール結果キャッシュ再利用としてエージェンティック・ワークロードに対し2.1倍の高速化として出荷し、ラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤がプレフィックス共有からツールコール結果共有へと一般化することを実証する;そしてTrail of BitsのSGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567(CVSS 8.1の認証済みサーバーサイド・テンプレート・インジェクション)に対する完全レッドチーム・ライトアップに加え、金曜開示のプレフィックス・キャッシュ汚染CVE-2026-44512に対するv0.11.1パッチが、セキュリティ・ナラティブをブロッカーから文書化された開示タイムライン・パターンへと変える。構造的な力は、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングが本番エッジ・アーキテクチャとオープンソース・サービング・スタックのディスアグリゲート・モードの間でH100層でのパリティを示すベンチマークを公表するや否や、下流のフレームワーク・メンテナーは本番比較可能ベンチマークを引用でき、モノリシック・モードのデフォルトを出荷する必要はなくなり、SGLangのラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤が同じ形に収束する並行的なアーキテクチャ系譜を提供することである。最も可能性の高い形状は、vLLM v0.12およびSGLang RadixArk v0.6リリースラインに文書化されたデフォルトとして追加されるディスアグリゲート・プリフィル/デコード・モードで、H100単一ノードとL40Sエッジ層トポロジをターゲットとする層別デプロイ・テンプレートに加え、本番運用準備性の主張をゲートするYottaスタイルの正準ベンチマーク・ハーネスを伴う。ソブリン・クラウドおよびオンプレのエージェンティックAIワークロードが最初に採用するのは、ツール結果キャッシュ再利用基盤が長いツールコール・チェーンに対するレイテンシ改善を複利化するためである。ベア・ケースは競合するサービング・スタック・アーキテクチャがディスアグリゲーション分割を拒否してベンチマーク手法をフォークする;それ以外の場合、Q4 2026はディスアグリゲート・プリフィルをオープンソース・サービング・コホート全体の文書化されたデフォルトとして着地させる。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia de prefill desagregado del 9 de mayo fuerza la desagregación de prefill/decode fuera de la arquitectura edge específica de Cloudflare Infire y hacia el modo de servicio predeterminado documentado enviado por vLLM y SGLang en los niveles H100 y L40S. Los catalizadores que aterrizan en un solo ciclo de fin de semana son concretos y mutuamente reforzantes: vLLM v0.11.1 envía un modo de prefill desagregado que, según la nota de benchmark del sábado de la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire, alcanza paridad con la arquitectura edge de producción de Infire en throughput de prefill en el nivel H100, con Infire reteniendo solo una ventaja de 1.4x en el nivel edge L40S en latencia del lado-decode en lugar de la brecha de orden-de-magnitud que previamente mantuvo la desagregación fuera del stack de servicio open-source; la actualización de benchmark de Yotta Labs mantiene la carga canónica de prefijo compartido en aproximadamente 14,650 tok/s en vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s en SGLang RadixArk, estrechando la brecha de throughput a un nivel donde la elección arquitectónica (monolítica vs desagregada) domina el delta restante; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 envía una primitiva arquitectónica paralela en forma de reutilización de cache de resultados de tool-call consciente de RadixAttention entregando una aceleración de 2.1x en cargas agentic intensivas en tool-calls, demostrando que el sustrato de cache radix-tree se generaliza desde compartir prefijos hasta compartir resultados de tool-call; y el write-up red-team completo de Trail of Bits sobre SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 inyección de plantilla server-side autenticada) más el parche v0.11.1 para el CVE-2026-44512 de envenenamiento de prefix-cache divulgado el viernes convierten la narrativa de seguridad de un bloqueador a un patrón documentado de cronograma de divulgación. La fuerza estructural es que una vez que la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire publica un benchmark mostrando paridad en el nivel H100 entre su arquitectura edge de producción y el modo desagregado de un stack de servicio open-source, los mantenedores de marcos descendentes pueden citar el benchmark comparable a producción en lugar de enviar predeterminados de modo monolítico, y el sustrato de cache radix-tree de SGLang da un linaje arquitectónico paralelo que converge en la misma forma. La forma más probable es un modo prefill/decode desagregado agregado como el predeterminado documentado en las líneas de release vLLM v0.12 y SGLang RadixArk v0.6, con plantillas de despliegue por-nivel apuntando a topología H100 single-node y edge L40S, más un harness canónico de benchmark estilo Yotta que sirva de gate para la afirmación de production-readiness. Las cargas sovereign-cloud y agentic-AI on-prem lo adoptan primero porque el sustrato de reutilización de cache de tool-result compone la victoria de latencia para cadenas largas de tool-call. El caso bajista es una arquitectura competidora de stack de servicio rechazando la división de desagregación y bifurcando la metodología de benchmark; en ausencia de eso, Q4 2026 aterriza el prefill desagregado como el predeterminado documentado a través de la cohorte de servicio open-source.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Sa Q4 2026 ang May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence ay pumipilit sa prefill/decode disaggregation na lumabas mula sa Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture at pumasok sa documented default serving mode na nag-ship ng vLLM at SGLang sa H100 at L40S tiers. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang weekend cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang vLLM v0.11.1 ay nag-ship ng disaggregated-prefill mode na, ayon sa Saturday benchmark note ng Cloudflare Infire engineering, ay umaabot sa parity sa production Infire edge architecture sa prefill throughput sa H100 tier, na ang Infire ay nag-iingat lamang ng 1.4x advantage sa L40S edge tier sa decode-side latency imbis na order-of-magnitude gap na dati ay nagpapanatili sa disaggregation sa labas ng open-source serving stack; ang Yotta Labs benchmark refresh ay hinahawakan ang canonical shared-prefix workload sa humigit-kumulang 14,650 tok/s sa vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s sa SGLang RadixArk, na nagpapakitid sa throughput gap sa antas kung saan ang architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) ay nangingibabaw sa natitirang delta; ang SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ay nag-ship ng parallel architectural primitive sa anyo ng RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse na naghahatid ng 2.1x speedup sa tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, na nagpapakita na ang radix-tree cache substrate ay nag-ge-generalize mula sa prefix sharing papasok sa tool-call result sharing; at ang Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up sa SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus ang v0.11.1 patch para sa prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 na inilathala nitong Friday ay nagko-convert sa security narrative mula sa blocker papasok sa documented disclosure-timeline pattern. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang Cloudflare Infire engineering ay maglathala ng benchmark na nagpapakita ng parity sa H100 tier sa pagitan ng production edge architecture nito at disaggregated mode ng open-source serving stack, ang downstream framework maintainers ay pwedeng banggitin ang production-comparable benchmark imbis na mag-ship ng monolithic-mode defaults, at ang SGLang radix-tree cache substrate ay nagbibigay ng parallel architectural lineage na nagko-converge sa parehong shape. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang disaggregated-prefill/decode mode na idinaragdag bilang documented default sa vLLM v0.12 at SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, na may per-tier deployment templates na nakatutok sa H100 single-node at L40S edge-tier topology, plus isang Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness na nagga-gate sa production-readiness claim. Ang sovereign-cloud at on-prem agentic-AI workloads ang unang nag-aadopt nito dahil ang tool-result-cache reuse substrate ay nagko-compound sa latency win para sa mahahabang tool-call chains. Ang bear case ay isang competing serving-stack architecture na tumatangging tanggapin ang disaggregation split at nag-fo-fork ng benchmark methodology; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa disaggregated prefill bilang documented default sa buong open-source serving cohort.

description.en: **"Training-vs-inference SKU split" becomes the standard for custom AI silicon.** Google's TPU 8t / 8i split extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia line and locks in **hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference**. In H2 2026 / H1 2027, expect Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy — opposing NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin's "single architecture, both workloads." Inference-tuned SKUs assume native FP4 / MXFP4 and drive **$/query competition** to a peak in Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「学習用 vs 推論用のSKU分割」がカスタムAIシリコンの標準仕様になる。** GoogleのTPU 8t / 8i分割は、Trainium-Inferentiaのラインを延伸し、**ハイパースケーラの内製シリコンを学習用と推論用でアーキテクチャ的に分離**することを定着させる。2026年H2 / 2027年H1にかけて、Microsoft MAIAとMeta MTIAも同様のデュアルトラックSKU戦略を採用すると見込まれる — NVIDIA BlackwellやVera Rubinの「単一アーキテクチャで両ワークロード」路線と対立する形になる。推論向けにチューニングされたSKUはネイティブFP4 / MXFP4を前提とし、**$/queryの競争**を2026年Q3にピークへ押し上げる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La "separacion de SKU entrenamiento-vs-inferencia" se convierte en el estandar para silicio AI personalizado.** La division TPU 8t / 8i de Google extiende la linea Trainium-vs-Inferentia y consolida el **silicio interno de los hyperscalers como arquitectonicamente separado para entrenamiento vs inferencia**. En H2 2026 / H1 2027, se espera que Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA adopten la misma estrategia de SKU dual — oponiendose a la "arquitectura unica, ambas cargas de trabajo" de NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Los SKU optimizados para inferencia asumen FP4 / MXFP4 nativo e impulsan la **competencia de $/consulta** a un pico en Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "Training-vs-inference SKU split" ay nagiging pamantayan para sa custom AI silicon.** Ang TPU 8t / 8i split ng Google ay nag-eextend sa Trainium-vs-Inferentia line at nag-lo-lock in sa **hyperscaler in-house silicon bilang architecturally separate para sa training vs inference**. Sa H2 2026 / H1 2027, asahan na ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA ay magtitibay ng parehong dual-track SKU strategy — laban sa "single architecture, both workloads" ng NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Ang inference-tuned SKUs ay nag-aassume ng native FP4 / MXFP4 at nagtutulak ng **$/query competition** sa peak sa Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

detail.summary_short: Google's TPU 8t / 8i announcement extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia split and codifies hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference. By H2 2026 / H1 2027, Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA are expected to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy, with inference SKUs driving $/query competition to a peak.

summary_short_locales.en: Google's TPU 8t / 8i announcement extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia split and codifies hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference. By H2 2026 / H1 2027, Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA are expected to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy, with inference SKUs driving $/query competition to a peak.
summary_short_locales.ja: GoogleのTPU 8t / 8i発表はTrainium-Inferentia型の分割を延伸し、ハイパースケーラの内製シリコンを学習用と推論用でアーキテクチャ的に分離することを定式化する。2026年H2 / 2027年H1までに、Microsoft MAIAとMeta MTIAも同じデュアルトラックSKU戦略を採用すると見込まれ、推論SKUが$/query競争をピークへ押し上げる。
summary_short_locales.es: El anuncio TPU 8t / 8i de Google extiende la division Trainium-vs-Inferentia y codifica el silicio interno de los hyperscalers como arquitectonicamente separado para entrenamiento vs inferencia. Para H2 2026 / H1 2027, se espera que Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA adopten la misma estrategia de SKU dual, con SKU de inferencia llevando la competencia de $/consulta a un pico.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang anunsyo ng TPU 8t / 8i ng Google ay nag-eextend sa Trainium-vs-Inferentia split at nag-cocodify ng hyperscaler in-house silicon bilang architecturally separate para sa training vs inference. Sa pamamagitan ng H2 2026 / H1 2027, ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA ay inaasahang magtitibay ng parehong dual-track SKU strategy, kung saan ang inference SKUs ay nagtutulak ng $/query competition sa peak.

bridges.text: AWS's Apr 27 roundup deepens the Trainium silicon-level co-engineering with Anthropic and Meta-Graviton CPU at scale, reinforcing that hyperscalers continue to architect inference-class silicon distinct from training-class accelerators. The precondition that custom AI silicon splits cleanly along workload lines holds with fresh partnership detail rather than a new tape-out.

text_locales.en: AWS's Apr 27 roundup deepens the Trainium silicon-level co-engineering with Anthropic and Meta-Graviton CPU at scale, reinforcing that hyperscalers continue to architect inference-class silicon distinct from training-class accelerators. The precondition that custom AI silicon splits cleanly along workload lines holds with fresh partnership detail rather than a new tape-out.
text_locales.ja: AWSの4月27日ラウンドアップは、AnthropicとのTrainiumシリコンレベル協調エンジニアリングとMeta-Gravitonの大規模CPUを深化させ、ハイパースケーラーがトレーニング級アクセラレータとは別個に推論級シリコンを設計し続けていることを補強している。カスタムAIシリコンがワークロード・ラインに沿って明確に分かれるという前提条件は、新しいテープアウトではなく新鮮なパートナーシップの詳細とともに維持されている。
text_locales.es: El roundup del 27 de abril de AWS profundiza la co-ingenieria a nivel de silicio Trainium con Anthropic y Meta-Graviton CPU a escala, reforzando que los hyperscalers continuan arquitecturando silicio inference-class distinto de aceleradores training-class. La precondicion de que el silicio personalizado de IA se divide limpiamente por lineas de workload se mantiene con detalle fresco de partnership en lugar de un nuevo tape-out.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 27 roundup ng AWS ay pinapalalim ang Trainium silicon-level co-engineering kasama ang Anthropic at Meta-Graviton CPU sa scale, na nagpapatibay na ang hyperscalers ay patuloy na nag-aarchitect ng inference-class silicon na hiwalay sa training-class accelerators. Ang precondition na ang custom AI silicon ay naghahati nang malinis sa workload lines ay nananatili na may sariwang partnership detail sa halip na bagong tape-out.

bridges.text: AWS doubling down on Trainium for training and Graviton for CPU-heavy agentic workloads reinforces the structural force the prediction names — hyperscaler in-house silicon is the differentiation layer, with workload-specialized SKUs increasingly the operative shape.

text_locales.en: AWS doubling down on Trainium for training and Graviton for CPU-heavy agentic workloads reinforces the structural force the prediction names — hyperscaler in-house silicon is the differentiation layer, with workload-specialized SKUs increasingly the operative shape.
text_locales.ja: AWS がトレーニングに Trainium、CPU 重めのエージェンティック ワークロードに Graviton を二重に賭けていくことは、予測が指す構造的力を補強する — ハイパースケーラの自社シリコンが差別化レイヤーであり、ワークロード特化型 SKU が次第にその作動的形状となっている。
text_locales.es: AWS redoblando con Trainium para entrenamiento y Graviton para cargas agentic intensivas en CPU refuerza la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra — el silicio interno del hyperscaler es la capa de diferenciación, con SKUs especializados por carga de trabajo cada vez más como la forma operativa.
text_locales.fil: Ang AWS na nagdo-doble down sa Trainium para sa training at Graviton para sa CPU-heavy agentic workloads ay pinatatatag ang structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction — ang in-house silicon ng hyperscaler ang differentiation layer, kasama ang workload-specialized SKUs na lalong nagiging operative shape.

text_locales.fil: Ang IPO filing ng Cerebras ay tumutukoy sa inference-tier specialization ngunit hindi direktang humihipo sa training-vs-inference SKU split sa loob ng hyperscaler in-house silicon roadmap na sinasaklaw ng prediction.

text_locales.en: GPT-5.5's API pricing 2x GPT-5.4 with Codex's 40% output-token reduction sharpens the inference $/query axis, while Anthropic-AWS's 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 simultaneous-run shape locks the training-side dual-track silicon, keeping the structural split intact even as Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.
text_locales.ja: GPT-5.5のAPI価格がGPT-5.4の2倍となりCodexの40%出力トークン削減で推論$/クエリ軸が鋭くなる一方、Anthropic-AWSの5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3同時稼働の形が学習側のデュアルトラック・シリコンをロックし、Microsoft MAIAとMeta MTIAのデュアルSKU発表が保留中であっても構造的分割が無傷のままである。
text_locales.es: El precio API de GPT-5.5 a 2x GPT-5.4 con la reducción del 40% de tokens de output de Codex agudiza el eje $/consulta de inferencia, mientras la forma de corrida simultánea de Anthropic-AWS de 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 bloquea el silicio de doble pista del lado de entrenamiento, manteniendo la división estructural intacta incluso mientras los anuncios de doble SKU de Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang API pricing ng GPT-5.5 na 2x GPT-5.4 kasama ang 40% output-token reduction ng Codex ay nagpapatibay sa inference $/query axis, habang ang 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 simultaneous-run shape ng Anthropic-AWS ay nagla-lock sa training-side dual-track silicon, na pinananatiling buo ang structural split kahit pa nakabinbin pa ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA dual-SKU announcements.

text_locales.en: Google Cloud Next '26 Day 3 emphasizing TPU 8i inference-optimization (1,152 TPUs, 3x SRAM) reinforces the dual-track SKU split, while NVIDIA Vera Rubin's 6-chip + Groq 3 LPU single-architecture stack hitting mass production sharpens the structural contrast, keeping the underlying market split intact even as MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.
text_locales.ja: Google Cloud Next '26のDay 3がTPU 8iの推論最適化(1,152 TPU、SRAM 3倍)を強調することがデュアルトラックSKU分裂を補強し、NVIDIA Vera Rubinの6チップ + Groq 3 LPUシングル・アーキテクチャ・スタックが量産入りすることが構造的対比をシャープにし、MAIA / MTIAのデュアルSKU発表が保留中であっても、根底にある市場分裂は無傷のまま保たれている。
text_locales.es: Google Cloud Next '26 Día 3 enfatizando la optimización de inferencia TPU 8i (1,152 TPUs, SRAM 3x) refuerza la división dual-track SKU, mientras que el stack de 6 chips + Groq 3 LPU de arquitectura única de NVIDIA Vera Rubin alcanzando producción en masa agudiza el contraste estructural, manteniendo intacta la división subyacente del mercado incluso mientras los anuncios de SKU dual MAIA / MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang Google Cloud Next '26 Day 3 na nagdidiin sa TPU 8i inference-optimization (1,152 TPUs, 3x SRAM) ay nagpapatibay sa dual-track SKU split, habang ang NVIDIA Vera Rubin's 6-chip + Groq 3 LPU single-architecture stack na umaabot sa mass production ay pinatatalas ang structural contrast, na pinapanatili ang underlying market split kahit ang MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements ay nananatiling pending.

bridges.text: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform shipping a 7-chip single-architecture stack into mass production sharpens the structural contrast that the prediction draws — hyperscaler dual-track SKU on one side, NVIDIA single-architecture on the other — while keeping the underlying market split intact, even as MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.

text_locales.en: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform shipping a 7-chip single-architecture stack into mass production sharpens the structural contrast that the prediction draws — hyperscaler dual-track SKU on one side, NVIDIA single-architecture on the other — while keeping the underlying market split intact, even as MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.
text_locales.ja: NVIDIAのVera Rubinプラットフォームが7チップ単一アーキテクチャスタックを量産にリリースしていることは、予測が描く構造的対比を鮮明にしている ― 一方ではハイパースケーラーのデュアルトラックSKU、他方ではNVIDIAの単一アーキテクチャ ― MAIA / MTIAデュアルSKUの発表が保留中であっても、根本的な市場分裂は維持されている。
text_locales.es: La plataforma Vera Rubin de NVIDIA enviando un stack de 7 chips de arquitectura única a producción en masa agudiza el contraste estructural que dibuja la predicción — SKU dual-track de hyperscaler en un lado, arquitectura única de NVIDIA en el otro — manteniendo intacta la división subyacente del mercado, incluso mientras los anuncios de SKU dual MAIA / MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang Vera Rubin platform ng NVIDIA na nagpapadala ng 7-chip single-architecture stack sa mass production ay nagpapatalas sa structural contrast na binubuod ng prediction — hyperscaler dual-track SKU sa isang panig, NVIDIA single-architecture sa kabilang panig — habang pinapanatili ang underlying market split, kahit na ang MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements ay nakabinbin pa.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: **"Training-vs-inference SKU split" becomes the standard for custom AI silicon.** Google's TPU 8t / 8i split extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia line and locks in **hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference**. In H2 2026 / H1 2027, expect Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy — opposing NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin's "single architecture, both workloads." Inference-tuned SKUs assume native FP4 / MXFP4 and drive **$/query competition** to a peak in Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

In H2 2026 / H1 2027, expect Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy — opposing NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin's "single architecture, both workloads." Inference-tuned SKUs assume native FP4 / MXFP4 and drive **$/query competition** to a peak in Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.ja: **「学習用 vs 推論用のSKU分割」がカスタムAIシリコンの標準仕様になる。** GoogleのTPU 8t / 8i分割は、Trainium-Inferentiaのラインを延伸し、**ハイパースケーラの内製シリコンを学習用と推論用でアーキテクチャ的に分離**することを定着させる。2026年H2 / 2027年H1にかけて、Microsoft MAIAとMeta MTIAも同様のデュアルトラックSKU戦略を採用すると見込まれる — NVIDIA BlackwellやVera Rubinの「単一アーキテクチャで両ワークロード」路線と対立する形になる。推論向けにチューニングされたSKUはネイティブFP4 / MXFP4を前提とし、**$/queryの競争**を2026年Q3にピークへ押し上げる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **La "separacion de SKU entrenamiento-vs-inferencia" se convierte en el estandar para silicio AI personalizado.** La division TPU 8t / 8i de Google extiende la linea Trainium-vs-Inferentia y consolida el **silicio interno de los hyperscalers como arquitectonicamente separado para entrenamiento vs inferencia**. En H2 2026 / H1 2027, se espera que Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA adopten la misma estrategia de SKU dual — oponiendose a la "arquitectura unica, ambas cargas de trabajo" de NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Los SKU optimizados para inferencia asumen FP4 / MXFP4 nativo e impulsan la **competencia de $/consulta** a un pico en Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang "Training-vs-inference SKU split" ay nagiging pamantayan para sa custom AI silicon.** Ang TPU 8t / 8i split ng Google ay nag-eextend sa Trainium-vs-Inferentia line at nag-lo-lock in sa **hyperscaler in-house silicon bilang architecturally separate para sa training vs inference**. Sa H2 2026 / H1 2027, asahan na ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA ay magtitibay ng parehong dual-track SKU strategy — laban sa "single architecture, both workloads" ng NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Ang inference-tuned SKUs ay nag-aassume ng native FP4 / MXFP4 at nagtutulak ng **$/query competition** sa peak sa Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.description: **Capital markets reset their valuation of "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" inside Q2 2026.** ServiceNow's **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** on Apr 23, IBM's same-day decline, and the chained falls of Salesforce / Workday / Oracle reveal a shift in how capital markets weigh "AI cost-savings benefit" vs "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Inside Q2 2026, expect Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports to make the "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis explicit, and market-cap math to move from "seats × ARPU" to "share of API calls touched by agents." Lagging analyst consensus updates mean another 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) likely see 15%+ drops in the next two quarters. description.ja: **資本市場はQ2 2026中に「AIエージェントに置換される企業向けSaaS」のバリュエーションをリセットする。** 4月23日のServiceNowの**-18%(史上最悪の単日下落)**、IBMの同日下落、Salesforce / Workday / Oracleの連鎖的な下落は、資本市場が「AIによるコスト削減効果」と「AIによるレガシー・ワークフローSaaSの置換」をどう天秤にかけるかが転換したことを示している。Q2 2026中に、Gartner / Forresterのマジック・クアドラント / ウェーブ・レポートが「Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS」軸を明示し、時価総額の計算式は「シート数 × ARPU」から「エージェントが触れるAPIコールのシェア」へと移行すると予想される。アナリスト・コンセンサスの更新が遅れるため、今後2四半期でさらに3-5社(Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheetなど)が15%以上の下落を見せる可能性が高い。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los mercados de capitales restablecen su valoración del "SaaS empresarial desplazado por agentes de IA" dentro del Q2 2026.** El **-18% (peor caída en un solo día de la historia)** de ServiceNow el 23 de abril, el declive de IBM el mismo día, y las caídas encadenadas de Salesforce / Workday / Oracle revelan un cambio en cómo los mercados de capitales sopesan el "beneficio de ahorro de costos por IA" frente al "desplazamiento por IA del SaaS de workflow legacy". Dentro del Q2 2026, se espera que los reportes Magic Quadrant / Wave de Gartner / Forrester hagan explícito el eje "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS", y que la matemática de capitalización de mercado pase de "asientos × ARPU" a "cuota de llamadas a API tocadas por agentes". Las actualizaciones rezagadas del consenso de analistas significan que probablemente otros 3-5 nombres (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) verán caídas del 15%+ en los próximos dos trimestres. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Iri-reset ng capital markets ang valuation nila ng "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" sa loob ng Q2 2026.** Ang **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** ng ServiceNow noong Apr 23, ang same-day decline ng IBM, at ang chained falls ng Salesforce / Workday / Oracle ay naghahayag ng pagbabago kung paano tinitimbang ng capital markets ang "AI cost-savings benefit" laban sa "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Sa loob ng Q2 2026, asahan ang Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports na gawing explicit ang "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis, at ang market-cap math na lumipat mula sa "seats × ARPU" papunta sa "share of API calls touched by agents." Ang lagging analyst consensus updates ay nangangahulugan na isa pang 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) ay malamang na makikita ng 15%+ drops sa susunod na dalawang quarter. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

summary.en: **Capital markets reset their valuation of "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" inside Q2 2026.** ServiceNow's **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** on Apr 23, IBM's same-day decline, and the chained falls of Salesforce / Workday / Oracle reveal a shift in how capital markets weigh "AI cost-savings benefit" vs "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Inside Q2 2026, expect Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports to make the "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis explicit, and market-cap math to move from "seats × ARPU" to "share of API calls touched by agents." Lagging analyst consensus updates mean another 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) likely see 15%+ drops in the next two quarters. text_locales.es: El cierre del 24 de abril de Motley Fool fijando a NVIDIA en $5.12T más la impresión +24% mejor-desde-1987 de Intel y AMD MTD +45% / iShares Semiconductor ETF +40.4% de IndexBox materializan la re-calificación de capital alrededor de la infraestructura de IA que ancla el eje de desplazamiento de agente que la predicción proyecta en el mismo ciclo de ganancias.
text_locales.fil: Ang Motley Fool's Apr 24 close na nagpa-pin sa NVIDIA sa $5.12T plus ang Intel's +24% best-since-1987 print at ang IndexBox's AMD MTD +45% / iShares Semiconductor ETF +40.4% ay nagma-materialize sa capital re-rating sa paligid ng AI infrastructure na nag-aanchor sa agent-displacement axis na pinagpapalagay ng prediction sa parehong earnings cycle.

bridges.text: The 24/7 Wall St contrast between Salesforce's FY2026 $41.5B revenue with Agentforce ARR $800M and 29,000 deals (+50% QoQ) and ServiceNow's prior worst-ever -18% drop sharpens the Agent-native vs Legacy split as accelerate-vs-decline, materializing the displacement axis the prediction projects in the same earnings cycle.

text_locales.en: The 24/7 Wall St contrast between Salesforce's FY2026 $41.5B revenue with Agentforce ARR $800M and 29,000 deals (+50% QoQ) and ServiceNow's prior worst-ever -18% drop sharpens the Agent-native vs Legacy split as accelerate-vs-decline, materializing the displacement axis the prediction projects in the same earnings cycle.
text_locales.ja: 24/7 Wall StのSalesforceのFY2026 $41.5B収益とAgentforce ARR $800Mおよび29,000件取引(+50% QoQ)対ServiceNowの直前の史上最悪-18%下落の対比が、Agent-native対Legacyの分割を加速対衰退としてシャープにし、同じ決算サイクルで予測が想定する置換軸を物質化する。
text_locales.es: El contraste de 24/7 Wall St entre los ingresos FY2026 de $41.5B de Salesforce con Agentforce ARR $800M y 29,000 acuerdos (+50% QoQ) y la peor caída de la historia de -18% previa de ServiceNow agudiza la división Agent-native vs Legacy como acelerar-vs-declinar, materializando el eje de desplazamiento que la predicción proyecta en el mismo ciclo de ganancias.
text_locales.fil: Ang kontraste ng 24/7 Wall St sa pagitan ng FY2026 $41.5B revenue ng Salesforce na may Agentforce ARR $800M at 29,000 deals (+50% QoQ) at ng naunang worst-ever -18% drop ng ServiceNow ay nagpapatatag sa Agent-native vs Legacy split bilang accelerate-vs-decline, na nagpapamateryalisa sa displacement axis na inaasahan ng prediction sa parehong earnings cycle.

detail.description: **Capital markets reset their valuation of "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" inside Q2 2026.** ServiceNow's **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** on Apr 23, IBM's same-day decline, and the chained falls of Salesforce / Workday / Oracle reveal a shift in how capital markets weigh "AI cost-savings benefit" vs "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Inside Q2 2026, expect Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports to make the "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis explicit, and market-cap math to move from "seats × ARPU" to "share of API calls touched by agents." Lagging analyst consensus updates mean another 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) likely see 15%+ drops in the next two quarters. prediction_summary_locales.es: **Los mercados de capitales restablecen su valoración del "SaaS empresarial desplazado por agentes de IA" dentro del Q2 2026.** El **-18% (peor caída en un solo día de la historia)** de ServiceNow el 23 de abril, el declive de IBM el mismo día, y las caídas encadenadas de Salesforce / Workday / Oracle revelan un cambio en cómo los mercados de capitales sopesan el "beneficio de ahorro de costos por IA" frente al "desplazamiento por IA del SaaS de workflow legacy". Dentro del Q2 2026, se espera que los reportes Magic Quadrant / Wave de Gartner / Forrester hagan explícito el eje "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS", y que la matemática de capitalización de mercado pase de "asientos × ARPU" a "cuota de llamadas a API tocadas por agentes". Las actualizaciones rezagadas del consenso de analistas significan que probablemente otros 3-5 nombres (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) verán caídas del 15%+ en los próximos dos trimestres. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

Sa loob ng Q2 2026, asahan ang Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports na gawing explicit ang "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis, at ang market-cap math na lumipat mula sa "seats × ARPU" papunta sa "share of API calls touched by agents." Ang lagging analyst consensus updates ay nangangahulugan na isa pang 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) ay malamang na makikita ng 15%+ drops sa susunod na dalawang quarter. nodes.title: Agentic-AI CVE class lands as CSAI CNA sub-corpus by Q3 2026
nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.

description.en: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. description.ja: 2026年Q3までにエージェント型AIのCVEクラスが独立した第一級のCNA発行サブコーパスとなり、CSAIのMITRE認定CNAの下でエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが50件以上公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic skills、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Face skills)が公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みの必須ゲートを実装する。4月29日のCSAI MITRE-CNA認定は制度的な火種であり、4月28日のATT&CK v19は技術名(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント展開)を命名し、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDKは7つのサンドボックスプロバイダー(Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel)全体でデフォルトのプリミティブとしてネイティブサンドボックス実行を出荷し、4月28日のNovita Sandbox+4月28日のAWS Bedrock Managed Agents+4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry hosted agentsはベンダー側の対応を形成し、4月26日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208(単一のSQLi行がOpenAI+Anthropic+Bedrockキーを漏洩)+4月28日のSpring AI CVE-2026-40967+繰り越しのSGLang CVE-2026-5760はモデルツールレイヤー注入の影響半径を実証している。強制関数は企業のリスク移転である ― 明示的なAIエージェント任務を持つCNAが存在すれば、開示ケイデンスはランダムパブリッシャーから調整発行者主導へと圧縮され、スキルマーケットプレイスはエンタープライズ顧客を失わずに署名なしデフォルトを維持できなくなる。CSAIの最初のフルクォーター(2026年Q3)が閾値を超える最も可能性の高い着地点である。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 la clase de CVE de IA-agéntica se convierte en su propio sub-corpus de primera clase emitido por una CNA, con ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicadas bajo la CNA autorizada por MITRE de CSAI, y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills (skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face) lanza un gate obligatorio de firma + atestación de provenance antes de publicar. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.
description.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang agentic-AI CVE class ay magiging sariling first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, na may ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na inilathala sa ilalim ng MITRE-authorized CNA ng CSAI, at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ay maglulunsad ng mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate bago mag-publish. Ang Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ang institutional spark; ang Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ay nagpangalan sa mga technique (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ay naglulunsad ng native sandbox execution bilang default primitive sa 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents ang bumubuo ng vendor-side counterpart; ang Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row na naglalabas ng OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nagpapakita ng model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise risk transfer — kapag may CNA na may explicit AI-agent mandate, mag-co-compress ang disclosure cadence mula random-publisher patungo sa coordinated-issuer-driven, at hindi makakaiwas ang skill marketplaces na manatiling unsigned-by-default nang hindi nawawalan ng enterprise customers. Ang first-pull-quarter ng CSAI (Q3 2026) ay ang pinaka-malamang na landing zone para malagpasan ang threshold.

summary.es: Para Q3 2026 la clase de CVE de IA-agéntica se convierte en su propio sub-corpus de primera clase emitido por una CNA, con ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicadas bajo la CNA autorizada por MITRE de CSAI, y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills (skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face) lanza un gate obligatorio de firma + atestación de provenance antes de publicar. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.
summary.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang agentic-AI CVE class ay magiging sariling first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, na may ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na inilathala sa ilalim ng MITRE-authorized CNA ng CSAI, at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ay maglulunsad ng mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate bago mag-publish. Ang Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ang institutional spark; ang Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ay nagpangalan sa mga technique (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ay naglulunsad ng native sandbox execution bilang default primitive sa 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents ang bumubuo ng vendor-side counterpart; ang Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row na naglalabas ng OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nagpapakita ng model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise risk transfer — kapag may CNA na may explicit AI-agent mandate, mag-co-compress ang disclosure cadence mula random-publisher patungo sa coordinated-issuer-driven, at hindi makakaiwas ang skill marketplaces na manatiling unsigned-by-default nang hindi nawawalan ng enterprise customers. Ang first-pull-quarter ng CSAI (Q3 2026) ay ang pinaka-malamang na landing zone para malagpasan ang threshold.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.
