bridges.text: The Sunday CBRS buyside note season (Morgan Stanley raises target to $192, Jefferies initiates Buy at $178, Goldman holds $185 with a $220 upside scenario) supplies the public-market reference the second deal must clear; Tenstorrent's syndicate plus $3.4B fully-closed bridge tracks toward an August confidential S-1, while SambaNova's $7-9B range sits below the $10B threshold but inside negotiation distance and Groq's Saudi-PIF secondary discussion surfaces the contingent capital structure.

text_locales.en: The Sunday CBRS buyside note season (Morgan Stanley raises target to $192, Jefferies initiates Buy at $178, Goldman holds $185 with a $220 upside scenario) supplies the public-market reference the second deal must clear; Tenstorrent's syndicate plus $3.4B fully-closed bridge tracks toward an August confidential S-1, while SambaNova's $7-9B range sits below the $10B threshold but inside negotiation distance and Groq's Saudi-PIF secondary discussion surfaces the contingent capital structure.
text_locales.ja: 日曜CBRSバイサイドノート・シーズン(Morgan Stanleyは目標を$192へ引き上げ、Jefferiesは$178でBuyを開始、Goldmanは$220アップサイド・シナリオ付きで$185を維持)は、第二ディールがクリアすべきパブリック・マーケット・リファレンスを供給する;Tenstorrentのシンジケート + $3.4B完全クローズ・ブリッジは8月機密S-1へ向け追跡、一方でSambaNovaの$7-9Bレンジは$10B閾値を下回るが交渉距離内、Groqのサウジ-PIF二次議論は条件付き資本構造を浮上させる。
text_locales.es: La temporada de notas buyside dominicales de CBRS (Morgan Stanley sube objetivo a $192, Jefferies inicia Buy a $178, Goldman mantiene $185 con un escenario al alza de $220) suministra la referencia de mercado público que el segundo trato debe superar; el sindicato de Tenstorrent más el puente completamente cerrado de $3.4B trackea hacia un S-1 confidencial en agosto, mientras el rango $7-9B de SambaNova se sitúa por debajo del umbral $10B pero dentro de distancia de negociación y la discusión de secundario Saudi-PIF de Groq emerge la estructura de capital contingente.
text_locales.fil: Nagbibigay ang Sunday CBRS buyside note season (nagtataas ang Morgan Stanley ng target sa $192, nag-iinitiate ang Jefferies ng Buy sa $178, hawak ng Goldman ang $185 na may $220 upside scenario) ng public-market reference na dapat laktawan ng pangalawang deal; sumusubaybay ang syndicate plus lubusang isinarang $3.4B bridge ng Tenstorrent patungo sa isang August confidential S-1, habang ang $7-9B range ng SambaNova ay nakaupo sa ibaba ng $10B threshold pero nasa loob ng negotiation distance at pinapaibabaw ng Groq's Saudi-PIF secondary discussion ang contingent capital structure.

bridges.text: Tenstorrent files a confidential JOBS Act EGC S-1 with public window opening early August, retaining Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as $3.4B bridge co-anchors and adding Bain Capital Ventures and Fidelity. SambaNova names J.P. Morgan and Citi alongside Goldman for a late-June S-1 at a $7-9B range; Groq trails 30-60 days. The continuation-play precondition hardens.

text_locales.en: Tenstorrent files a confidential JOBS Act EGC S-1 with public window opening early August, retaining Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as $3.4B bridge co-anchors and adding Bain Capital Ventures and Fidelity. SambaNova names J.P. Morgan and Citi alongside Goldman for a late-June S-1 at a $7-9B range; Groq trails 30-60 days. The continuation-play precondition hardens.
text_locales.ja: TenstorrentはJOBS Act EGC機密S-1を提出、公開ウィンドウは8月上旬オープン、HyundaiとSamsung Foundryを$3.4Bブリッジ・コ・アンカーとして保持しBain Capital VenturesとFidelityを追加。SambaNovaはGoldmanと並んでJ.P. MorganとCitiを6月下旬S-1で$7-9Bレンジに指名;Groqは30-60日遅れる。継続プレイの前提条件が硬化する。
text_locales.es: Tenstorrent presenta un S-1 EGC JOBS Act confidencial con ventana pública abriendo a principios de agosto, reteniendo a Hyundai y Samsung Foundry como co-anclas de un puente de $3.4B y añadiendo Bain Capital Ventures y Fidelity. SambaNova nombra a J.P. Morgan y Citi junto con Goldman para un S-1 a finales de junio en un rango $7-9B; Groq trailing 30-60 días. La precondición de continuation-play se endurece.
text_locales.fil: Naghain ang Tenstorrent ng confidential JOBS Act EGC S-1 na ang public window ay magbubukas sa unang bahagi ng August, pinananatili ang Hyundai at Samsung Foundry bilang $3.4B bridge co-anchors at idinaragdag ang Bain Capital Ventures at Fidelity. Pinapangalanan ng SambaNova ang J.P. Morgan at Citi kasama ang Goldman para sa late-June S-1 sa $7-9B range; nakatalikod ng 30-60 araw ang Groq. Tumitigas ang continuation-play precondition.

bridges.text: Cerebras's $31.4B first-day cap plus the $4.9B OpenAI warrant paper gain reset the public-market comparable, and Tenstorrent confirms a $3.4B IPO bridge with Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as co-anchors targeting a July S-1 while shipping the Wormhole Galaxy rack to CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe, and Hyundai Robotics. The continuation-play precondition the prediction names is now operative.

text_locales.en: Cerebras's $31.4B first-day cap plus the $4.9B OpenAI warrant paper gain reset the public-market comparable, and Tenstorrent confirms a $3.4B IPO bridge with Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as co-anchors targeting a July S-1 while shipping the Wormhole Galaxy rack to CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe, and Hyundai Robotics. The continuation-play precondition the prediction names is now operative.
text_locales.ja: Cerebrasの初日$314億時価総額に加え、$49億のOpenAI warrantの含み益が公開市場のコンパラブルをリセットし、Tenstorrentは現代自動車とSamsung Foundryをcoアンカーとする$34億IPOブリッジを確認、7月のS-1を目標としつつWormhole GalaxyラックをCoreWeave、Lambda、Crusoe、Hyundai Roboticsへ出荷する。予測の挙げる継続プレイ前提条件が稼働状態に入る。
text_locales.es: El market cap de primer dia de $31.4B de Cerebras mas la ganancia en papel de $4.9B del warrant de OpenAI reinician la comparable del public-market, y Tenstorrent confirma un IPO bridge de $3.4B con Hyundai y Samsung Foundry como co-anchors apuntando a una S-1 en julio mientras envia el rack Wormhole Galaxy a CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe y Hyundai Robotics. La precondicion de continuation-play que nombra la prediccion ahora esta operativa.
text_locales.fil: Ang $31.4B first-day cap ng Cerebras kasama ang $4.9B paper gain sa OpenAI warrant ay nagre-reset sa public-market comparable, at kinukumpirma ng Tenstorrent ang $3.4B IPO bridge kasama ang Hyundai at Samsung Foundry bilang co-anchors na nakatutok sa July S-1 habang ipinapadala ang Wormhole Galaxy rack sa CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe, at Hyundai Robotics. Ngayon ay aktibo na ang continuation-play precondition na pinapangalanan ng prediction.

bridges.text: Cerebras pricing +2.4% above range at ~$27.2B with full green-shoe sets a concrete public-market floor that the second-deal-greater-than-$10B prediction (May 6) requires; SambaNova ($5.1B last-priced) and Groq ($2.8B + Saudi-anchored vehicle) accelerating S-1 confidential submissions to 60-90 days plus Tenstorrent's >$3B IPO bridge round move the cohort from watching to executing.

text_locales.en: Cerebras pricing +2.4% above range at ~$27.2B with full green-shoe sets a concrete public-market floor that the second-deal-greater-than-$10B prediction (May 6) requires; SambaNova ($5.1B last-priced) and Groq ($2.8B + Saudi-anchored vehicle) accelerating S-1 confidential submissions to 60-90 days plus Tenstorrent's >$3B IPO bridge round move the cohort from watching to executing.
text_locales.ja: Cerebrasがレンジ上限+2.4%の約272億ドル、グリーンシュー満額で値付けされ、第二案件>100億ドル予測(5月6日)が要する具体的な公開市場のフロアを設定した。SambaNova(直近51億ドル)とGroq(28億ドル+サウジ系ビークル)はS-1秘密提出を60-90日に加速、TenstorrentのIPO前ブリッジ>30億ドルもコホートを観望から実行へと動かしている。
text_locales.es: El precio de Cerebras +2,4% por encima del rango a ~$27,2B con green-shoe completo establece un piso concreto en el mercado público que la predicción de un segundo acuerdo mayor a $10B (6 de mayo) requiere; SambaNova ($5,1B última valoración) y Groq ($2,8B + vehículo anclado por Arabia Saudí) acelerando presentaciones confidenciales S-1 a 60-90 días, más la ronda puente IPO de Tenstorrent >$3B, mueven la cohorte de observar a ejecutar.
text_locales.fil: Ang Cerebras pricing na +2.4% sa itaas ng range sa ~$27.2B kasama ang full green-shoe ay nagtatakda ng konkretong public-market floor na kinakailangan ng second-deal-greater-than-$10B prediction (Mayo 6); ang SambaNova ($5.1B last-priced) at Groq ($2.8B + Saudi-anchored vehicle) na nagpapabilis ng S-1 confidential submissions sa 60-90 araw kasama ang >$3B IPO bridge round ng Tenstorrent ay naglilipat sa cohort mula sa pagmamasid tungo sa ehekusyon.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares at $115-$125 each to raise ~$3.5B at a $26.6B market cap at the high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership disclosed at >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan secured by warrants for >33M shares), angel roster including Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — combined with the standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, the OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent now publicly priceable on the open market, and the Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering as the parallel debt-issuance signal forces a second AI-accelerator IPO at >$10B valuation within the same calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched the most-likely candidate cohort, with Groq the leading first-mover given its prior funding-round signaling and inference-tier API revenue. The forcing function is that Cerebras's IPO surfaces a public-market comparable for AI-accelerator-startup equity for the first time — buyside coverage now has a direct multiple to anchor against, so a sibling priced inside the same cycle reads as continuation rather than first-mover risk premium. The Cerebras pricing window itself acts as a forward-guide for sibling underwriters (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) who can syndicate the next deal at parallel terms. Bear case is Cerebras pricing below midpoint and forcing the cohort to wait two quarters; absent that, Q4 2026 lands the second deal.

prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 el lanzamiento del IPO de Cerebras Systems del 4 de mayo — 28M acciones a $115-$125 cada una para recaudar ~$3.5B a una capitalización de mercado de $26.6B en el extremo alto (vs Series H $23B feb 2026), $510M en ingresos trailing, asociación OpenAI revelada en estructura warrant + préstamo multi-año >$10B (dic 2025 OpenAI prestó $1B a Cerebras garantizado por warrants para >33M acciones), roster de inversionistas ángel incluyendo Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — combinado con la cinta standing de $700B en AI-capex 2026 Big-Tech, el precedente de contratos de suministro frontier-lab de OpenAI / Anthropic ahora cotizable públicamente, y la oferta de notas garantizadas de Fleet Data Centers de $4.6B en Storey County como señal paralela de emisión de deuda obliga a un segundo IPO de acelerador AI a valoración >$10B dentro de la misma ventana calendario — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched la cohorte candidata más probable, con Groq el first-mover líder dado su signaling previo de rondas y revenue de API de capa de inferencia. La forcing function es que el IPO de Cerebras revela un comparable público para equity de startups de aceleradores AI por primera vez — la cobertura buyside ahora tiene un múltiplo directo para anclar, así que un hermano fijado dentro del mismo ciclo se lee como continuación en lugar de prima de riesgo first-mover. La ventana de fijación de Cerebras misma actúa como guía forward para underwriters hermanos (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) que pueden sindicar la siguiente operación en términos paralelos. Caso bajista es Cerebras fijando bajo el midpoint y forzando a la cohorte a esperar dos trimestres; sin eso, Q4 2026 aterriza la segunda operación.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026 ang May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares sa $115-$125 bawat isa upang makakalap ng ~$3.5B sa $26.6B market cap sa high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership na inilantad sa >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan na sineguro ng warrants para sa >33M shares), angel roster kabilang Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — kasama ng standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, ang OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent na ngayon ay publicly priceable sa open market, at ang Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering bilang parallel debt-issuance signal ay pumipilit ng pangalawang AI-accelerator IPO sa >$10B valuation sa loob ng parehong calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched ang most-likely candidate cohort, na may Groq bilang nangungunang first-mover dahil sa kanyang prior funding-round signaling at inference-tier API revenue. description.ja: Q3 2026までに、5月9日のアクセラレータIPOコホート週末アップデート — Tenstorrentが金曜引け後遅くにJOBS Act EGCフレームワーク下で機密S-1ドラフトを提出し、公的提出ウィンドウは8月初旬に開き、Hyundai Motor Group + Samsung Foundryが$3.4B完全クローズ・ブリッジ・ラウンドの共同アンカー・ポジションを維持;SambaNovaがJ.P. MorganとCitiをGoldman Sachsと並ぶ共同主幹事ブックランナーとして指名し、6月下旬ターゲットのS-1機密提出を$7-9Bフル希薄化後評価レンジで予定;Groqがソブリン・クラウドのSaudi Arabiaコミットメント・クロージング待ちで30〜60日後を推移;BernsteinがCerebras CBRSへの土曜Market-Perform開始を$172でSaudi Aramco Digital MoU依存をトップの単一カウンターパーティ集中リスクとして引用し、Morgan Stanley / Goldman / Citi Buyレーティングの$165-$185コホートに対比;Cerebras CFOが土曜に2026年10月28日の180日ロックアップを確認し、OpenAIの$1Bワラント・パッケージへの早期解除ウェーバーなし — に加えて、5月8日のサンプル・コメント・レターを一般的に適用可能なガイダンスとして扱うSEC Corp Finの土曜明確化脚注、およびMag-7コホート全体に対する顧客集中脚注に関する同スタッフの定常的照会ラインが組み合わさり、次世代AIアクセラレータS-1コホートに、ナラティブ専用開示ではなく単一カウンターパーティ・リスクファクター・エキシビット — カウンターパーティ、売上または受注残バンドのパーセンテージ、契約期間、テイクオアペイ言語、ソブリン管轄または輸出管理オーバーレイを命名するカウンターパーティごとの表 — を運用S-1形式として標準化することを強制する。強制機能は、新たにリストされたコンパラブルへのセルサイド・カバレッジ開始が単一カウンターパーティ集中に対するMarket-Performコールをアンカーするや否や、後続のS-1引受会社はナラティブ専用言語を放置できず、放置すれば取引カレンダーを押し出すCorp Finコメント・レター・サイクルを招くことになる、というものである。可能性の高い形状はTenstorrentの8月公開ファイリング・ウィンドウでの表形式エキシビットで、SambaNova 6月下旬とGroqが同ウィンドウ内でミラーする。ベア・ケースは形式を10-K開示へ延期する別個のコンセプト・リリース;それ以外の場合、Q3 2026はコホート全体に標準化されたエキシビットを着地させる。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 la actualización de fin de semana de la cohorte de IPO de aceleradores del 9 de mayo — el borrador confidencial S-1 de Tenstorrent presentado bajo el marco JOBS Act EGC el viernes a última hora con ventanas de presentación pública abriendo a inicios de agosto y Hyundai Motor Group más Samsung Foundry reteniendo posiciones de co-anclas en la ronda puente totalmente cerrada de $3.4B, SambaNova nombrando a J.P. Morgan y Citi como bookrunners líderes conjuntos junto a Goldman Sachs para una presentación confidencial S-1 apuntada para finales de junio en un rango de valoración totalmente diluida de $7-9B, Groq quedando 30-60 días detrás pendiente del cierre del compromiso sovereign-cloud Saudi-Arabia, más la iniciación Market-Perform del sábado de Bernstein sobre Cerebras CBRS a $172 citando la dependencia del MoU de Saudi Aramco Digital como el mayor riesgo de concentración de contraparte única contra la cohorte Buy-rated de $165-$185 de Morgan Stanley / Goldman / Citi y la confirmación del CFO de Cerebras del sábado del lock-up de 180 días del 28 de octubre 2026 sin exención de liberación anticipada para el paquete de warrants de $1B de OpenAI — combinada con la nota al pie aclaratoria del sábado de SEC Corp Fin tratando la carta de comentarios de muestra del 8 de mayo como guía generalmente aplicable y la línea de consulta permanente del mismo personal sobre notas al pie de concentración de clientes a través de la cohorte Mag-7, fuerzan a la cohorte de S-1 de aceleradores AI de la próxima ola a estandarizar un exhibit de factor-de-riesgo de contraparte única — una tabla por cliente nombrando contraparte, banda de porcentaje-de-ingresos o backlog, plazo de contrato, lenguaje take-or-pay, y cualquier overlay de jurisdicción soberana o control de exportación — como el formato S-1 operativo en lugar de divulgación solo-narrativa. La función forzante es que una vez que la iniciación sell-side sobre un comparable recién listado ancla un call Market-Perform sobre concentración de contraparte única, los suscriptores S-1 subsiguientes no pueden dejar que el lenguaje solo-narrativo permanezca sin invitar un ciclo de carta-de-comentarios de Corp Fin que empuja el calendario del deal. La forma probable es un exhibit tabular en la ventana de presentación pública de Tenstorrent de agosto, reflejado por SambaNova a finales de junio y Groq dentro de la misma ventana. El caso bajista es un release de concepto separado difiriendo el formato a la divulgación 10-K; en ausencia de eso, Q3 2026 aterriza el exhibit estandarizado a través de la cohorte.
description.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang May 9 accelerator-IPO cohort weekend update — ang confidential S-1 draft ng Tenstorrent na inihain sa ilalim ng JOBS Act EGC framework late Friday na ang public-filing windows ay magbubukas sa unang bahagi ng August at hawak ng Hyundai Motor Group plus Samsung Foundry ang co-anchor positions sa $3.4B fully-closed bridge round, ang pagngangalan ng SambaNova sa J.P. Morgan at Citi bilang joint lead bookrunners kasama ang Goldman Sachs para sa S-1 confidential submission na nakatutok sa late June sa $7-9B fully-diluted valuation range, ang Groq na nasa likod ng 30-60 araw pending sovereign-cloud Saudi-Arabia commitment closure, plus ang Saturday Market-Perform initiation ng Bernstein sa Cerebras CBRS sa $172 na binabanggit ang Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency bilang nangungunang single-counterparty concentration risk laban sa Morgan Stanley / Goldman / Citi Buy-rated $165-$185 cohort at ang Saturday confirmation ng Cerebras CFO sa October 28 2026 180-day lock-up na walang early-release waiver para sa $1B warrant package ng OpenAI — kasama ng SEC Corp Fin Saturday clarifying footnote na tinatrato ang May 8 sample comment letter bilang generally applicable guidance at ang standing line of inquiry ng parehong staff sa customer-concentration footnotes sa buong Mag-7 cohort, ay pumipilit sa next-wave AI-accelerator S-1 cohort na i-standardize ang single-counterparty risk-factor exhibit — isang per-customer table na nagngangalan sa counterparty, percentage-of-revenue o backlog band, contract tenor, take-or-pay language, at anumang sovereign-jurisdiction o export-control overlay — bilang operative S-1 format imbis na narrative-only disclosure. Ang forcing function ay na sa sandaling ang sell-side initiation sa freshly-listed comparable ay anchor sa Market-Perform call sa single-counterparty concentration, ang mga sumunod na S-1 underwriters ay hindi maaaring hayaang manatili ang narrative-only language nang hindi nag-iimbita ng Corp Fin comment-letter cycle na nagtutulak sa deal calendar. Ang malamang na shape ay isang tabular exhibit sa August public-filing window ng Tenstorrent, na sinasalamin ng SambaNova late June at Groq sa loob ng parehong window. Bear case ay isang separate concept release na ipinagpapaliban ang format sa 10-K disclosure; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 2026 sa standardized exhibit sa cohort.

bridges.text: On the AI-accelerator S-1 per-counterparty risk-factor table prediction (May 9): Sunday buyside note season elevates Bernstein's single-counterparty-concentration risk into its own subheading at $172 Market-Perform on CBRS, while Morgan Stanley raises to $192 and Jefferies initiates at $178 citing the May 8 SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter as removing the Reg FD overhang. Tenstorrent adds Citi as joint lead bookrunner alongside JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley plus Mizuho and SMBC Nikko reflecting Hyundai and Samsung Foundry co-anchors; SambaNova adds Wells Fargo; a Reuters Asia wire references early Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion for Groq. CBRS call-skew sits at 3.5x into Monday.

text_locales.en: On the AI-accelerator S-1 per-counterparty risk-factor table prediction (May 9): Sunday buyside note season elevates Bernstein's single-counterparty-concentration risk into its own subheading at $172 Market-Perform on CBRS, while Morgan Stanley raises to $192 and Jefferies initiates at $178 citing the May 8 SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter as removing the Reg FD overhang. Tenstorrent adds Citi as joint lead bookrunner alongside JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley plus Mizuho and SMBC Nikko reflecting Hyundai and Samsung Foundry co-anchors; SambaNova adds Wells Fargo; a Reuters Asia wire references early Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion for Groq. CBRS call-skew sits at 3.5x into Monday.
text_locales.ja: AIアクセラレータS-1カウンターパーティ単位リスクファクター・テーブル予測(5月9日)について: 日曜バイサイドノート・シーズンはCBRS上の$172 Market-PerformでBernsteinの単一カウンターパーティ集中リスクをそれ自身の小見出しへ引き上げ、Morgan Stanleyは$192へ、Jefferiesは$178で開始し5月8日SEC Corp FinサンプルコメントレターをReg FDオーバーハング除去として引用。TenstorrentはCitiをJPMorganとMorgan Stanleyに加えてジョイント・リード・ブックランナーとして追加、MizuhoとSMBC NikkoがHyundaiとSamsung Foundryコ・アンカーを反映し追加;SambaNovaはWells Fargoを追加;Reuters Asiaワイヤはサウジ-PIF条件付き二次オファリング議論の初期段階に言及。CBRSコール・スキューは月曜に向けて3.5倍に位置する。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de tabla de factor de riesgo por-contraparte en S-1s de aceleradores IA (9 de mayo): la temporada de notas buyside del domingo eleva el riesgo de concentración por contraparte única de Bernstein a su propio subtítulo en $172 Market-Perform sobre CBRS, mientras Morgan Stanley sube a $192 y Jefferies inicia en $178 citando la carta de comentario muestra de SEC Corp Fin del 8 de mayo como eliminadora del overhang Reg FD. Tenstorrent añade Citi como joint lead bookrunner junto a JPMorgan y Morgan Stanley más Mizuho y SMBC Nikko reflejando co-anclas Hyundai y Samsung Foundry; SambaNova añade Wells Fargo; un wire de Reuters Asia referencia discusión temprana de secundario contingente de Saudi PIF para Groq. El call-skew de CBRS se sitúa en 3.5x entrando al lunes.
text_locales.fil: Sa AI-accelerator S-1 per-counterparty risk-factor table prediction (Mayo 9): itinataas ng Sunday buyside note season ang single-counterparty-concentration risk ng Bernstein sa sarili nitong subheading sa $172 Market-Perform sa CBRS, habang nagtaas ang Morgan Stanley sa $192 at nag-iinitiate ang Jefferies sa $178 na binabanggit ang Mayo 8 SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter bilang pag-aalis ng Reg FD overhang. Idinaragdag ng Tenstorrent si Citi bilang joint lead bookrunner kasama ang JPMorgan at Morgan Stanley plus Mizuho at SMBC Nikko na sumasalamin sa Hyundai at Samsung Foundry co-anchors; idinaragdag ng SambaNova ang Wells Fargo; tinutukoy ng Reuters Asia wire ang maagang Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion para sa Groq. Nakaupo ang CBRS call-skew sa 3.5x patungo sa Lunes.

bridges.text: Published today, the prediction is anchored by Bernstein's Saturday Market-Perform initiation on Cerebras CBRS at $172 naming Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency as the top single-counterparty concentration risk, Tenstorrent's confidential S-1 with Hyundai + Samsung Foundry co-anchors, SambaNova's J.P. Morgan + Citi bookrunner roster at $7-9B fully-diluted, and SEC Corp Fin's clarifying footnote treating the May 8 sample comment letter as generally applicable.

text_locales.en: Published today, the prediction is anchored by Bernstein's Saturday Market-Perform initiation on Cerebras CBRS at $172 naming Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency as the top single-counterparty concentration risk, Tenstorrent's confidential S-1 with Hyundai + Samsung Foundry co-anchors, SambaNova's J.P. Morgan + Citi bookrunner roster at $7-9B fully-diluted, and SEC Corp Fin's clarifying footnote treating the May 8 sample comment letter as generally applicable.
text_locales.ja: 本日公表、予測はBernsteinの土曜Market-Perform Cerebras CBRS $172開始がSaudi Aramco Digital MoU依存性をトップ単一カウンターパーティ集中リスクとして命名すること、TenstorrentのHyundai + Samsung Foundryコ・アンカー機密S-1、SambaNovaのJ.P. Morgan + Citiブックランナー名簿$7-9B完全希薄化、SEC Corp Finの5月8日サンプル・コメント・レターを一般適用として扱う明確化フットノートでアンカーされる。
text_locales.es: Publicada hoy, la predicción está anclada por la iniciación Market-Perform del sábado de Bernstein sobre Cerebras CBRS a $172 nombrando la dependencia del MoU de Saudi Aramco Digital como el riesgo top de concentración por contraparte única, el S-1 confidencial de Tenstorrent con co-anclas Hyundai + Samsung Foundry, el roster de bookrunners J.P. Morgan + Citi de SambaNova a $7-9B completamente diluido, y la nota aclaratoria de SEC Corp Fin tratando la carta de comentario muestra del 8 de mayo como generalmente aplicable.
text_locales.fil: Inilathala ngayon, ang prediction ay naka-anchor sa Saturday Market-Perform initiation ng Bernstein sa Cerebras CBRS sa $172 na nagpapangalan sa Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency bilang top single-counterparty concentration risk, sa confidential S-1 ng Tenstorrent na may co-anchors ng Hyundai + Samsung Foundry, sa J.P. Morgan + Citi bookrunner roster ng SambaNova sa $7-9B fully-diluted, at sa clarifying footnote ng SEC Corp Fin na tumatrato sa Mayo 8 sample comment letter bilang generally applicable.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: By Q3 2026 the May 9 accelerator-IPO cohort weekend update — Tenstorrent's confidential S-1 draft filed under the JOBS Act EGC framework late Friday with public-filing windows opening early August and Hyundai Motor Group plus Samsung Foundry retaining co-anchor positions on the $3.4B fully-closed bridge round, SambaNova naming J.P. Morgan and Citi as joint lead bookrunners alongside Goldman Sachs for an S-1 confidential submission targeted late June at a $7-9B fully-diluted valuation range, Groq trailing 30-60 days behind pending sovereign-cloud Saudi-Arabia commitment closure, plus Bernstein's Saturday Market-Perform initiation on Cerebras CBRS at $172 citing Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency as the top single-counterparty concentration risk against the Morgan Stanley / Goldman / Citi Buy-rated $165-$185 cohort and the Cerebras CFO Saturday confirmation of the October 28 2026 180-day lock-up with no early-release waiver for OpenAI's $1B warrant package — combined with the SEC Corp Fin Saturday clarifying footnote treating the May 8 sample comment letter as generally applicable guidance and the same staff's standing line of inquiry on customer-concentration footnotes across the Mag-7 cohort, force the next-wave AI-accelerator S-1 cohort to standardize a single-counterparty risk-factor exhibit — a per-customer table naming counterparty, percentage-of-revenue or backlog band, contract tenor, take-or-pay language, and any sovereign-jurisdiction or export-control overlay — as the operative S-1 format rather than narrative-only disclosure. The forcing function is that once sell-side initiation on a freshly-listed comparable anchors a Market-Perform call on single-counterparty concentration, subsequent S-1 underwriters cannot let narrative-only language stand without inviting a Corp Fin comment-letter cycle that pushes the deal calendar. The likely shape is a tabular exhibit in Tenstorrent's August public-filing window, mirrored by SambaNova late June and Groq inside the same window. Bear case is a separate concept release deferring the format to 10-K disclosure; absent that, Q3 2026 lands the standardized exhibit across the cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 la actualización de fin de semana de la cohorte de IPO de aceleradores del 9 de mayo — el borrador confidencial S-1 de Tenstorrent presentado bajo el marco JOBS Act EGC el viernes a última hora con ventanas de presentación pública abriendo a inicios de agosto y Hyundai Motor Group más Samsung Foundry reteniendo posiciones de co-anclas en la ronda puente totalmente cerrada de $3.4B, SambaNova nombrando a J.P. Morgan y Citi como bookrunners líderes conjuntos junto a Goldman Sachs para una presentación confidencial S-1 apuntada para finales de junio en un rango de valoración totalmente diluida de $7-9B, Groq quedando 30-60 días detrás pendiente del cierre del compromiso sovereign-cloud Saudi-Arabia, más la iniciación Market-Perform del sábado de Bernstein sobre Cerebras CBRS a $172 citando la dependencia del MoU de Saudi Aramco Digital como el mayor riesgo de concentración de contraparte única contra la cohorte Buy-rated de $165-$185 de Morgan Stanley / Goldman / Citi y la confirmación del CFO de Cerebras del sábado del lock-up de 180 días del 28 de octubre 2026 sin exención de liberación anticipada para el paquete de warrants de $1B de OpenAI — combinada con la nota al pie aclaratoria del sábado de SEC Corp Fin tratando la carta de comentarios de muestra del 8 de mayo como guía generalmente aplicable y la línea de consulta permanente del mismo personal sobre notas al pie de concentración de clientes a través de la cohorte Mag-7, fuerzan a la cohorte de S-1 de aceleradores AI de la próxima ola a estandarizar un exhibit de factor-de-riesgo de contraparte única — una tabla por cliente nombrando contraparte, banda de porcentaje-de-ingresos o backlog, plazo de contrato, lenguaje take-or-pay, y cualquier overlay de jurisdicción soberana o control de exportación — como el formato S-1 operativo en lugar de divulgación solo-narrativa. La función forzante es que una vez que la iniciación sell-side sobre un comparable recién listado ancla un call Market-Perform sobre concentración de contraparte única, los suscriptores S-1 subsiguientes no pueden dejar que el lenguaje solo-narrativo permanezca sin invitar un ciclo de carta-de-comentarios de Corp Fin que empuja el calendario del deal. La forma probable es un exhibit tabular en la ventana de presentación pública de Tenstorrent de agosto, reflejado por SambaNova a finales de junio y Groq dentro de la misma ventana. El caso bajista es un release de concepto separado difiriendo el formato a la divulgación 10-K; en ausencia de eso, Q3 2026 aterriza el exhibit estandarizado a través de la cohorte.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang May 9 accelerator-IPO cohort weekend update — ang confidential S-1 draft ng Tenstorrent na inihain sa ilalim ng JOBS Act EGC framework late Friday na ang public-filing windows ay magbubukas sa unang bahagi ng August at hawak ng Hyundai Motor Group plus Samsung Foundry ang co-anchor positions sa $3.4B fully-closed bridge round, ang pagngangalan ng SambaNova sa J.P. Morgan at Citi bilang joint lead bookrunners kasama ang Goldman Sachs para sa S-1 confidential submission na nakatutok sa late June sa $7-9B fully-diluted valuation range, ang Groq na nasa likod ng 30-60 araw pending sovereign-cloud Saudi-Arabia commitment closure, plus ang Saturday Market-Perform initiation ng Bernstein sa Cerebras CBRS sa $172 na binabanggit ang Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency bilang nangungunang single-counterparty concentration risk laban sa Morgan Stanley / Goldman / Citi Buy-rated $165-$185 cohort at ang Saturday confirmation ng Cerebras CFO sa October 28 2026 180-day lock-up na walang early-release waiver para sa $1B warrant package ng OpenAI — kasama ng SEC Corp Fin Saturday clarifying footnote na tinatrato ang May 8 sample comment letter bilang generally applicable guidance at ang standing line of inquiry ng parehong staff sa customer-concentration footnotes sa buong Mag-7 cohort, ay pumipilit sa next-wave AI-accelerator S-1 cohort na i-standardize ang single-counterparty risk-factor exhibit — isang per-customer table na nagngangalan sa counterparty, percentage-of-revenue o backlog band, contract tenor, take-or-pay language, at anumang sovereign-jurisdiction o export-control overlay — bilang operative S-1 format imbis na narrative-only disclosure. Ang forcing function ay na sa sandaling ang sell-side initiation sa freshly-listed comparable ay anchor sa Market-Perform call sa single-counterparty concentration, ang mga sumunod na S-1 underwriters ay hindi maaaring hayaang manatili ang narrative-only language nang hindi nag-iimbita ng Corp Fin comment-letter cycle na nagtutulak sa deal calendar. Ang malamang na shape ay isang tabular exhibit sa August public-filing window ng Tenstorrent, na sinasalamin ng SambaNova late June at Groq sa loob ng parehong window. Bear case ay isang separate concept release na ipinagpapaliban ang format sa 10-K disclosure; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 2026 sa standardized exhibit sa cohort.

description.ja: Q3 2026までに、現在省庁間レビューで回付されているWhite House Frontier Model Review Board大統領令ドラフト(OSTPプレスプール確認による5月22日以前に署名ウィンドウは開かない見通し、5月15日14:00 EDTのS-407機密閾値ブリーフィングにNIST DirectorのLocascio、ODNIサイバーリード、CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative代表が出席、AI Policy InstituteにR Street、Public Knowledge、Lawyers for Civil Justice、Knight First Amendment Institute、EFFが合流した連合が文書化されたState Farm準拠の理由付き決定記録と60日のDefense Production Act Section 708パブリック・コメント・ウィンドウを要求)と、インド太平洋サイバー評価レシプロシティ境界の週末拡張(韓国PIPCと科学技術情報通信部の正式ミラー・シグナル、ニュージーランドGCSBがQ3 2026のミラー・コミットメントを伴うオブザーバー、5月7日のEU AI Office + UK AISI協力覚書および5月8日のSingapore IMDA + Japan AISIパラレルMoCにCanada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCのオブザーバーが重なる)が組み合わさり、署名済みFMRB大統領令は同盟国サイバー評価レシプロシティ・ラダーを組み込むことを強制される。これはEU AI Act第51条レジーム、UK AISI任意フロンティアモデル・プログラム、およびインド太平洋のSingapore + Japan + 韓国コホートをFMRB 30日事前リリース通知要件の運用上の充足面として指名し、AISI管理のTLOレンジ・ランを120日の配置ウィンドウ内のレシプロカル証拠として扱い、テナントごとのMythosクラス能力アテステーション・ログ(5月9日のarxiv 2605.05933リーケージ・フリーダム証明 + Anthropic Project Glasswingプリミティブ)をコンプライアンス証拠の形として指名する。強制機能は、AI Policy InstituteとKnight-EFFアミカス書簡が結晶化した訴訟ベクトルが、DPA Section 708の任意情報共有言語のみでは答えられないことである;EOドラフターは、コメント・ウィンドウ対応に手続き的フロアを与えStat Farm記録に証拠的ベースラインを与える多国間レシプロシティ・アンカーを必要とし、EU-UK-インド太平洋コホートはAISIの32ステップThe Last Onesレンジを中心に既に運用上整合している。可能性の高い形状はEOに対する名指し管轄レシプロシティ・アネックスで、既に署名済みの4レジーム + 韓国ミラー + ニュージーランド・オブザーバー・ラダーが、5月21日のCISA連邦民政部門KEVミラーリング・ケイデンスに紐付く運用レビュー・ティックとして結ばれる。ベア・ケースはEOが先に単独で出荷され、OSTPレター交換経由でレシプロシティを後付けする;それ以外の場合、署名済みEOはQ3 2026内にラダーを着地させる。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 el borrador de la orden ejecutiva del Frontier Model Review Board de la Casa Blanca ahora circulando en revisión interagencial (confirmación del press-pool de OSTP de que no se abre ventana de firma antes del 22 de mayo, briefing clasificado de umbral S-407 del 15 de mayo 14:00 EDT con la directora de NIST Locascio, el responsable cyber de ODNI, y un representante del Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative de CISA asistiendo, la coalición AI Policy Institute más R Street más Public Knowledge más Lawyers for Civil Justice más el Knight First Amendment Institute más EFF presionando un registro documentado de decisión razonada según State Farm y una ventana de comentarios públicos de la Defense Production Act Sección 708 de 60 días) combinado con la extensión de fin de semana del perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Indo-Pacífico (señal de reflejo formal de South Korea PIPC más Ministry of Science and ICT, compromiso de observador de New Zealand GCSB con reflejo Q3 2026, superpuesto al memorándum-de-cooperación EU AI Office más UK AISI del 7 de mayo y el MoC paralelo Singapore IMDA más Japan AISI del 8 de mayo con observadores Canada CCCS más Australia ASD ACSC) fuerza a la orden ejecutiva firmada del FMRB a incorporar una escalera de reciprocidad de evaluación-cyber aliada nombrando el régimen de la Sección 51 del EU AI Act, el programa voluntario de modelos-frontera de UK AISI, y la cohorte Indo-Pacífico Singapur más Japón más South Korea como la superficie operativa de satisfacción para el requisito de notificación pre-lanzamiento de 30 días del FMRB, con corridas de rango TLO administradas por AISI tratadas como evidencia recíproca dentro de una ventana de colocación de 120 días y logs de atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant (la prueba de libertad-de-fuga de arxiv 2605.05933 del 9 de mayo más la primitiva Anthropic Project Glasswing) nombrados como la forma de evidencia-de-cumplimiento. La función forzante es que el vector de litigio que AI Policy Institute y la carta amicus Knight-EFF han cristalizado no puede ser respondido con lenguaje voluntario de intercambio-de-información de la DPA Sección 708 solo; los redactores de la EO necesitan un ancla multilateral de reciprocidad que dé a la respuesta de la ventana de comentarios un piso procesal y al registro State Farm una línea base evidenciaria, y la cohorte EU-UK-Indo-Pacífico ya está operacionalmente alineada alrededor del rango The Last Ones de 32 pasos de AISI. La forma probable es un anexo de reciprocidad de jurisdicción-nombrada a la EO con los cuatro regímenes ya firmados más el reflejo de South Korea más la escalera de observador de New Zealand, atado a la cadencia de KEV-mirroring federal-civil de CISA del 21 de mayo como el tick operativo de revisión. El caso bajista es que la EO se envíe unilateral primero y agregue la reciprocidad vía intercambio de cartas de OSTP; en ausencia de eso, la EO firmada aterriza la escalera dentro de Q3 2026.
description.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang White House Frontier Model Review Board executive-order draft na umiikot ngayon sa interagency review (OSTP press-pool confirmation na walang signing window na bubukas bago ang May 22, ang May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing kasama ang NIST Director Locascio, ang ODNI cyber lead, at isang CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative na dadalo, ang AI Policy Institute plus R Street plus Public Knowledge plus Lawyers for Civil Justice plus ang Knight First Amendment Institute plus EFF coalition na nagtutulak sa documented State Farm reasoned-decision record at sa 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window) kasama ng weekend extension ng Indo-Pacific cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter (South Korea PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT formal-mirror signal, New Zealand GCSB observer commitment na may Q3 2026 mirror, na nakapatong sa May 7 EU AI Office plus UK AISI memorandum-of-cooperation at sa May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI parallel MoC na may Canada CCCS plus Australia ASD ACSC observers) ay pumipilit sa signed FMRB executive order na isama ang allied cyber-evaluation reciprocity ladder na nagngangalan sa EU AI Act Section 51 regime, sa UK AISI voluntary frontier-model program, at sa Indo-Pacific Singapore plus Japan plus South Korea cohort bilang operative satisfying surface para sa 30-day pre-release notification requirement ng FMRB, na ang AISI-administered TLO-range runs ay tinatrato bilang reciprocal evidence sa loob ng 120-day placement window at ang per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs (ang May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof plus Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive) ay pinangalanan bilang compliance-evidence shape. Ang forcing function ay na ang litigation-vector na pinabalakubak ng AI Policy Institute at ng Knight-EFF amicus letter ay hindi masasagot ng DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language lamang; ang EO drafters ay nangangailangan ng multilateral reciprocity anchor na nagbibigay sa comment-window response ng procedural floor at sa State Farm record ng evidentiary baseline, at ang EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort ay nasa operationally aligned na sa paligid ng AISI's 32-step The Last Ones range. Ang malamang na shape ay isang named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex sa EO na may apat na already-signed regimes plus ang South Korea mirror plus ang New Zealand observer ladder, na nakatali sa May 21 CISA federal-civilian KEV-mirroring cadence bilang operative review tick. Ang bear case ay ang EO ay nag-ship ng unilateral muna at bina-bolt ang reciprocity sa pamamagitan ng OSTP letter exchange; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang signed EO sa ladder sa loob ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: On the FMRB allied reciprocity ladder prediction (May 10): Lawfare's Sunday long-read sharpens the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the executive order ships on Defense Production Act Section 708 without notice-and-comment; Just Security argues the EU-UK plus Singapore-Japan MoCs establish a customary-international-practice baseline a US-side regime should mirror to avoid an outlier posture. Senator Warner adds NSA Cybersecurity Directorate plus Microsoft MSTIC witnesses to the May 15 S-407 classified briefing; the Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter widens to eight named jurisdictions with India MeitY/CERT-In and Taiwan NICS joining as observers; OSTP holds the no-signing-before-May-22 floor.

text_locales.en: On the FMRB allied reciprocity ladder prediction (May 10): Lawfare's Sunday long-read sharpens the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the executive order ships on Defense Production Act Section 708 without notice-and-comment; Just Security argues the EU-UK plus Singapore-Japan MoCs establish a customary-international-practice baseline a US-side regime should mirror to avoid an outlier posture. Senator Warner adds NSA Cybersecurity Directorate plus Microsoft MSTIC witnesses to the May 15 S-407 classified briefing; the Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter widens to eight named jurisdictions with India MeitY/CERT-In and Taiwan NICS joining as observers; OSTP holds the no-signing-before-May-22 floor.
text_locales.ja: FMRB同盟相互性ラダー予測(5月10日)について: Lawfareの日曜ロング・リードは、大統領令が告示・パブリック・コメントなしに国防生産法第708条で出荷される場合の決定的訴訟ベクターとしてState Farm理由付き決定記録論証を先鋭化する;Just SecurityはEU-UKプラスシンガポール-日本MoCsがUS側レジームが外れ値ポスチャーを避けるためにミラーすべき慣習国際慣行ベースラインを確立する、と論じる。Warner上院議員は5月15日S-407機密ブリーフィングにNSAサイバーセキュリティ・ディレクトレートとMicrosoft MSTIC証人を追加;インド太平洋相互性ペリメーターはインドMeitY / CERT-Inと台湾NICSがオブザーバーとして合流し8つの命名管轄区へ広がる;OSTPは5月22日以前不署名フロアを維持する。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de escalera de reciprocidad aliada FMRB (10 de mayo): el long-read dominical de Lawfare afila el argumento del registro de decisión razonada State Farm como el vector de litigación dispositivo si la orden ejecutiva se envía sobre el vehículo Defense Production Act Section 708 sin notice-and-comment; Just Security argumenta que los MoCs EU-UK más Singapore-Japan establecen una base de práctica internacional consuetudinaria que un régimen del lado estadounidense debería reflejar para evitar una postura outlier. El senador Warner añade testigos de NSA Cybersecurity Directorate más Microsoft MSTIC al briefing clasificado del 15 de mayo en S-407; el perímetro de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífico se amplía a ocho jurisdicciones nombradas con India MeitY/CERT-In y Taiwan NICS uniéndose como observadores; OSTP mantiene el piso de no-firma-antes-del-22-de-mayo.
text_locales.fil: Sa FMRB allied reciprocity ladder prediction (Mayo 10): hinahasa ng Sunday long-read ng Lawfare ang State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument bilang dispositive litigation vector kung mag-ship ang executive order sa Defense Production Act Section 708 nang walang notice-and-comment; nag-aargumento ang Just Security na ang EU-UK plus Singapore-Japan MoCs ay nag-eestablish ng customary-international-practice baseline na dapat i-mirror ng US-side regime para maiwasan ang outlier posture. Idinaragdag ni Senator Warner ang NSA Cybersecurity Directorate plus Microsoft MSTIC witnesses sa Mayo 15 S-407 classified briefing; lumalawak ang Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter sa walong named jurisdictions sa pagsasama ng India MeitY/CERT-In at Taiwan NICS bilang observers; hawak ng OSTP ang no-signing-before-Mayo-22 floor.

needs.actor: AI Policy Institute plus R Street plus Public Knowledge plus Lawyers for Civil Justice plus Knight First Amendment Institute plus EFF coalition counsel crystallizing the litigation vector and DPA Section 708 public-comment-window State Farm record
needs.job: file structured comments in the 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window and a Knight-EFF amicus letter that crystallizes the litigation vector forcing the FMRB executive-order drafters to incorporate the allied reciprocity ladder as the procedural floor — documenting that DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language alone fails the State Farm reasoned-decision standard absent a named-jurisdiction reciprocity anchor.
needs.outcome: Documented State Farm reasoned-decision record plus Knight-EFF amicus letter on file in the FMRB EO public-comment docket forcing the executive-order drafters to incorporate the six-jurisdiction reciprocity ladder as the operative satisfying surface, with the litigation-vector procedural floor cited in the OSTP letter exchange and the eventual signed EO preamble.
needs.motivation: The advocacy coalition's strategic interest is converting a voluntary-information-sharing regime into a hard reciprocity-ladder commitment that downstream litigation and judicial review can enforce; without the State Farm record crystallized inside the 60-day comment window, the EO can ship unilateral first and bolt on reciprocity only via OSTP letter exchange, weakening the long-run enforceability surface.

job_locales.en: file structured comments in the 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window and a Knight-EFF amicus letter that crystallizes the litigation vector forcing the FMRB executive-order drafters to incorporate the allied reciprocity ladder as the procedural floor — documenting that DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language alone fails the State Farm reasoned-decision standard absent a named-jurisdiction reciprocity anchor.
job_locales.ja: 60日のDefense Production Act Section 708パブリック・コメント・ウィンドウに構造化コメントを提出し、FMRB大統領令ドラフターに同盟レシプロシティ・ラダーを手続き的フロアとして組み込むことを強制する訴訟ベクトルを結晶化するKnight-EFFアミカス書簡を提出する — DPA Section 708の任意情報共有言語のみでは、名指し管轄レシプロシティ・アンカーなしにState Farm準拠の理由付き決定基準を満たさないことを文書化する。
job_locales.es: presentar comentarios estructurados en la ventana de comentarios públicos de 60 días de la Defense Production Act Sección 708 y una carta amicus Knight-EFF que cristaliza el vector de litigio forzando a los redactores de la orden ejecutiva del FMRB a incorporar la escalera de reciprocidad aliada como el piso procesal — documentando que el lenguaje voluntario de intercambio-de-información de la DPA Sección 708 solo falla el estándar de decisión razonada según State Farm en ausencia de un ancla de reciprocidad de jurisdicción-nombrada.
job_locales.fil: maghain ng structured comments sa 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window at isang Knight-EFF amicus letter na nagpapatalas sa litigation vector na pumipilit sa FMRB executive-order drafters na isama ang allied reciprocity ladder bilang procedural floor — dinodokumento na ang DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language lamang ay nabibigo sa State Farm reasoned-decision standard kung wala ang named-jurisdiction reciprocity anchor.

outcome_locales.en: Documented State Farm reasoned-decision record plus Knight-EFF amicus letter on file in the FMRB EO public-comment docket forcing the executive-order drafters to incorporate the six-jurisdiction reciprocity ladder as the operative satisfying surface, with the litigation-vector procedural floor cited in the OSTP letter exchange and the eventual signed EO preamble.
outcome_locales.ja: FMRB EOパブリック・コメント・ドケットに記録された文書化されたState Farm準拠の理由付き決定記録 + Knight-EFFアミカス書簡が、大統領令ドラフターに6管轄区域レシプロシティ・ラダーを運用上の充足面として組み込むことを強制し、訴訟ベクトル手続き的フロアがOSTPレター交換と最終的な署名済みEOプリアンブルで引用される。
outcome_locales.es: Registro documentado de decisión razonada según State Farm más carta amicus Knight-EFF en el expediente de comentarios públicos de la EO del FMRB forzando a los redactores de la orden ejecutiva a incorporar la escalera de reciprocidad de seis-jurisdicciones como la superficie operativa de satisfacción, con el piso procesal del vector de litigio citado en el intercambio de cartas de OSTP y el preámbulo eventual de la EO firmada.
outcome_locales.fil: Dokumentadong State Farm reasoned-decision record plus Knight-EFF amicus letter na nasa file sa FMRB EO public-comment docket na pumipilit sa executive-order drafters na isama ang six-jurisdiction reciprocity ladder bilang operative satisfying surface, kasama ang litigation-vector procedural floor na binanggit sa OSTP letter exchange at sa eventual signed EO preamble.

motivation_locales.en: The advocacy coalition's strategic interest is converting a voluntary-information-sharing regime into a hard reciprocity-ladder commitment that downstream litigation and judicial review can enforce; without the State Farm record crystallized inside the 60-day comment window, the EO can ship unilateral first and bolt on reciprocity only via OSTP letter exchange, weakening the long-run enforceability surface.
motivation_locales.ja: アドボカシー連合の戦略的利益は、任意情報共有レジームを下流の訴訟と司法レビューが執行できるハード・レシプロシティ・ラダー・コミットメントへ変換することにある;60日のコメント・ウィンドウ内でState Farm記録が結晶化されない場合、EOは単独で先に出荷され、OSTPレター交換経由でのみレシプロシティが後付けされ、長期的執行可能性が弱まる。
motivation_locales.es: El interés estratégico de la coalición de advocacy es convertir un régimen voluntario de intercambio-de-información en un compromiso duro de escalera-de-reciprocidad que el litigio descendente y la revisión judicial puedan hacer cumplir; sin el registro según State Farm cristalizado dentro de la ventana de comentarios de 60 días, la EO puede enviarse unilateral primero y agregar la reciprocidad solo vía intercambio de cartas de OSTP, debilitando la superficie de aplicabilidad a largo-plazo.
motivation_locales.fil: Ang strategic interest ng advocacy coalition ay ang pag-co-convert ng voluntary-information-sharing regime papasok sa hard reciprocity-ladder commitment na maipatutupad ng downstream litigation at judicial review; kung walang State Farm record na napatibay sa loob ng 60-day comment window, ang EO ay pwedeng mag-ship ng unilateral muna at bina-bolt ang reciprocity sa pamamagitan lamang ng OSTP letter exchange, na nagpapahina sa long-run enforceability surface.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 the White House Frontier Model Review Board executive-order draft now circulating in interagency review (OSTP press-pool confirmation that no signing window opens before May 22, May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing with NIST Director Locascio, the ODNI cyber lead, and a CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative attending, AI Policy Institute plus R Street plus Public Knowledge plus Lawyers for Civil Justice plus the Knight First Amendment Institute plus EFF coalition pressing a documented State Farm reasoned-decision record and a 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window) combined with the weekend extension of the Indo-Pacific cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter (South Korea PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT formal-mirror signal, New Zealand GCSB observer commitment with Q3 2026 mirror, layered on the May 7 EU AI Office plus UK AISI memorandum-of-cooperation and the May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI parallel MoC with Canada CCCS plus Australia ASD ACSC observers) forces the signed FMRB executive order to incorporate an allied cyber-evaluation reciprocity ladder naming the EU AI Act Section 51 regime, the UK AISI voluntary frontier-model program, and the Indo-Pacific Singapore plus Japan plus South Korea cohort as the operative satisfying surface for the FMRB's 30-day pre-release notification requirement, with AISI-administered TLO-range runs treated as reciprocal evidence inside a 120-day placement window and per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs (the May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof plus Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive) named as the compliance-evidence shape. The forcing function is that the litigation-vector that AI Policy Institute and the Knight-EFF amicus letter have crystallized cannot be answered with DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language alone; the EO drafters need a multilateral reciprocity anchor that gives the comment-window response a procedural floor and the State Farm record an evidentiary baseline, and the EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort is already operationally aligned around AISI's 32-step The Last Ones range. The likely shape is a named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex to the EO with the four already-signed regimes plus the South Korea mirror plus the New Zealand observer ladder, tied to the May 21 CISA federal-civilian KEV-mirroring cadence as the operative review tick. Bear case is the EO ships unilateral first and bolts on reciprocity via OSTP letter exchange; absent that, the signed EO lands the ladder inside Q3 2026.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Q3 2026までに、現在省庁間レビューで回付されているWhite House Frontier Model Review Board大統領令ドラフト(OSTPプレスプール確認による5月22日以前に署名ウィンドウは開かない見通し、5月15日14:00 EDTのS-407機密閾値ブリーフィングにNIST DirectorのLocascio、ODNIサイバーリード、CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative代表が出席、AI Policy InstituteにR Street、Public Knowledge、Lawyers for Civil Justice、Knight First Amendment Institute、EFFが合流した連合が文書化されたState Farm準拠の理由付き決定記録と60日のDefense Production Act Section 708パブリック・コメント・ウィンドウを要求)と、インド太平洋サイバー評価レシプロシティ境界の週末拡張(韓国PIPCと科学技術情報通信部の正式ミラー・シグナル、ニュージーランドGCSBがQ3 2026のミラー・コミットメントを伴うオブザーバー、5月7日のEU AI Office + UK AISI協力覚書および5月8日のSingapore IMDA + Japan AISIパラレルMoCにCanada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCのオブザーバーが重なる)が組み合わさり、署名済みFMRB大統領令は同盟国サイバー評価レシプロシティ・ラダーを組み込むことを強制される。これはEU AI Act第51条レジーム、UK AISI任意フロンティアモデル・プログラム、およびインド太平洋のSingapore + Japan + 韓国コホートをFMRB 30日事前リリース通知要件の運用上の充足面として指名し、AISI管理のTLOレンジ・ランを120日の配置ウィンドウ内のレシプロカル証拠として扱い、テナントごとのMythosクラス能力アテステーション・ログ(5月9日のarxiv 2605.05933リーケージ・フリーダム証明 + Anthropic Project Glasswingプリミティブ)をコンプライアンス証拠の形として指名する。強制機能は、AI Policy InstituteとKnight-EFFアミカス書簡が結晶化した訴訟ベクトルが、DPA Section 708の任意情報共有言語のみでは答えられないことである;EOドラフターは、コメント・ウィンドウ対応に手続き的フロアを与えStat Farm記録に証拠的ベースラインを与える多国間レシプロシティ・アンカーを必要とし、EU-UK-インド太平洋コホートはAISIの32ステップThe Last Onesレンジを中心に既に運用上整合している。可能性の高い形状はEOに対する名指し管轄レシプロシティ・アネックスで、既に署名済みの4レジーム + 韓国ミラー + ニュージーランド・オブザーバー・ラダーが、5月21日のCISA連邦民政部門KEVミラーリング・ケイデンスに紐付く運用レビュー・ティックとして結ばれる。ベア・ケースはEOが先に単独で出荷され、OSTPレター交換経由でレシプロシティを後付けする;それ以外の場合、署名済みEOはQ3 2026内にラダーを着地させる。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 el borrador de la orden ejecutiva del Frontier Model Review Board de la Casa Blanca ahora circulando en revisión interagencial (confirmación del press-pool de OSTP de que no se abre ventana de firma antes del 22 de mayo, briefing clasificado de umbral S-407 del 15 de mayo 14:00 EDT con la directora de NIST Locascio, el responsable cyber de ODNI, y un representante del Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative de CISA asistiendo, la coalición AI Policy Institute más R Street más Public Knowledge más Lawyers for Civil Justice más el Knight First Amendment Institute más EFF presionando un registro documentado de decisión razonada según State Farm y una ventana de comentarios públicos de la Defense Production Act Sección 708 de 60 días) combinado con la extensión de fin de semana del perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Indo-Pacífico (señal de reflejo formal de South Korea PIPC más Ministry of Science and ICT, compromiso de observador de New Zealand GCSB con reflejo Q3 2026, superpuesto al memorándum-de-cooperación EU AI Office más UK AISI del 7 de mayo y el MoC paralelo Singapore IMDA más Japan AISI del 8 de mayo con observadores Canada CCCS más Australia ASD ACSC) fuerza a la orden ejecutiva firmada del FMRB a incorporar una escalera de reciprocidad de evaluación-cyber aliada nombrando el régimen de la Sección 51 del EU AI Act, el programa voluntario de modelos-frontera de UK AISI, y la cohorte Indo-Pacífico Singapur más Japón más South Korea como la superficie operativa de satisfacción para el requisito de notificación pre-lanzamiento de 30 días del FMRB, con corridas de rango TLO administradas por AISI tratadas como evidencia recíproca dentro de una ventana de colocación de 120 días y logs de atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant (la prueba de libertad-de-fuga de arxiv 2605.05933 del 9 de mayo más la primitiva Anthropic Project Glasswing) nombrados como la forma de evidencia-de-cumplimiento. La función forzante es que el vector de litigio que AI Policy Institute y la carta amicus Knight-EFF han cristalizado no puede ser respondido con lenguaje voluntario de intercambio-de-información de la DPA Sección 708 solo; los redactores de la EO necesitan un ancla multilateral de reciprocidad que dé a la respuesta de la ventana de comentarios un piso procesal y al registro State Farm una línea base evidenciaria, y la cohorte EU-UK-Indo-Pacífico ya está operacionalmente alineada alrededor del rango The Last Ones de 32 pasos de AISI. La forma probable es un anexo de reciprocidad de jurisdicción-nombrada a la EO con los cuatro regímenes ya firmados más el reflejo de South Korea más la escalera de observador de New Zealand, atado a la cadencia de KEV-mirroring federal-civil de CISA del 21 de mayo como el tick operativo de revisión. El caso bajista es que la EO se envíe unilateral primero y agregue la reciprocidad vía intercambio de cartas de OSTP; en ausencia de eso, la EO firmada aterriza la escalera dentro de Q3 2026.

Ang forcing function ay na ang litigation-vector na pinabalakubak ng AI Policy Institute at ng Knight-EFF amicus letter ay hindi masasagot ng DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language lamang; ang EO drafters ay nangangailangan ng multilateral reciprocity anchor na nagbibigay sa comment-window response ng procedural floor at sa State Farm record ng evidentiary baseline, at ang EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort ay nasa operationally aligned na sa paligid ng AISI's 32-step The Last Ones range. Ang malamang na shape ay isang named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex sa EO na may apat na already-signed regimes plus ang South Korea mirror plus ang New Zealand observer ladder, na nakatali sa May 21 CISA federal-civilian KEV-mirroring cadence bilang operative review tick. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. description.en: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. description.ja: **Mag 7 の Q1 決算 (4/29-30) が AI capex の ROI ナラティブを再設定する — Q3 2026 までに、トークンマージンの閾値で AI capex を公に階層化する最初のハイパースケーラが登場する。** Alphabet ($175B-$185B)、Amazon (約 $200B)、Meta ($115B-$135B)、そして Microsoft (Azure 出遅れによる再評価リスク) を合算した 2026 capex ガイダンスは合計 ~$650B-$700B に達し、ウォール街の「AI ROI リアリティチェック」と対峙する。4/29-30 の決算は、**トークン単位売上のエグジットベロシティ**仮説を裏付けるか、それともマルチプル圧縮を引き起こすかのいずれかとなる。Q3 2026 までに、Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社は **Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限で増分 GPU capex を公にゲーティング** — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」が登場し、2024-2025 の「使え、さもなくば死ね」ドクトリンに終止符を打つ。フロンティアラボのアンカーディール (Google $40B / Anthropic、Amazon $25B / Anthropic、OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) が可視的な圧力解放弁になる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los resultados del Q1 de Mag 7 (29-30 de abril) reinician la narrativa del ROI del capex en IA — el Q3 2026 ve al primer hyperscaler que tiera públicamente el capex de IA por una valla de margen por token.** Con la guía combinada de capex 2026 de Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B) y Microsoft (riesgo de rerating por rezago de Azure) totalizando ~$650B-$700B contra el "AI ROI reality check" de Wall Street, las publicaciones del 29-30 de abril o validan la tesis de **velocidad-de-salida de ingresos por token** o disparan una compresión de múltiplos. Para el Q3 2026, al menos uno de los Big-3 hyperscalers públicamente **gatea el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — el primer umbral explícito de "ROI de infra de IA" de una nube pública, terminando la doctrina de "gastar o morir" de 2024-2025. Los acuerdos ancla con laboratorios frontier (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) se convierten en la válvula visible de alivio de presión. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) ay magre-reset ng AI-capex ROI narrative — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, makikita ang unang hyperscaler na pampublikong magti-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.** Sa pinagsamang 2026 capex guidance mula sa Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), at Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) na umaabot sa ~$650B-$700B laban sa "AI ROI reality check" ng Wall Street, ang Apr 29-30 prints ay magpapatunay sa **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis o magti-trigger ng multiple compression. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscalers ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa pamamagitan ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud, na nagtatapos sa 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Ang frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) ay magiging visible pressure relief valve. plain_language.es: Los gigantes de la nube gastaron enormemente en chips de IA; los inversores ahora exigen pruebas de ganancias, así que uno limitará públicamente el nuevo gasto en GPU según el margen por token.
plain_language.fil: Cloud giants spent huge on AI chips; investors now want proof of profit, so one will publicly limit new GPU spend by token-margin.

title_locales.en: Big-3 hyperscalers gate AI capex on per-token-margin floor by Q3 2026
title_locales.ja: Big-3 ハイパースケーラー、Q3 2026 までに AI capex をトークン単位マージン下限でゲート
title_locales.es: Los 3 grandes hyperscalers condicionan el capex en IA a un piso de margen por token para Q3 2026
title_locales.fil: Big-3 hyperscalers, ipapatigil ang AI capex hangga't di natutugunan ang per-token-margin floor pagsapit ng Q3 2026

detail.summary_short: Combined 2026 Mag 7 AI capex guidance near $650B-$700B meets Wall Street's ROI reality check at the Apr 29-30 prints. By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly tiers incremental GPU spend on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor, ending the 2024-2025 spend-or-die doctrine.

summary_short_locales.en: Combined 2026 Mag 7 AI capex guidance near $650B-$700B meets Wall Street's ROI reality check at the Apr 29-30 prints. By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly tiers incremental GPU spend on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor, ending the 2024-2025 spend-or-die doctrine.
summary_short_locales.ja: Mag 7 合算の 2026 AI capex ガイダンスは約 $650B-$700B に近く、4/29-30 の決算でウォール街の ROI リアリティチェックと対峙する。Q3 2026 までに、Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限で増分 GPU 支出を公に階層化し、2024-2025 の「使え、さもなくば死ね」ドクトリンに終止符を打つ。
summary_short_locales.es: La guía combinada de capex de IA 2026 de Mag 7 cerca de $650B-$700B se encuentra con el AI ROI reality check de Wall Street en las publicaciones del 29-30 de abril. Para el Q3 2026 al menos uno de los Big-3 hyperscalers tiera públicamente el gasto incremental en GPU sobre un piso de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex, terminando la doctrina de gastar o morir de 2024-2025.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang pinagsamang 2026 Mag 7 AI capex guidance na malapit sa $650B-$700B ay sasalubungin ng AI ROI reality check ng Wall Street sa Apr 29-30 prints. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscalers ay pampublikong magti-tier ng incremental GPU spend sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor, na nagtatapos sa 2024-2025 spend-or-die doctrine.

bridges.text: AMD's May 5 print preview tightens the structural force the prediction names: the MI308 China collapse plus the analyst split (Cathie Wood trim, DA Davidson Buy, RBC Hold) shows buyside pressure for explicit AI-capex ROI disclosure is now operative on a per-vendor basis, exactly the precondition for a hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.

text_locales.en: AMD's May 5 print preview tightens the structural force the prediction names: the MI308 China collapse plus the analyst split (Cathie Wood trim, DA Davidson Buy, RBC Hold) shows buyside pressure for explicit AI-capex ROI disclosure is now operative on a per-vendor basis, exactly the precondition for a hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.
text_locales.ja: AMDの5月5日決算プレビューは、予測が指摘する構造的な強制力を引き締める: MI308中国崩壊 + アナリストの分裂(Cathie Woodの売却、DA DavidsonのBuy、RBCのHold)が、明示的なAI-capex ROI開示に対するバイサイドの圧力がベンダー単位で運用されていることを示しており、これはハイパースケーラーがAI capexをトークン単位マージン・ゲートで公に階層化する前提条件そのものである。
text_locales.es: El avance de la impresión del 5 de mayo de AMD ajusta la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: el colapso de MI308 China más la división de analistas (recorte de Cathie Wood, Buy de DA Davidson, Hold de RBC) muestra que la presión del lado comprador para divulgación explícita de ROI de capex de IA ahora opera por proveedor, exactamente la precondición para que un hyperscaler escalone públicamente el capex de IA por puerta de margen por token.
text_locales.fil: Ang AMD May 5 print preview ay nagpapatigas sa structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang MI308 China collapse plus ang analyst split (Cathie Wood trim, DA Davidson Buy, RBC Hold) ay nagpapakita na ang buyside pressure para sa explicit AI-capex ROI disclosure ay aktibo na ngayon sa per-vendor basis, eksaktong precondition para sa isang hyperscaler na pampublikong mag-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.

bridges.text: Apple's Q3 guide without an AI-services line, the $700B 2026 capex tape, and Microsoft's $37B run-rate disclosure are exactly the buyside-pressure signals the prediction needed to move from narrative to disclosure-shape. The cohort is now publicly competing on per-token-margin transparency rather than hiding behind aggregate cloud revenue.

text_locales.en: Apple's Q3 guide without an AI-services line, the $700B 2026 capex tape, and Microsoft's $37B run-rate disclosure are exactly the buyside-pressure signals the prediction needed to move from narrative to disclosure-shape. The cohort is now publicly competing on per-token-margin transparency rather than hiding behind aggregate cloud revenue.
text_locales.ja: AppleのQ3ガイダンスがAIサービスラインなし、$700Bの2026年capexテープ、Microsoftの$37B run-rate開示が、予測が物語から開示形へ移るために必要だった買い手側圧力信号そのものだ。コホートは今や、集約クラウド収益の背後に隠れるのではなく、トークン当たりマージンの透明性で公に競争している。
text_locales.es: La guía Q3 de Apple sin línea de servicios de IA, el tape de capex 2026 de $700B y la divulgación de run-rate de $37B de Microsoft son exactamente las señales de presión del lado comprador que la predicción necesitaba para moverse de narrativa a forma de divulgación. El cohorte ahora compite públicamente sobre transparencia de margen por token en lugar de esconderse detrás de ingresos agregados de nube.
text_locales.fil: Ang Q3 guide ng Apple na walang AI-services line, ang $700B 2026 capex tape, at ang $37B run-rate disclosure ng Microsoft ang eksaktong buyside-pressure signals na kinailangan ng prediction upang lumipat mula narrative tungo sa disclosure-shape. Ang cohort ngayon ay pampublikong nagkukumpetensya sa per-token-margin transparency sa halip na magtago sa likod ng aggregate cloud revenue.

bridges.text: Apple's $100B buyback and clean +14-17% guide rebuilt the AI-capex-on-faith tape exactly when the prediction expected the buyside to demand a per-token-margin gate; AMD's May 5 print and the Cerebras IPO are the next pressure points that should produce that disclosure.

text_locales.en: Apple's $100B buyback and clean +14-17% guide rebuilt the AI-capex-on-faith tape exactly when the prediction expected the buyside to demand a per-token-margin gate; AMD's May 5 print and the Cerebras IPO are the next pressure points that should produce that disclosure.
text_locales.ja: Appleの$100B自社株買いとクリーンな+14-17%ガイドが、予測がトークンあたりマージンゲートをバイサイドが要求すると期待したまさにそのとき、AI設備投資オン信仰テープを再構築した;AMDの5月5日決算とCerebras IPOがその開示を生み出すはずの次の圧力点だ。
text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de Apple y la guía limpia +14-17% reconstruyeron la cinta de capex-IA-por-fe exactamente cuando la predicción esperaba que el lado comprador exigiera una puerta de margen-por-token; la impresión AMD del 5 mayo y la IPO de Cerebras son los siguientes puntos de presión que deberían producir esa divulgación.
text_locales.fil: Ang $100B buyback ng Apple at malinis na +14-17% guide ay muling nagbuo sa AI-capex-on-faith tape eksakto nang hilingin ng buyside ang per-token-margin gate na inaasahan ng prediction; ang May 5 print ng AMD at ang Cerebras IPO ay ang susunod na pressure points na dapat magpoduce ng disclosure na iyon.

bridges.text: Apple's clean Q2 beat plus the $700B 2026 AI-capex tracking number and Apple's $100B buyback land the cohort-side of the Mag 7 super-week reset, but no hyperscaler has yet stated a per-token-margin gate. Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate disclosure remains the closest precedent, one structural step short of the explicit gate the prediction calls for.

text_locales.en: Apple's clean Q2 beat plus the $700B 2026 AI-capex tracking number and Apple's $100B buyback land the cohort-side of the Mag 7 super-week reset, but no hyperscaler has yet stated a per-token-margin gate. Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate disclosure remains the closest precedent, one structural step short of the explicit gate the prediction calls for.
text_locales.ja: AppleのクリーンなQ2 ビートに加え、7,000億ドルの2026年AI設備投資追跡数値とAppleの1,000億ドル自社株買いは、Mag 7スーパーウィークリセットのコホート側を着地させるが、ハイパースケーラーはまだトークンあたりマージンゲートを述べていない。Microsoftの370億ドルAIランレート開示が依然として最も近い前例であり、予測が要求する明示的なゲートよりも構造的に1ステップ短い。
text_locales.es: El beat limpio Q2 de Apple más el número de tracking de capex-IA-2026 de $700B y la recompra de $100B de Apple aterrizan el lado-cohorte del reset de la super-semana Mag 7, pero ningún hyperscaler ha enunciado aún un gate por token-margin. La disclosure del run-rate IA de $37B de Microsoft sigue siendo el precedente más cercano, un paso estructural por debajo del gate explícito que la predicción exige.
text_locales.fil: Ang malinis na Q2 beat ng Apple plus ang $700B 2026 AI-capex tracking number at ang $100B buyback ng Apple ay naghatid ng cohort-side ng Mag 7 super-week reset, ngunit walang hyperscaler na nag-state pa ng per-token-margin gate. Ang $37B AI run-rate disclosure ng Microsoft ay nananatiling pinakamalapit na precedent, isang structural step na kulang sa explicit na gate na hinihingi ng prediction.

bridges.text: The Mag 7 print event landed exactly in the prediction's forecast window with Microsoft posting the first per-AI-business single-line $37B run-rate disclosure. That is one structural step short of an explicit per-token-margin gate but is the closest precedent any hyperscaler has set. META's -7% AH capex-shortfall reset reinforces the disclosure-pressure leg.

text_locales.en: The Mag 7 print event landed exactly in the prediction's forecast window with Microsoft posting the first per-AI-business single-line $37B run-rate disclosure. That is one structural step short of an explicit per-token-margin gate but is the closest precedent any hyperscaler has set. META's -7% AH capex-shortfall reset reinforces the disclosure-pressure leg.
text_locales.ja: Mag 7決算イベントは予測の予測窓内ぴったりに着地し、MicrosoftがAI事業ごと初の単一行$37Bランレート開示を行った。これはトークンあたりマージン明示ゲートに構造的に1ステップ短いが、どのハイパースケーラもこれまで設定したことのない最も近い先例である。METAの-7% AH capex不足リセットが開示圧力脚を強化する。
text_locales.es: El evento de prints Mag 7 aterrizó exactamente en la ventana de pronóstico de la predicción con Microsoft publicando la primera disclosure por-AI-business como sola línea de run-rate de $37B. Eso queda un paso estructural corto frente a un gate explícito de margen-por-token, pero es el precedente más cercano que ha sentado cualquier hyperscaler. El reset de -7% AH de META por shortfall de capex refuerza la pata de presión de disclosure.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mag 7 print event ay lumapag eksakto sa forecast window ng prediction kasama ng Microsoft na nag-post ng unang per-AI-business single-line $37B run-rate disclosure. Iyon ay isang structural step kulang sa explicit per-token-margin gate ngunit ang pinakamalapit na precedent na itinakda ng anumang hyperscaler. Ang -7% AH capex-shortfall reset ng META ay nagpapatibay sa disclosure-pressure leg.

bridges.text: The Apr 29-30 Mag-7 print collision with Powell's final FOMC presser arrives exactly as the prediction projected, on top of Apr 28's WSJ-driven OpenAI-revenue-miss tape crack. The landing window the prediction names - prints + FOMC compressing the AI-capex ROI debate into a single 24-hour tape - is materializing as scripted; what's left to verify is whether at least one Big-3 hyperscaler tiers capex on a per-token-margin floor by Q3 2026.

text_locales.en: The Apr 29-30 Mag-7 print collision with Powell's final FOMC presser arrives exactly as the prediction projected, on top of Apr 28's WSJ-driven OpenAI-revenue-miss tape crack. The landing window the prediction names - prints + FOMC compressing the AI-capex ROI debate into a single 24-hour tape - is materializing as scripted; what's left to verify is whether at least one Big-3 hyperscaler tiers capex on a per-token-margin floor by Q3 2026.
text_locales.ja: 4月29-30日のMag-7プリント衝突がPowellの最終FOMC記者会見と重なり、4月28日のWSJ駆動OpenAI収益ミス・テープ・クラックの上に、まさに予測が投影した通りに到着している。予測が指摘する着地ウィンドウ - プリント + FOMCがAI-capex ROI議論を単一の24時間テープに圧縮 - はスクリプト通りに物質化している。残された検証は、少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラーが2026年Q3までにトークン単位マージン・フロアでcapexを階層化するかどうかだ。
text_locales.es: La colision de resultados Mag-7 del 29-30 de abril con la conferencia final FOMC de Powell llega exactamente como la prediccion proyecto, encima de la cinta del fallo-de-ingresos-de-OpenAI impulsada por WSJ del 28 de abril. La ventana de aterrizaje que la prediccion nombra - resultados + FOMC comprimiendo el debate del ROI del capex de IA en una sola cinta de 24-horas - se esta materializando como guion; lo que queda por verificar es si al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 tierara capex sobre un piso de margen-por-token para el Q3 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 29-30 Mag-7 print collision kasama ang final FOMC presser ni Powell ay dumarating nang eksakto sa ipino-project ng hula, sa ibabaw ng Apr 28 WSJ-driven OpenAI-revenue-miss tape crack. Ang landing window na pinapangalanan ng hula - prints + FOMC na nag-co-compress ng AI-capex ROI debate sa iisang 24-hour tape - ay nag-mamaterialize gaya ng inilarawan; ang natitira sa pag-verify ay kung kahit isang Big-3 hyperscaler ay mag-tier ng capex sa per-token-margin floor pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: FOMC and Mag 7 prints colliding into the same 48h tape with ~$700B capex on the table is the landing-window the prediction set; Apr 27's contract restructurings give the relief-valve framing and the per-token-margin disclosure setup the thesis expected.

text_locales.en: FOMC and Mag 7 prints colliding into the same 48h tape with ~$700B capex on the table is the landing-window the prediction set; Apr 27's contract restructurings give the relief-valve framing and the per-token-margin disclosure setup the thesis expected.
text_locales.ja: FOMC と Mag 7 決算が同じ 48 時間のテープに衝突し、テーブルに約 $700B の capex が乗ることは、予測が定めたランディング ウィンドウだ; 4/27 の契約再構築が、テーゼが見込んだ圧力解放のフレーミングとトークン単位マージン開示のセットアップを与える。
text_locales.es: FOMC y las publicaciones Mag 7 chocando en la misma cinta de 48h con ~$700B de capex sobre la mesa es la ventana de aterrizaje que estableció la predicción; las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril dan el marco de válvula de alivio y la configuración de divulgación de margen-por-token que esperaba la tesis.
text_locales.fil: Ang FOMC at Mag 7 prints na kumukolisyon sa parehong 48h tape na may ~$700B capex sa lamesa ay ang landing-window na itinakda ng prediction; ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay nagbibigay ng relief-valve framing at ang per-token-margin disclosure setup na inaasahan ng thesis.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **Mag 7 の Q1 決算 (4/29-30) が AI capex の ROI ナラティブを再設定する — Q3 2026 までに、トークンマージンの閾値で AI capex を公に階層化する最初のハイパースケーラが登場する。** Alphabet ($175B-$185B)、Amazon (約 $200B)、Meta ($115B-$135B)、そして Microsoft (Azure 出遅れによる再評価リスク) を合算した 2026 capex ガイダンスは合計 ~$650B-$700B に達し、ウォール街の「AI ROI リアリティチェック」と対峙する。4/29-30 の決算は、**トークン単位売上のエグジットベロシティ**仮説を裏付けるか、それともマルチプル圧縮を引き起こすかのいずれかとなる。Q3 2026 までに、Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社は **Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限で増分 GPU capex を公にゲーティング** — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」が登場し、2024-2025 の「使え、さもなくば死ね」ドクトリンに終止符を打つ。フロンティアラボのアンカーディール (Google $40B / Anthropic、Amazon $25B / Anthropic、OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) が可視的な圧力解放弁になる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Los resultados del Q1 de Mag 7 (29-30 de abril) reinician la narrativa del ROI del capex en IA — el Q3 2026 ve al primer hyperscaler que tiera públicamente el capex de IA por una valla de margen por token.** Con la guía combinada de capex 2026 de Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B) y Microsoft (riesgo de rerating por rezago de Azure) totalizando ~$650B-$700B contra el "AI ROI reality check" de Wall Street, las publicaciones del 29-30 de abril o validan la tesis de **velocidad-de-salida de ingresos por token** o disparan una compresión de múltiplos. Para el Q3 2026, al menos uno de los Big-3 hyperscalers públicamente **gatea el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — el primer umbral explícito de "ROI de infra de IA" de una nube pública, terminando la doctrina de "gastar o morir" de 2024-2025. Los acuerdos ancla con laboratorios frontier (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) se convierten en la válvula visible de alivio de presión. prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) ay magre-reset ng AI-capex ROI narrative — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, makikita ang unang hyperscaler na pampublikong magti-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.** Sa pinagsamang 2026 capex guidance mula sa Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), at Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) na umaabot sa ~$650B-$700B laban sa "AI ROI reality check" ng Wall Street, ang Apr 29-30 prints ay magpapatunay sa **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis o magti-trigger ng multiple compression. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscalers ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa pamamagitan ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud, na nagtatapos sa 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Ang frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) ay magiging visible pressure relief valve. The "AGI" word becomes a financial-instrument primitive, not a metaphysical one. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
