description.es: **El "desmontaje de la cláusula AGI" sienta una plantilla — para Q4 2026 al menos otro contrato foundation-lab × hyperscaler se modifica públicamente para eliminar una cláusula discrecional de "capability-trigger", reemplazada por revenue-share de fecha-fin fija + distribución cloud no exclusiva.** La reescritura del 27 de abril Microsoft/OpenAI ya no se trata solo de la exclusividad de Azure — convierte un riesgo binario y discrecional del consejo de revocación de IP en un **límite de ingresos vinculado al calendario (2030)** y **distribución multi-cloud como nuevo estándar**. description.en: **Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 force the first **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure from a hyperscaler by Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal anchor the new doctrine.** Combined Mag 7 capex of ~$700B for 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending to ~$170B FY27) lands into a tape that has already shifted from "rewarding capex on faith" to "demanding tangible profit." **Apr 27 contract restructurings explicitly route AI-lab compute through hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton with Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs at scale). By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — first explicit "AI-infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud. NVDA $5T-class market cap and AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory hold; the spend curve doesn't break, but its disclosure language does. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **Mag 7 決算 + 4/28-29 FOMC が、Q3 2026 までにハイパースケーラからの初の **トークン単位マージンでゲーティングされた capex** 開示を強要する — 4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft 協定 + Anthropic / AWS Trainium のシリコンレベル ディールが新ドクトリンを定礎する。** 2026 年の Mag 7 合算 capex 約 $700B (Alphabet $175B-$185B、Amazon 約 $200B、Meta $115B-$135B、Microsoft 約 $146B FY26 から FY27 で約 $170B へトレンド) は、すでに「信仰に基づき capex を報いる」から「具体的な利益を要求する」へとシフトしたテープに着地する。**4/27 の契約再構築は AI ラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ自社シリコン経由に明示的にルーティング** している (Anthropic との AWS Trainium / Graviton、スケールでの Meta-Graviton CPU)。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が **増分 GPU capex を Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限でゲーティング** する — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」となる。NVDA $5T クラスの時価総額と AMD / Cerebras IPO 軌道は維持される。支出曲線は折れないが、その開示言語は折れる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Las publicaciones de Mag 7 + FOMC del 28-29 de abril fuerzan la primera divulgación de **capex con margen-por-token gateado** desde un hyperscaler para Q3 2026 — el pacto OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril + el acuerdo Anthropic/AWS Trainium a nivel de silicio anclan la nueva doctrina.** El capex combinado de Mag 7 de ~$700B para 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 tendiendo a ~$170B FY27) aterriza en una cinta que ya ha pasado de "recompensar el capex con fe" a "exigir ganancia tangible." **Las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril enrutan explícitamente la computación de los AI-labs a través del silicio propiedad del hyperscaler** (AWS Trainium/Graviton con Anthropic; CPUs Meta-Graviton a escala). Para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler **gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — primer "umbral de ROI de AI-infra" explícito de un cloud público. La capitalización de mercado de NVDA tipo $5T y la trayectoria de IPO AMD/Cerebras se mantienen; la curva de gasto no se rompe, pero su lenguaje de divulgación sí. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 ay magpipilit sa unang **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure mula sa hyperscaler pagsapit ng Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal ang nag-aanchor sa bagong doctrine.** Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 capex na ~$700B para sa 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending sa ~$170B FY27) ay tumatama sa tape na lumipat na mula sa "rewarding capex on faith" patungo sa "demanding tangible profit." **Ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay tahasang nagru-route ng AI-lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton kasama ang Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs sa scale). Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI-infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud. Ang NVDA $5T-class market cap at AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory ay nananatili; hindi mababasag ang spend curve, ngunit ang disclosure language nito ay babasagin. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.ja: AAPLの$100B自社株買いが$700B capexテープに積層され、MSFTの$37B run-rate単一ライン開示と合わせて、トークン当たりマージンゲーティングテーゼが活発に保たれる。Powellが2028年まで理事会に残る決定とAMD 5月5日決算、5月8日の4月雇用統計が、ハイパースケーラーへのより厳格なトークン当たり開示への圧力をかけるマクロボラティリティの足を加える。
text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de AAPL apilada sobre el tape de capex de $700B y la divulgación de línea única de run-rate de $37B de MSFT mantienen activa la tesis de gating de margen por token. Powell-se-queda-en-la-Junta hasta 2028 más la impresión de AMD del 5 de mayo y la impresión de empleos de abril del 8 de mayo añaden la pierna de volatilidad macro que presiona a los hyperscalers hacia una divulgación más dura por token.
text_locales.fil: Ang $100B buyback ng AAPL na nakapatong sa $700B capex tape at sa $37B run-rate single-line disclosure ng MSFT ay pinapanatiling aktibo ang per-token-margin gating thesis. Ang Powell-stays-on-Board hanggang 2028 plus ang AMD May 5 print at ang May 8 Apr jobs print ay nagdaragdag ng macro-volatility leg na nagpipilit sa hyperscalers tungo sa mas matigas na per-token disclosure.

text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de Apple más la cinta récord del 1 mayo reconstruyeron el condicionamiento de capex-IA-por-fe que la predicción espera que se rompa en una puerta de margen-por-token, con la disidencia FOMC del 29 abr suministrando la capa de presión de riesgo institucional.

Powell-permanece-en-Board refuerza la prima de riesgo institucional bajo todo el tape de capex IA. La disclosure de capex condicionada por per-token-margin en sí misma todavía está upstream — el run-rate de $37B de Microsoft es el precedente más cercano.
text_locales.fil: Ang pag-close ng Apple sa Mag 7 super-week nang walang separate AI-services line plus ang $700B 2026 capex print ay eksaktong tumutugma sa buyside-pressure setup na pinanindigan ng prediction. Ang per-token-margin-gated-capex disclosure mismo ay nasa upstream pa rin — ang $37B run-rate ng Microsoft ay ang pinakamalapit na precedent.

text_locales.es: El AI run-rate explícito de $37B de Microsoft es la primera disclosure por-AI-business como una sola línea desde un hyperscaler — precedente directo para la tesis de capex-con-gate-de-margen-por-token que proyecta la predicción. El disenso 8-4 del FOMC + Powell-se-queda-en-la-Junta refuerzan la prima de riesgo institucional bajo todo el tape de capex-IA. Señal de refuerzo fuerte.

Ang 8-4 FOMC dissent + Powell-stays-on-Board ay nagpapatibay sa institutional-risk premium sa ilalim ng buong AI-capex tape. Matibay na nagpapatibay na signal.

text_locales.en: Mag-7 prints arrive after close today and FOMC's 2:30 PM ET presser closes Powell's term, exactly the Apr 28-29 landing window the prediction named, on top of Apr 28's chip selloff cracking the AI-capex-on-faith tape. The disclosure-language shift the prediction projects is now under live pressure; the per-token-margin floor itself has not yet appeared in earnings commentary.
text_locales.ja: Mag-7プリントは本日引け後に到着し、FOMC午後2:30 ET記者会見がPowellの任期を締めくくる。これはまさに予測が指摘した4月28-29日の着地ウィンドウであり、4月28日のチップ売却が信頼に基づくAI-capexテープを割った上に乗っている。予測が投影する開示言語のシフトは今やライブの圧力下にある。トークン単位マージン・フロア自体は決算コメントにまだ現れていない。
text_locales.es: Los resultados Mag-7 llegan despues del cierre hoy y la conferencia FOMC de las 2:30 PM ET cierra el termino de Powell, exactamente la ventana de aterrizaje del 28-29 de abril que la prediccion nombro, encima del selloff de chips del 28 de abril quebrando la cinta de capex-de-IA-por-fe. El cambio de lenguaje de divulgacion que la prediccion proyecta ahora esta bajo presion en vivo; el piso de margen-por-token mismo todavia no ha aparecido en el comentario de resultados.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mag-7 prints ay dumarating pagkatapos ng close ngayon at ang FOMC 2:30 PM ET presser ay nagsasara sa termino ni Powell, eksakto sa Apr 28-29 landing window na pinapangalanan ng hula, sa ibabaw ng Apr 28 chip selloff na bumabasag sa AI-capex-on-faith tape. Ang disclosure-language shift na ipino-project ng hula ay ngayon nasa ilalim ng live pressure; ang per-token-margin floor mismo ay hindi pa lumitaw sa earnings commentary.

detail.description: **Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 force the first **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure from a hyperscaler by Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal anchor the new doctrine.** Combined Mag 7 capex of ~$700B for 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending to ~$170B FY27) lands into a tape that has already shifted from "rewarding capex on faith" to "demanding tangible profit." **Apr 27 contract restructurings explicitly route AI-lab compute through hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton with Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs at scale). By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — first explicit "AI-infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud. NVDA $5T-class market cap and AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory hold; the spend curve doesn't break, but its disclosure language does. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **Mag 7 決算 + 4/28-29 FOMC が、Q3 2026 までにハイパースケーラからの初の **トークン単位マージンでゲーティングされた capex** 開示を強要する — 4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft 協定 + Anthropic / AWS Trainium のシリコンレベル ディールが新ドクトリンを定礎する。** 2026 年の Mag 7 合算 capex 約 $700B (Alphabet $175B-$185B、Amazon 約 $200B、Meta $115B-$135B、Microsoft 約 $146B FY26 から FY27 で約 $170B へトレンド) は、すでに「信仰に基づき capex を報いる」から「具体的な利益を要求する」へとシフトしたテープに着地する。**4/27 の契約再構築は AI ラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ自社シリコン経由に明示的にルーティング** している (Anthropic との AWS Trainium / Graviton、スケールでの Meta-Graviton CPU)。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が **増分 GPU capex を Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限でゲーティング** する — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」となる。NVDA $5T クラスの時価総額と AMD / Cerebras IPO 軌道は維持される。支出曲線は折れないが、その開示言語は折れる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Las publicaciones de Mag 7 + FOMC del 28-29 de abril fuerzan la primera divulgación de **capex con margen-por-token gateado** desde un hyperscaler para Q3 2026 — el pacto OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril + el acuerdo Anthropic/AWS Trainium a nivel de silicio anclan la nueva doctrina.** El capex combinado de Mag 7 de ~$700B para 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 tendiendo a ~$170B FY27) aterriza en una cinta que ya ha pasado de "recompensar el capex con fe" a "exigir ganancia tangible." **Las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril enrutan explícitamente la computación de los AI-labs a través del silicio propiedad del hyperscaler** (AWS Trainium/Graviton con Anthropic; CPUs Meta-Graviton a escala). Para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler **gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — primer "umbral de ROI de AI-infra" explícito de un cloud público. La capitalización de mercado de NVDA tipo $5T y la trayectoria de IPO AMD/Cerebras se mantienen; la curva de gasto no se rompe, pero su lenguaje de divulgación sí. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 ay magpipilit sa unang **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure mula sa hyperscaler pagsapit ng Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal ang nag-aanchor sa bagong doctrine.** Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 capex na ~$700B para sa 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending sa ~$170B FY27) ay tumatama sa tape na lumipat na mula sa "rewarding capex on faith" patungo sa "demanding tangible profit." **Ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay tahasang nagru-route ng AI-lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton kasama ang Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs sa scale). Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI-infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud. Ang NVDA $5T-class market cap at AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory ay nananatili; hindi mababasag ang spend curve, ngunit ang disclosure language nito ay babasagin. Combined with the Mag-7 print collision today + ~$700B aggregated 2026 capex + the Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), Wall Street is now **explicitly demanding tangible AI-economics disclosure, not narrative**. By Q3 2026 the SEC + analyst pressure produces (a) at least one foundation lab moving to a public monthly revenue / WAU dashboard cadence, and (b) at least one Big-3 cloud separating per-token AI-platform margin in the 10-Q footnotes. The "AGI" word goes from metaphysical to financial-instrument; "DAU/WAU" goes from product KPI to MD&A. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang SEC + analyst pressure ay magbubunga ng (a) kahit isang foundation lab na lumipat sa public monthly revenue / WAU dashboard cadence, at (b) kahit isang Big-3 cloud na maghihiwalay ng per-token AI-platform margin sa 10-Q footnotes. Ang salitang "AGI" ay magiging mula metaphysical patungo sa financial-instrument; ang "DAU/WAU" ay magiging mula product KPI patungo sa MD&A. description.es: **El reporte del WSJ del 28 abr sobre la falta de revenue de OpenAI + la colisión de prints Mag 7 del 29 abr dispara un push 2026 SEC + analistas para la reescritura de la disclosure de revenue de IA — para Q3 2026 al menos un foundation lab (OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) lanza una cadencia auditada de disclosure mensual de revenue o WAU, y al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 separa el margen por token de Bedrock / Azure-OpenAI / Vertex en notas al pie del 10-Q frente al revenue cloud crudo.** El selloff del 28 abr (S&P -0,49%, Nasdaq -0,9%, Oracle -4%, AMD -3%, Broadcom -4%, SoftBank -10%) fue la primera grieta material en el tape de capex-IA-por-fe; los prints del 29 abr fueron un reset mixto (MSFT/GOOGL pegaron fuerte, META -7% AH); los prints del 30 abr de AAPL cierran el ciclo Mag 7. Microsoft ya citó un AI run rate de $37B (+123%) explícitamente — ese es el precedente de disclosure. Con el IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo a $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI concentración de revenue), la presión SEC + buyside por divulgación explícita de margen por token + WAU converge en torno a los ciclos de earnings Q2-Q3 2026. La elección de Powell de quedarse en la Junta como contrapeso a la investigación de la Fed por la administración Trump también eleva la prima de riesgo político sobre todo el tape de capex-IA; exigir números más duros es la palanca que tienen los mercados públicos. summary.fil: **Ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss report + Apr 29 Mag 7 print collision ay magpapasimula ng 2026 SEC + analyst push para sa AI-revenue disclosure rewrite — pagsapit ng Q3 2026 hindi bababa sa isang foundation lab (OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) ang magpapadala ng audited monthly-revenue o WAU disclosure cadence, at hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler ang maghihiwalay ng Bedrock / Azure-OpenAI / Vertex per-token margin sa 10-Q footnotes mula sa raw cloud revenue.** Apr 28 selloff (S&P -0.49%, Nasdaq -0.9%, Oracle -4%, AMD -3%, Broadcom -4%, SoftBank -10%) ang unang materyal na bitak sa AI-capex-on-faith tape; Apr 29 prints ay halo-halong reset (MSFT/GOOGL beat hard, META -7% AH); Apr 30 AAPL prints ay magsasara ng Mag 7 cycle. Tahasang binanggit na ng Microsoft ang $37B AI run rate (+123%) — iyan ang disclosure precedent. Sa Cerebras IPO sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo sa $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), ang SEC + buyside pressure para sa explicit per-token margin + WAU disclosure ay nagsasama-sama sa paligid ng Q2-Q3 2026 earnings cycles. detail.description: **The Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss report + Apr 29 Mag 7 print collision triggers a 2026 SEC + analyst push for AI-revenue disclosure rewrite — by Q3 2026 at least one foundation lab (OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) ships an audited monthly-revenue or WAU disclosure cadence, and at least one Big-3 hyperscaler separates Bedrock / Azure-OpenAI / Vertex per-token margin in 10-Q footnotes from raw cloud revenue.** Apr 28 selloff (S&P -0.49%, Nasdaq -0.9%, Oracle -4%, AMD -3%, Broadcom -4%, SoftBank -10%) was the first material crack in the AI-capex-on-faith tape; Apr 29 prints were a mixed reset (MSFT/GOOGL beat hard, META -7% AH); Apr 30 AAPL prints close the Mag 7 cycle. Microsoft already cited a $37B AI run rate (+123%) explicitly — that is the disclosure precedent. With the Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), the SEC + buyside pressure for explicit per-token margin + WAU disclosure converges around Q2-Q3 2026 earnings cycles. Powell's choice to stay on Board as a check on Trump-admin Fed investigation also raises the political-risk premium on the entire AI-capex tape; demanding harder numbers is the lever public markets have.

La elección de Powell de quedarse en la Junta como contrapeso a la investigación de la Fed por la administración Trump también eleva la prima de riesgo político sobre todo el tape de capex-IA; exigir números más duros es la palanca que tienen los mercados públicos. Tahasang binanggit na ng Microsoft ang $37B AI run rate (+123%) — iyan ang disclosure precedent. Sa Cerebras IPO sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo sa $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), ang SEC + buyside pressure para sa explicit per-token margin + WAU disclosure ay nagsasama-sama sa paligid ng Q2-Q3 2026 earnings cycles. Ang pagpili ni Powell na manatili sa Board bilang check sa Trump-admin Fed investigation ay nagtataas din ng political-risk premium sa buong AI-capex tape; ang paghingi ng mas matitigas na numero ay ang lever na hawak ng public markets.

nodes.description: **Powell's Apr 29 decision to remain on the Board of Governors past his Chair-term expiration (May 15) reshapes 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — by Q4 2026 the FOMC reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) under Warsh as Chair, but Powell's continued Board presence becomes the marginal swing vote on the Fed-investigation governance question, not on rates.** Apr 29 was the highest-dissent FOMC since Oct-1992 (8-4); Miran wanted -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan opposed easing-bias inclusion. Warsh nomination advanced from Senate Banking same day. The 2026-2027 setup: Powell on Board through term-end 2028 with Warsh in the Chair seat; the dissent posture compresses on rate calls because the Chair sets the framing; Powell's marginal vote becomes a governance signal whenever the Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome moves. Markets price a smaller forward-guidance volatility on rates but a larger institutional-risk premium on the Fed itself. The 1992-precedent comparison stops being a curiosity and starts being a structural reference point in financial-press explanations of the new Fed governance regime.

description.en: **Powell's Apr 29 decision to remain on the Board of Governors past his Chair-term expiration (May 15) reshapes 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — by Q4 2026 the FOMC reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) under Warsh as Chair, but Powell's continued Board presence becomes the marginal swing vote on the Fed-investigation governance question, not on rates.** Apr 29 was the highest-dissent FOMC since Oct-1992 (8-4); Miran wanted -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan opposed easing-bias inclusion. Warsh nomination advanced from Senate Banking same day. The 2026-2027 setup: Powell on Board through term-end 2028 with Warsh in the Chair seat; the dissent posture compresses on rate calls because the Chair sets the framing; Powell's marginal vote becomes a governance signal whenever the Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome moves. Markets price a smaller forward-guidance volatility on rates but a larger institutional-risk premium on the Fed itself. The 1992-precedent comparison stops being a curiosity and starts being a structural reference point in financial-press explanations of the new Fed governance regime.
description.ja: **Powellの4月29日の決定 — 議長任期満了(5月15日)後も理事会に残る — が2026年の金融政策市場心理を再構築する — 2026年Q4までに、FOMCはWarsh議長の下でより小規模な反対(≤2人の反対者)規範に戻るが、Powellの理事会継続的存在は金利ではなくFRB調査ガバナンス問題に関する限界スイング票となる。** 4月29日は1992年10月以来最高の反対(8-4)のFOMCだった。Miranは-25bpを希望、Hammack/Kashkari/Loganは緩和バイアス採用に反対した。Warsh指名は同日上院銀行委員会から進展した。2026-2027年のセットアップ:Powellは2028年の任期末まで理事会、Warshは議長席に着席。議長がフレーミングを設定するため反対姿勢は金利関連で圧縮される。Powellの限界票は、トランプ政権のFRB調査結果が動くたびにガバナンスシグナルとなる。市場は金利に関するフォワードガイダンスのボラティリティの低下を織り込む一方、FRB自体への制度リスクプレミアムの上昇を織り込む。1992年先例の比較は珍奇なものではなくなり、新しいFRBガバナンス体制の金融プレス解説における構造的な参照点となり始める。
description.es: **La decisión de Powell del 29 abr de permanecer en la Board of Governors más allá de la expiración de su mandato como Chair (15 may) reconfigura la psicología de mercado de política monetaria 2026 — para Q4 2026 el FOMC revierte a una norma de menor disenso (≤2 disidentes) bajo Warsh como Chair, pero la presencia continua de Powell en la Junta se vuelve el voto bisagra marginal sobre la cuestión de gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed, no sobre tasas.** El 29 abr fue el FOMC con más disenso desde oct-1992 (8-4); Miran quería -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan se opusieron a incluir un sesgo flexibilizador. La nominación de Warsh avanzó desde el Senate Banking ese mismo día. La configuración 2026-2027: Powell en la Junta hasta el final de su mandato en 2028 con Warsh en el asiento de Chair; la postura de disenso se comprime en decisiones de tasas porque el Chair fija el encuadre; el voto marginal de Powell se vuelve una señal de gobernanza cada vez que se mueve el resultado de la investigación a la Fed por la administración Trump. Los mercados precian menor volatilidad de forward-guidance sobre tasas pero una prima de riesgo institucional mayor sobre la propia Fed. La comparación con el precedente de 1992 deja de ser una curiosidad y empieza a ser un punto de referencia estructural en las explicaciones de la prensa financiera del nuevo régimen de gobernanza de la Fed. description.fil: **Ang desisyon ni Powell noong Apr 29 na manatili sa Board of Governors lampas sa pagtatapos ng kanyang Chair-term (May 15) ay nagbabago sa 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — pagsapit ng Q4 2026 ang FOMC ay babalik sa smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) sa ilalim ni Warsh bilang Chair, ngunit ang patuloy na presensya ni Powell sa Board ay nagiging marginal swing vote sa Fed-investigation governance question, hindi sa rates.** Apr 29 ang pinakamataas na dissent na FOMC mula noong Oct-1992 (8-4); gusto ni Miran ng -25bp; tumutol sina Hammack/Kashkari/Logan sa pagsasama ng easing-bias. Sumulong ang Warsh nomination mula sa Senate Banking sa parehong araw. Ang 2026-2027 setup: si Powell sa Board hanggang term-end 2028 kasama si Warsh sa Chair seat; ang dissent posture ay sumasaayos sa rate calls dahil itinatakda ng Chair ang framing; ang marginal vote ni Powell ay nagiging governance signal kapag ang Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome ay gumagalaw. Ang mga merkado ay nagpe-presyo ng mas maliit na forward-guidance volatility sa rates ngunit mas malaking institutional-risk premium sa Fed mismo. Ang 1992-precedent comparison ay tumitigil sa pagiging curiosity at nagsisimulang maging structural reference point sa financial-press explanations ng bagong Fed governance regime.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: **Powell's Apr 29 decision to remain on the Board of Governors past his Chair-term expiration (May 15) reshapes 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — by Q4 2026 the FOMC reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) under Warsh as Chair, but Powell's continued Board presence becomes the marginal swing vote on the Fed-investigation governance question, not on rates.** Apr 29 was the highest-dissent FOMC since Oct-1992 (8-4); Miran wanted -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan opposed easing-bias inclusion. Warsh nomination advanced from Senate Banking same day. The 2026-2027 setup: Powell on Board through term-end 2028 with Warsh in the Chair seat; the dissent posture compresses on rate calls because the Chair sets the framing; Powell's marginal vote becomes a governance signal whenever the Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome moves. Markets price a smaller forward-guidance volatility on rates but a larger institutional-risk premium on the Fed itself. The 1992-precedent comparison stops being a curiosity and starts being a structural reference point in financial-press explanations of the new Fed governance regime.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **Powellの4月29日の決定 — 議長任期満了(5月15日)後も理事会に残る — が2026年の金融政策市場心理を再構築する — 2026年Q4までに、FOMCはWarsh議長の下でより小規模な反対(≤2人の反対者)規範に戻るが、Powellの理事会継続的存在は金利ではなくFRB調査ガバナンス問題に関する限界スイング票となる。** 4月29日は1992年10月以来最高の反対(8-4)のFOMCだった。Miranは-25bpを希望、Hammack/Kashkari/Loganは緩和バイアス採用に反対した。Warsh指名は同日上院銀行委員会から進展した。2026-2027年のセットアップ:Powellは2028年の任期末まで理事会、Warshは議長席に着席。議長がフレーミングを設定するため反対姿勢は金利関連で圧縮される。Powellの限界票は、トランプ政権のFRB調査結果が動くたびにガバナンスシグナルとなる。市場は金利に関するフォワードガイダンスのボラティリティの低下を織り込む一方、FRB自体への制度リスクプレミアムの上昇を織り込む。1992年先例の比較は珍奇なものではなくなり、新しいFRBガバナンス体制の金融プレス解説における構造的な参照点となり始める。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **La decisión de Powell del 29 abr de permanecer en la Board of Governors más allá de la expiración de su mandato como Chair (15 may) reconfigura la psicología de mercado de política monetaria 2026 — para Q4 2026 el FOMC revierte a una norma de menor disenso (≤2 disidentes) bajo Warsh como Chair, pero la presencia continua de Powell en la Junta se vuelve el voto bisagra marginal sobre la cuestión de gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed, no sobre tasas.** El 29 abr fue el FOMC con más disenso desde oct-1992 (8-4); Miran quería -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan se opusieron a incluir un sesgo flexibilizador. La nominación de Warsh avanzó desde el Senate Banking ese mismo día. La configuración 2026-2027: Powell en la Junta hasta el final de su mandato en 2028 con Warsh en el asiento de Chair; la postura de disenso se comprime en decisiones de tasas porque el Chair fija el encuadre; el voto marginal de Powell se vuelve una señal de gobernanza cada vez que se mueve el resultado de la investigación a la Fed por la administración Trump. Los mercados precian menor volatilidad de forward-guidance sobre tasas pero una prima de riesgo institucional mayor sobre la propia Fed. La comparación con el precedente de 1992 deja de ser una curiosidad y empieza a ser un punto de referencia estructural en las explicaciones de la prensa financiera del nuevo régimen de gobernanza de la Fed. Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss + Apr 29 Mag 7 mixed reset (META -7.5%, MSFT -3.8% on print day) shows public-market price discrimination is already operating on imprecise AI-revenue numbers; the path of least resistance is for the most-disclosing hyperscaler to set the precedent and force the cohort to follow. description.ja: Mag 7スーパーウィーク+7,000億ドル-2026年AI設備投資プリント+4月30日のApple +1,000億ドル-自社株買い／4%-配当増の組み合わせは、2026年をAI設備投資開示が2つの報告ケイデンスに分裂する年として確定する ― 2026年Q4までに、少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラー(4月29日の370億ドルAIランレート前例を踏まえると、Microsoftの可能性が最も高い)が監査済みの月次AIビジネスKPI(ランレート、有料席、展開済みエージェント)を10-Qフットノートとして公表し、より広範なS&P AIコホート(Apple、IPO後のCerebras、Broadcom)が四半期ごとのAIビジネス別マージン開示で追随する。4月29日のMicrosoftの370億ドルAIランレート(+123%)は開示の前例であり、4月30日のAppleの記録的なサービス収益309.8億ドル(+16%)はAIサービスの個別ラインを含まなかった。4月30日のビッグテックの1,300億ドル超のQ1設備投資(Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon)は2026年の7,000億ドル設備投資への道のりであり、買い手側の圧力数値である。5月中旬のCerebras IPOは220億～250億ドルの評価額で、収益集中度はG42 24%／MBZUAI 62%であり、開示のストレステストである。4月28日のWSJ OpenAI収益不振+4月29日のMag 7混合リセット(プリント当日にMETA -7.5%、MSFT -3.8%)は、公開市場の価格差別が既に不正確なAI収益数値で動いていることを示している。最も抵抗の少ないパスは、最も開示するハイパースケーラーが前例を作り、コホートに追随を強制することである。SECは自主開示に先立って行動する必要はない ― 買い手側がここで強制関数となる。
description.es: La super-semana Mag 7 + el print de capex-IA-2026 de $700B + la combinación recompra de +$100B / alza de dividendo del 4% de Apple del 30 abr cementan 2026 como el año en que la disclosure de capex IA se divide en dos cadencias de reporte — para Q4 2026, al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 (muy probablemente Microsoft, dado el precedente del run-rate IA de $37B del 29 abr) publica KPIs auditados mensuales de AI-business (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) como nota al pie del 10-Q; el cohorte S&P AI más amplio (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) sigue con disclosure trimestral de margen por AI-business. El run-rate IA de $37B (+123%) de Microsoft del 29 abr fue el precedente de disclosure; el récord de Services de $30.98B (+16%) de Apple del 30 abr no incluyó línea separada de AI-services; el capex Q1 de Big Tech de $130B+ del 30 abr (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) en camino a $700B de capex 2026 es el número de presión buyside; el IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo a $22-25B con concentración de revenue 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI es el stress-test de disclosure. El miss de revenue de OpenAI del WSJ del 28 abr + el reset mixto Mag 7 del 29 abr (META -7,5%, MSFT -3,8% en día de print) muestra que la price discrimination de mercado público ya está operando sobre números imprecisos de revenue IA; el camino de menor resistencia es que el hyperscaler más-disclosing fije el precedente y fuerce al cohorte a seguir. La SEC no necesitará actuar antes de la disclosure voluntaria aquí — el buyside es la función forzante.
description.fil: Ang kombinasyon ng Mag 7 super-week + $700B-2026-AI-capex print + Apr 30 Apple +$100B-buyback / 4%-dividend-hike ay magpapatatag sa 2026 bilang taon kung kailan ang AI-capex disclosure ay mahahati sa dalawang reporting cadences — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler (malamang Microsoft, dahil sa Apr 29 $37B AI run-rate precedent) ang maglalathala ng audited monthly AI-business KPIs (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) bilang 10-Q footnote; susunod ang mas malawak na S&P AI cohort (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) na may quarterly per-AI-business margin disclosure. Ang Apr 29 Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate (+123%) ang disclosure precedent; ang Apr 30 Apple's record Services $30.98B (+16%) ay hindi naglakip ng hiwalay na AI-services line; ang Apr 30 Big Tech $130B+ Q1 capex (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) papunta sa $700B 2026 capex ang buyside-pressure number; ang mid-May Cerebras IPO sa $22-25B na may 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration ay ang disclosure stress-test. Ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss + Apr 29 Mag 7 mixed reset (META -7.5%, MSFT -3.8% sa print day) ay nagpapakita na ang public-market price discrimination ay umaandar na sa imprecise AI-revenue numbers; ang path of least resistance ay para sa pinaka-disclosing hyperscaler na magtakda ng precedent at piliting sundin ng cohort. Hindi na kailangang mag-act ang SEC bago ang voluntary disclosure dito — ang buyside ang forcing function.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: The Mag 7 super-week + $700B-2026-AI-capex print + Apr 30 Apple +$100B-buyback / 4%-dividend-hike combination cements 2026 as the year AI-capex disclosure splits into two reporting cadences — by Q4 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler (most likely Microsoft, given the Apr 29 $37B AI run-rate precedent) publishes audited monthly AI-business KPIs (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) as a 10-Q footnote; the broader S&P AI cohort (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) follows with quarterly per-AI-business margin disclosure. Apr 29 Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate (+123%) was the disclosure precedent; Apr 30 Apple's record Services $30.98B (+16%) included no separate AI-services line; Apr 30 Big Tech $130B+ Q1 capex (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) on the way to $700B 2026 capex is the buyside-pressure number; mid-May Cerebras IPO at $22-25B with 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration is the disclosure stress-test. Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss + Apr 29 Mag 7 mixed reset (META -7.5%, MSFT -3.8% on print day) shows public-market price discrimination is already operating on imprecise AI-revenue numbers; the path of least resistance is for the most-disclosing hyperscaler to set the precedent and force the cohort to follow. SEC will not need to act ahead of voluntary disclosure here — the buyside is the forcing function.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Mag 7スーパーウィーク+7,000億ドル-2026年AI設備投資プリント+4月30日のApple +1,000億ドル-自社株買い／4%-配当増の組み合わせは、2026年をAI設備投資開示が2つの報告ケイデンスに分裂する年として確定する ― 2026年Q4までに、少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラー(4月29日の370億ドルAIランレート前例を踏まえると、Microsoftの可能性が最も高い)が監査済みの月次AIビジネスKPI(ランレート、有料席、展開済みエージェント)を10-Qフットノートとして公表し、より広範なS&P AIコホート(Apple、IPO後のCerebras、Broadcom)が四半期ごとのAIビジネス別マージン開示で追随する。4月29日のMicrosoftの370億ドルAIランレート(+123%)は開示の前例であり、4月30日のAppleの記録的なサービス収益309.8億ドル(+16%)はAIサービスの個別ラインを含まなかった。4月30日のビッグテックの1,300億ドル超のQ1設備投資(Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon)は2026年の7,000億ドル設備投資への道のりであり、買い手側の圧力数値である。5月中旬のCerebras IPOは220億～250億ドルの評価額で、収益集中度はG42 24%／MBZUAI 62%であり、開示のストレステストである。4月28日のWSJ OpenAI収益不振+4月29日のMag 7混合リセット(プリント当日にMETA -7.5%、MSFT -3.8%)は、公開市場の価格差別が既に不正確なAI収益数値で動いていることを示している。最も抵抗の少ないパスは、最も開示するハイパースケーラーが前例を作り、コホートに追随を強制することである。SECは自主開示に先立って行動する必要はない ― 買い手側がここで強制関数となる。
prediction_summary_locales.es: La super-semana Mag 7 + el print de capex-IA-2026 de $700B + la combinación recompra de +$100B / alza de dividendo del 4% de Apple del 30 abr cementan 2026 como el año en que la disclosure de capex IA se divide en dos cadencias de reporte — para Q4 2026, al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 (muy probablemente Microsoft, dado el precedente del run-rate IA de $37B del 29 abr) publica KPIs auditados mensuales de AI-business (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) como nota al pie del 10-Q; el cohorte S&P AI más amplio (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) sigue con disclosure trimestral de margen por AI-business. El run-rate IA de $37B (+123%) de Microsoft del 29 abr fue el precedente de disclosure; el récord de Services de $30.98B (+16%) de Apple del 30 abr no incluyó línea separada de AI-services; el capex Q1 de Big Tech de $130B+ del 30 abr (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) en camino a $700B de capex 2026 es el número de presión buyside; el IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo a $22-25B con concentración de revenue 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI es el stress-test de disclosure. El miss de revenue de OpenAI del WSJ del 28 abr + el reset mixto Mag 7 del 29 abr (META -7,5%, MSFT -3,8% en día de print) muestra que la price discrimination de mercado público ya está operando sobre números imprecisos de revenue IA; el camino de menor resistencia es que el hyperscaler más-disclosing fije el precedente y fuerce al cohorte a seguir. La SEC no necesitará actuar antes de la disclosure voluntaria aquí — el buyside es la función forzante.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Ang kombinasyon ng Mag 7 super-week + $700B-2026-AI-capex print + Apr 30 Apple +$100B-buyback / 4%-dividend-hike ay magpapatatag sa 2026 bilang taon kung kailan ang AI-capex disclosure ay mahahati sa dalawang reporting cadences — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler (malamang Microsoft, dahil sa Apr 29 $37B AI run-rate precedent) ang maglalathala ng audited monthly AI-business KPIs (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) bilang 10-Q footnote; susunod ang mas malawak na S&P AI cohort (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) na may quarterly per-AI-business margin disclosure. Ang Apr 29 Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate (+123%) ang disclosure precedent; ang Apr 30 Apple's record Services $30.98B (+16%) ay hindi naglakip ng hiwalay na AI-services line; ang Apr 30 Big Tech $130B+ Q1 capex (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) papunta sa $700B 2026 capex ang buyside-pressure number; ang mid-May Cerebras IPO sa $22-25B na may 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration ay ang disclosure stress-test. Ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss + Apr 29 Mag 7 mixed reset (META -7.5%, MSFT -3.8% sa print day) ay nagpapakita na ang public-market price discrimination ay umaandar na sa imprecise AI-revenue numbers; ang path of least resistance ay para sa pinaka-disclosing hyperscaler na magtakda ng precedent at piliting sundin ng cohort. Hindi na kailangang mag-act ang SEC bago ang voluntary disclosure dito — ang buyside ang forcing function.

nodes.title: FOMC reverts to <=2-dissent norm as Powell-Warsh split shifts Fed by Q4 2026
nodes.description: Powell's decision to stay on the Federal Reserve Board through 2028 + the Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) + the May 1 Apr-jobs print at the front of the May 15 Chair handoff window shifts 2026 monetary-policy market psychology from rate-volatility to institutional-volatility — by Q4 2026 the FOMC under Warsh as Chair reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2) on rate calls but the Powell-Warsh disagreement on Fed-investigation governance becomes the marginal swing-vote on any Fed-independence question; equity-market AI-capex re-rating events become more sensitive to Fed-Board signaling than to FOMC statement language. Apr 29 was the first 4-dissenter FOMC since 1992; Powell-staying-on-Board is unprecedented since 1948; Warsh confirmed by Senate Banking on Apr 29 with full-Senate vote scheduled before May 15; Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) is partially priced on rate-cut hopes that the FOMC dissent posture has not yet validated; May 1 Apr jobs print at the consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) is the first weakening data into the handoff window. The "Powell as shadow chair" framing was specifically rejected by Powell on Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") but the institutional reality of a 7-member Board with Powell as a dissenting governor under a Warsh chair creates exactly that dynamic on Fed-independence questions, even if not on rates. Markets will compress rate-volatility pricing and inflate institutional-risk pricing through 2026 H2.

description.ja: Powellの2028年までの連邦準備制度理事会への留任決定+4月29日の8-4反対票(1992年10月以来最高)+5月15日の議長交代ウィンドウ前面の5月1日4月雇用統計プリントは、2026年の金融政策市場心理を金利ボラティリティから制度的ボラティリティへとシフトさせる ― 2026年Q4までにWarsh議長下のFOMCは金利決定で小規模な反対票標準(2票以下)に戻るが、Fed調査ガバナンスに関するPowell-Warshの不一致が連邦準備制度の独立性に関する問題での限界スイング票となり、株式市場のAI設備投資再評価イベントはFOMC声明の文言よりも理事会のシグナリングに敏感になる。4月29日は1992年以来初の4反対票FOMCであり、Powellの理事会留任は1948年以来前例がなく、Warshは4月29日に上院銀行委員会で承認され、5月15日前に上院本会議投票が予定されている。4月30日のMag-7月次テープ(2020年以来最高の月)はFOMC反対姿勢がまだ検証していない利下げ期待で部分的に価格設定されている。5月1日の4月雇用統計プリントはコンセンサス13.5万件(3月17.8万件比)で、交代ウィンドウへの最初の弱含みデータである。「シャドウ議長としてのPowell」フレーミングは4月29日にPowellによって明確に拒否された(「私はシャドウ議長にはならない」)が、Warsh議長下で反対票理事としてのPowellを伴う7名理事会の制度的現実は、金利ではないにせよ、Fed独立性の問題でまさにそのダイナミクスを生み出す。市場は2026年下半期を通じて金利ボラティリティ価格を圧縮し、制度的リスク価格を膨張させるだろう。
description.es: La decisión de Powell de quedarse en la Federal Reserve Board hasta 2028 + el disenso 8-4 del 29 abr (el más alto desde oct-1992) + el print de empleo de abril del 1 may al frente del ventana de handoff del Chair del 15 may desplaza la psicología de mercado de política monetaria 2026 de rate-volatility a institutional-volatility — para Q4 2026 el FOMC bajo Warsh como Chair revierte a una norma de menor disenso (≤2) en decisiones de tasas pero el desacuerdo Powell-Warsh sobre gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed se vuelve el voto bisagra marginal en cualquier cuestión de Fed-independence; los eventos de re-rating de capex IA del mercado equity se vuelven más sensibles al señaling de la Fed-Board que al lenguaje del statement del FOMC. El 29 abr fue el primer FOMC con 4 disidentes desde 1992; Powell-quedarse-en-Board no tiene precedente desde 1948; Warsh confirmado por Senate Banking el 29 abr con voto del Senado completo programado antes del 15 may; el tape mensual Mag-7 del 30 abr (mejor mes desde 2020) está parcialmente preciado sobre esperanzas de rate-cut que la postura de disenso del FOMC aún no ha validado; el print de empleo de abril del 1 may al consenso de 135K (vs 178K de marzo) es la primera data de debilitamiento dentro de la ventana de handoff. El framing de "Powell como shadow chair" fue específicamente rechazado por Powell el 29 abr ("No seré un shadow chair") pero la realidad institucional de una Board de 7 miembros con Powell como gobernador disidente bajo un Chair Warsh crea exactamente esa dinámica en cuestiones de Fed-independence, aunque no en tasas. Los mercados comprimirán el pricing de rate-volatility e inflarán el pricing de institutional-risk a través del H2 2026.
description.fil: Ang desisyon ni Powell na manatili sa Federal Reserve Board hanggang 2028 + ang Apr 29 8-4 dissent (pinakamataas mula Oct-1992) + ang May 1 Apr-jobs print sa harap ng May 15 Chair handoff window ay maglilipat ng 2026 monetary-policy market psychology mula rate-volatility patungo sa institutional-volatility — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang FOMC sa ilalim ni Warsh bilang Chair ay babalik sa smaller-dissent norm (≤2) sa rate calls ngunit ang Powell-Warsh disagreement sa Fed-investigation governance ay magiging marginal swing-vote sa anumang Fed-independence question; ang equity-market AI-capex re-rating events ay magiging mas sensitibo sa Fed-Board signaling kaysa sa FOMC statement language. Ang Apr 29 ang unang 4-dissenter FOMC mula 1992; ang Powell-staying-on-Board ay walang pang precedent mula 1948; kinumpirma si Warsh ng Senate Banking noong Apr 29 na may full-Senate vote na nakaiskedyul bago ang May 15; ang Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) ay bahagyang naka-price sa rate-cut hopes na hindi pa na-validate ng FOMC dissent posture; ang May 1 Apr jobs print sa consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) ang unang weakening data papasok sa handoff window. Ang "Powell as shadow chair" framing ay partikular na tinanggihan ni Powell noong Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") ngunit ang institutional reality ng 7-member Board kasama si Powell bilang dissenting governor sa ilalim ng Warsh chair ay lumilikha mismo ng dynamic na iyon sa mga Fed-independence questions, kahit na hindi sa rates. Mag-co-compress ang markets ng rate-volatility pricing at mag-iinflate ng institutional-risk pricing hanggang 2026 H2.

summary.en: Powell's decision to stay on the Federal Reserve Board through 2028 + the Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) + the May 1 Apr-jobs print at the front of the May 15 Chair handoff window shifts 2026 monetary-policy market psychology from rate-volatility to institutional-volatility — by Q4 2026 the FOMC under Warsh as Chair reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2) on rate calls but the Powell-Warsh disagreement on Fed-investigation governance becomes the marginal swing-vote on any Fed-independence question; equity-market AI-capex re-rating events become more sensitive to Fed-Board signaling than to FOMC statement language. detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: Powell's decision to stay on the Federal Reserve Board through 2028 + the Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) + the May 1 Apr-jobs print at the front of the May 15 Chair handoff window shifts 2026 monetary-policy market psychology from rate-volatility to institutional-volatility — by Q4 2026 the FOMC under Warsh as Chair reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2) on rate calls but the Powell-Warsh disagreement on Fed-investigation governance becomes the marginal swing-vote on any Fed-independence question; equity-market AI-capex re-rating events become more sensitive to Fed-Board signaling than to FOMC statement language. Apr 29 was the first 4-dissenter FOMC since 1992; Powell-staying-on-Board is unprecedented since 1948; Warsh confirmed by Senate Banking on Apr 29 with full-Senate vote scheduled before May 15; Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) is partially priced on rate-cut hopes that the FOMC dissent posture has not yet validated; May 1 Apr jobs print at the consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) is the first weakening data into the handoff window. The "Powell as shadow chair" framing was specifically rejected by Powell on Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") but the institutional reality of a 7-member Board with Powell as a dissenting governor under a Warsh chair creates exactly that dynamic on Fed-independence questions, even if not on rates. Markets will compress rate-volatility pricing and inflate institutional-risk pricing through 2026 H2.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Powellの2028年までの連邦準備制度理事会への留任決定+4月29日の8-4反対票(1992年10月以来最高)+5月15日の議長交代ウィンドウ前面の5月1日4月雇用統計プリントは、2026年の金融政策市場心理を金利ボラティリティから制度的ボラティリティへとシフトさせる ― 2026年Q4までにWarsh議長下のFOMCは金利決定で小規模な反対票標準(2票以下)に戻るが、Fed調査ガバナンスに関するPowell-Warshの不一致が連邦準備制度の独立性に関する問題での限界スイング票となり、株式市場のAI設備投資再評価イベントはFOMC声明の文言よりも理事会のシグナリングに敏感になる。4月29日は1992年以来初の4反対票FOMCであり、Powellの理事会留任は1948年以来前例がなく、Warshは4月29日に上院銀行委員会で承認され、5月15日前に上院本会議投票が予定されている。4月30日のMag-7月次テープ(2020年以来最高の月)はFOMC反対姿勢がまだ検証していない利下げ期待で部分的に価格設定されている。5月1日の4月雇用統計プリントはコンセンサス13.5万件(3月17.8万件比)で、交代ウィンドウへの最初の弱含みデータである。「シャドウ議長としてのPowell」フレーミングは4月29日にPowellによって明確に拒否された(「私はシャドウ議長にはならない」)が、Warsh議長下で反対票理事としてのPowellを伴う7名理事会の制度的現実は、金利ではないにせよ、Fed独立性の問題でまさにそのダイナミクスを生み出す。市場は2026年下半期を通じて金利ボラティリティ価格を圧縮し、制度的リスク価格を膨張させるだろう。
prediction_summary_locales.es: La decisión de Powell de quedarse en la Federal Reserve Board hasta 2028 + el disenso 8-4 del 29 abr (el más alto desde oct-1992) + el print de empleo de abril del 1 may al frente del ventana de handoff del Chair del 15 may desplaza la psicología de mercado de política monetaria 2026 de rate-volatility a institutional-volatility — para Q4 2026 el FOMC bajo Warsh como Chair revierte a una norma de menor disenso (≤2) en decisiones de tasas pero el desacuerdo Powell-Warsh sobre gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed se vuelve el voto bisagra marginal en cualquier cuestión de Fed-independence; los eventos de re-rating de capex IA del mercado equity se vuelven más sensibles al señaling de la Fed-Board que al lenguaje del statement del FOMC. El 29 abr fue el primer FOMC con 4 disidentes desde 1992; Powell-quedarse-en-Board no tiene precedente desde 1948; Warsh confirmado por Senate Banking el 29 abr con voto del Senado completo programado antes del 15 may; el tape mensual Mag-7 del 30 abr (mejor mes desde 2020) está parcialmente preciado sobre esperanzas de rate-cut que la postura de disenso del FOMC aún no ha validado; el print de empleo de abril del 1 may al consenso de 135K (vs 178K de marzo) es la primera data de debilitamiento dentro de la ventana de handoff. El framing de "Powell como shadow chair" fue específicamente rechazado por Powell el 29 abr ("No seré un shadow chair") pero la realidad institucional de una Board de 7 miembros con Powell como gobernador disidente bajo un Chair Warsh crea exactamente esa dinámica en cuestiones de Fed-independence, aunque no en tasas. Los mercados comprimirán el pricing de rate-volatility e inflarán el pricing de institutional-risk a través del H2 2026.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Ang desisyon ni Powell na manatili sa Federal Reserve Board hanggang 2028 + ang Apr 29 8-4 dissent (pinakamataas mula Oct-1992) + ang May 1 Apr-jobs print sa harap ng May 15 Chair handoff window ay maglilipat ng 2026 monetary-policy market psychology mula rate-volatility patungo sa institutional-volatility — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang FOMC sa ilalim ni Warsh bilang Chair ay babalik sa smaller-dissent norm (≤2) sa rate calls ngunit ang Powell-Warsh disagreement sa Fed-investigation governance ay magiging marginal swing-vote sa anumang Fed-independence question; ang equity-market AI-capex re-rating events ay magiging mas sensitibo sa Fed-Board signaling kaysa sa FOMC statement language. Ang Apr 29 ang unang 4-dissenter FOMC mula 1992; ang Powell-staying-on-Board ay walang pang precedent mula 1948; kinumpirma si Warsh ng Senate Banking noong Apr 29 na may full-Senate vote na nakaiskedyul bago ang May 15; ang Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) ay bahagyang naka-price sa rate-cut hopes na hindi pa na-validate ng FOMC dissent posture; ang May 1 Apr jobs print sa consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) ang unang weakening data papasok sa handoff window. Ang "Powell as shadow chair" framing ay partikular na tinanggihan ni Powell noong Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") ngunit ang institutional reality ng 7-member Board kasama si Powell bilang dissenting governor sa ilalim ng Warsh chair ay lumilikha mismo ng dynamic na iyon sa mga Fed-independence questions, kahit na hindi sa rates. Mag-co-compress ang markets ng rate-volatility pricing at mag-iinflate ng institutional-risk pricing hanggang 2026 H2.

description.en: **The May 1 Pentagon-snubs-Anthropic + 7-vendor classified-network AI deal becomes the first US presidential-administration vs frontier-AI-lab autonomous-weapons-use line in the sand — by Q3 2026 at least two other frontier labs (Mistral, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Inflection-2026, Cohere) explicitly publish a use-of-force / autonomous-weapons carve-out in their public ToS or DoD bid responses; Anthropic's federal-judge-blocked Trump-admin freeze (April CA ruling) becomes the operative procurement-law precedent; Q3 earnings calls add an "autonomous-weapons exposure" disclosure line for the cohort.** Forcing function is litigation precedent: the federal-judge block already exists, so any future DoD freeze action against a competing lab now has a court-tested predicate. Trump's "deal is possible" framing on Apr 17 + the May 1 contract signings are the carrot-and-stick choreography; once a deal-or-no-deal binary becomes visible to the buyside, capital-allocation pressure will force every frontier-lab board to formally adopt either the Anthropic posture (carve-out, accept exclusion) or the OpenAI/Microsoft/Google posture (no carve-out, accept full DoD use). The middle position becomes untenable as soon as Q3 earnings cycle starts. In plain language: Anthropic's Pentagon snub forces every other AI lab to pick: take the contract or refuse it. In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **5月1日のペンタゴン-Anthropic排除 + 7ベンダー機密ネットワークAI契約が、米大統領政権 vs フロンティアAIラボの自律兵器使用の最初のレッドラインとなる — 2026年Q3までに、少なくとも他の2つのフロンティアラボ(Mistral、OpenAI、xAI、Google DeepMind、Inflection-2026、Cohere)が、武力使用 / 自律兵器カーブアウトを公開ToSまたはDoD入札応答で明示的に公開する;Anthropicの連邦判事ブロックされたTrump政権凍結(4月のCA判決)が運用調達法の判例となる;Q3決算コールがコホートに「自律兵器エクスポージャー」開示行を追加する。** 強制要因は訴訟先例:連邦判事のブロックがすでに存在するため、競合ラボに対する将来のDoD凍結措置には法廷で検証された予測が成立する。Trumpの4月17日「取引は可能」フレーミング + 5月1日の契約調印が飴と鞭の振付であり、取引可否のバイナリーがバイサイドに見えるようになると、資本配分圧力が、すべてのフロンティアラボの取締役会にAnthropic姿勢(カーブアウト、排除を受け入れる)またはOpenAI/Microsoft/Google姿勢(カーブアウトなし、完全なDoD利用を受け入れる)のいずれかを正式採用させる。Q3決算サイクルが始まると同時に中間ポジションは維持できなくなる。In plain language: AnthropicのペンタゴンスナブによってAIラボはどれも選択を迫られる:契約を取るか拒否するか。In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El desaire del Pentágono a Anthropic + el acuerdo de IA de red clasificada con 7 proveedores del 1 mayo se convierte en la primera línea en la arena entre la administración presidencial estadounidense y un laboratorio de IA frontera sobre el uso de armas autónomas — para el Q3 2026 al menos dos otros laboratorios frontera (Mistral, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Inflection-2026, Cohere) publicarán explícitamente una exclusión de uso de la fuerza / armas autónomas en sus ToS públicos o respuestas a licitaciones del DoD; la suspensión de la administración Trump bloqueada por un juez federal (decisión de abril en CA) se convierte en el precedente operativo de derecho de contratación; las llamadas de resultados del Q3 añadirán una línea de divulgación de "exposición a armas autónomas" para la cohorte.** La función forzante es el precedente jurídico: el bloqueo del juez federal ya existe, así que cualquier futura acción de suspensión del DoD contra un laboratorio competidor tiene ahora un predicado probado en tribunales. El encuadre de Trump del 17 abr de "un acuerdo es posible" + las firmas de contratos del 1 mayo son la coreografía del palo y la zanahoria; una vez que un binario acuerdo-o-no-acuerdo se vuelva visible para el lado comprador, la presión de asignación de capital obligará a cada consejo de laboratorio frontera a adoptar formalmente o la postura de Anthropic (exclusión, aceptar exclusión) o la postura de OpenAI/Microsoft/Google (sin exclusión, aceptar uso completo del DoD). La posición intermedia se vuelve insostenible en cuanto comience el ciclo de resultados Q3. En lenguaje claro: El desaire del Pentágono a Anthropic obliga a cada otro laboratorio de IA a elegir: tomar el contrato o rechazarlo. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
description.fil: **Ang May 1 Pentagon-snubs-Anthropic + 7-vendor classified-network AI deal ay nagiging unang US presidential-administration vs frontier-AI-lab autonomous-weapons-use line in the sand — pagsapit ng Q3 2026 hindi bababa sa dalawa pang frontier labs (Mistral, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Inflection-2026, Cohere) ay hayagang maglalathala ng use-of-force / autonomous-weapons carve-out sa kanilang public ToS o DoD bid responses; ang federal-judge-blocked Trump-admin freeze ng Anthropic (April CA ruling) ay nagiging operative procurement-law precedent; ang Q3 earnings calls ay magdadagdag ng "autonomous-weapons exposure" disclosure line para sa cohort.** Ang forcing function ay litigation precedent: nariyan na ang federal-judge block, kaya anumang future DoD freeze action laban sa kakumpitensyang lab ay mayroon nang court-tested predicate. Ang "deal is possible" framing ni Trump noong Apr 17 + ang May 1 contract signings ay ang carrot-and-stick choreography; sa sandaling maging visible sa buyside ang deal-or-no-deal binary, ang capital-allocation pressure ay pipilit sa bawat frontier-lab board na pormal na tanggapin ang Anthropic posture (carve-out, tanggapin ang exclusion) o ang OpenAI/Microsoft/Google posture (no carve-out, tanggapin ang full DoD use). Ang middle position ay nagiging untenable sa sandaling magsimula ang Q3 earnings cycle.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: **The May 1 Pentagon-snubs-Anthropic + 7-vendor classified-network AI deal becomes the first US presidential-administration vs frontier-AI-lab autonomous-weapons-use line in the sand — by Q3 2026 at least two other frontier labs (Mistral, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Inflection-2026, Cohere) explicitly publish a use-of-force / autonomous-weapons carve-out in their public ToS or DoD bid responses; Anthropic's federal-judge-blocked Trump-admin freeze (April CA ruling) becomes the operative procurement-law precedent; Q3 earnings calls add an "autonomous-weapons exposure" disclosure line for the cohort.** Forcing function is litigation precedent: the federal-judge block already exists, so any future DoD freeze action against a competing lab now has a court-tested predicate. Trump's "deal is possible" framing on Apr 17 + the May 1 contract signings are the carrot-and-stick choreography; once a deal-or-no-deal binary becomes visible to the buyside, capital-allocation pressure will force every frontier-lab board to formally adopt either the Anthropic posture (carve-out, accept exclusion) or the OpenAI/Microsoft/Google posture (no carve-out, accept full DoD use). detail.summary_short: Record S&P + Nasdaq closes on May 1, AAPL +3.28% on a $100B buyback and a Q3 +14-17% guide, plus the $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape ratify the AI-capex-on-faith thesis just as Cerebras's mid-May roadshow lands; pricing should clear the $22-25B S-1 range toward the pre-IPO secondary $26-28B with a ≥30% first-day pop.

summary_short_locales.en: Record S&P + Nasdaq closes on May 1, AAPL +3.28% on a $100B buyback and a Q3 +14-17% guide, plus the $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape ratify the AI-capex-on-faith thesis just as Cerebras's mid-May roadshow lands; pricing should clear the $22-25B S-1 range toward the pre-IPO secondary $26-28B with a ≥30% first-day pop.
summary_short_locales.ja: 5月1日のレコードS&P + Nasdaq終値、$100B自社株買いとQ3 +14-17%ガイドでAAPL +3.28%、加えて$700B 2026年Big-Tech AI設備投資テープが、Cerebrasの5月中旬ロードショー着地のちょうどそのときAI設備投資オン信仰仮説を批准する;価格付けは$22-25BのS-1レンジを越えてプレIPOセカンダリー$26-28Bに向かい、初日急騰30%以上を達成するはずだ。
summary_short_locales.es: Los cierres récord del S&P + Nasdaq el 1 mayo, AAPL +3.28% sobre recompra de $100B y una guía Q3 +14-17%, más la cinta de $700B de capex de IA de Big-Tech 2026 ratifican la tesis de capex-IA-por-fe justo cuando el roadshow de mediados de mayo de Cerebras llega; el precio debería superar el rango S-1 de $22-25B hacia el secundario pre-IPO de $26-28B con un primer-día subiendo ≥30%.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang record S&P + Nasdaq closes noong May 1, AAPL +3.28% sa $100B buyback at Q3 +14-17% guide, kasama ng $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape ay nagra-ratify sa AI-capex-on-faith thesis kaagad lalapag ang kalagitnaan-ng-Mayo roadshow ng Cerebras; ang pricing ay dapat sumipa pataas ng $22-25B S-1 range patungo sa pre-IPO secondary $26-28B na may ≥30% first-day pop.

bridges.text: Saturday post-trade reflection closes the empirical legs: Morgan Stanley, Goldman, and Citi hold Buy with $165-$185 targets while Bernstein initiates Market-Perform at $172 citing Saudi Aramco Digital concentration. CFO confirms the October 28 lock-up with no early waiver. The $27.2B fully-diluted cap exceeds the $22-25B band but the +18.3% open-to-close pop falls short of the >=30% bar.

text_locales.en: Saturday post-trade reflection closes the empirical legs: Morgan Stanley, Goldman, and Citi hold Buy with $165-$185 targets while Bernstein initiates Market-Perform at $172 citing Saudi Aramco Digital concentration. CFO confirms the October 28 lock-up with no early waiver. The $27.2B fully-diluted cap exceeds the $22-25B band but the +18.3% open-to-close pop falls short of the >=30% bar.
text_locales.ja: 土曜の取引後リフレクションが経験的レッグを締めくくる: Morgan Stanley、Goldman、Citiは$165-$185目標でBuyを維持、BernsteinはSaudi Aramco Digital集中性を引用してMarket-Perform $172で開始。CFOは早期免除なしで10月28日ロックアップを確認。$27.2B完全希薄化キャップは$22-25Bバンドを上回るが、+18.3%寄り付きから引け値の上昇は>=30%バーを下回る。
text_locales.es: La reflexión post-trade del sábado cierra las piernas empíricas: Morgan Stanley, Goldman y Citi mantienen Buy con objetivos $165-$185 mientras Bernstein inicia Market-Perform a $172 citando concentración Saudi Aramco Digital. El CFO confirma el lock-up del 28 de octubre sin waiver anticipado. La capitalización completamente diluida de $27.2B excede la banda $22-25B pero el pop open-to-close de +18.3% queda corto de la barra >=30%.
text_locales.fil: Isinasara ng Saturday post-trade reflection ang empirical legs: hawak ng Morgan Stanley, Goldman, at Citi ang Buy na may $165-$185 targets habang nag-iinitiate ang Bernstein ng Market-Perform sa $172 na binabanggit ang Saudi Aramco Digital concentration. Kinukumpirma ng CFO ang October 28 lock-up na walang early waiver. Lumalampas ang $27.2B fully-diluted cap sa $22-25B band ngunit ang +18.3% open-to-close pop ay kulang sa >=30% bar.

bridges.text: CBRS opens at $151.40 (+18.3% over the $128 IPO price) and closes near $148 with ~$31.4B fully-diluted market cap on first-day volume of ~28M shares, exceeding the $22-25B band by ~25%. The valuation half lands above the named threshold but the +18.3% first-day pop falls short of the >=30% bar — empirical outcome splits the prediction.

text_locales.en: CBRS opens at $151.40 (+18.3% over the $128 IPO price) and closes near $148 with ~$31.4B fully-diluted market cap on first-day volume of ~28M shares, exceeding the $22-25B band by ~25%. The valuation half lands above the named threshold but the +18.3% first-day pop falls short of the >=30% bar — empirical outcome splits the prediction.
text_locales.ja: CBRSは$151.40で寄り付き(IPO価格$128から+18.3%)、約$148で引け、初日出来高約2,800万株で完全希薄化後時価総額約$314億となり、$220-250億帯を約25%上回る。バリュエーション側は名指しの閾値を上回って着地するが、+18.3%の初日急騰は≥30%の基準に届かず、実証結果は予測を分割する。
text_locales.es: CBRS abre a $151.40 (+18.3% sobre el IPO price de $128) y cierra cerca de $148 con un market cap fully-diluted de aproximadamente $31.4B en un volumen de primer dia de aproximadamente 28M de acciones, superando la banda de $22-25B en aproximadamente 25%. La mitad de valuation aterriza por encima del umbral nombrado pero el first-day pop de +18.3% queda por debajo de la barra >=30% — el resultado empirico divide la prediccion.
text_locales.fil: Bumukas ang CBRS sa $151.40 (+18.3% sa $128 IPO price) at nag-close malapit sa $148 na may humigit-kumulang $31.4B fully-diluted market cap sa first-day volume na ~28M shares, lumalampas sa $22-25B band ng ~25%. Ang valuation half ay lumalapag sa itaas ng named threshold pero ang +18.3% first-day pop ay kulang sa >=30% bar — hinahati ng empirical outcome ang prediction.

bridges.text: The May 6-7 pricing print at $128 ($3 above range), fully-diluted ~$27.2B, $4.12B raise with green-shoe, and OpenAI warrant in-the-money on listing closes the valuation half of the Cerebras IPO prediction (May 2) above the $22-25B band unambiguously. CBRS opens Thursday on Nasdaq — the first-day pop magnitude is the only outstanding empirical leg.

text_locales.en: The May 6-7 pricing print at $128 ($3 above range), fully-diluted ~$27.2B, $4.12B raise with green-shoe, and OpenAI warrant in-the-money on listing closes the valuation half of the Cerebras IPO prediction (May 2) above the $22-25B band unambiguously. CBRS opens Thursday on Nasdaq — the first-day pop magnitude is the only outstanding empirical leg.
text_locales.ja: 5月6-7日の値付けは128ドル(レンジ+3ドル)、完全希薄化後約272億ドル、グリーンシュー込み41.2億ドル調達、上場時にOpenAIワラントがイン・ザ・マネーとなり、Cerebras IPO予測(5月2日)の評価額部分を22-25億ドル帯を明確に上回る形で確定させた。CBRSは木曜にナスダックで取引開始──初日上昇幅のみが残された経験的論点となる。
text_locales.es: El precio impreso del 6-7 de mayo a $128 ($3 sobre rango), totalmente diluido ~$27,2B, recaudación de $4,12B con green-shoe, y la warrant de OpenAI in-the-money en el listado, cierran inequívocamente la mitad de valoración de la predicción del IPO de Cerebras (2 de mayo) por encima de la banda $22-25B. CBRS abre el jueves en Nasdaq — la magnitud del primer día es la única pata empírica pendiente.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 6-7 pricing print sa $128 ($3 sa itaas ng range), fully-diluted ~$27.2B, $4.12B raise kasama ang green-shoe, at OpenAI warrant na in-the-money sa listing ay malinaw na isinasara ang valuation half ng Cerebras IPO prediction (Mayo 2) sa itaas ng $22-25B band. Bubukas ang CBRS sa Huwebes sa Nasdaq — ang first-day pop magnitude lamang ang natitirang empirical leg.

bridges.text: Cerebras's May 4 IPO launch at a $26.6B target (28M shares at $115-$125) lands the valuation half of the Cerebras IPO prediction (May 2) above the prediction's $22-25B band, with $510M trailing revenue and the >$10B OpenAI warrant + loan structure providing the supply-contract anchor. The first-day pop magnitude is the only empirical leg still outstanding.

text_locales.ja: Cerebrasの5月4日のIPOローンチ($26.6B目標、28M株を$115〜$125)は、Cerebras IPO予測(5月2日)の評価額部分を予測の$22〜25Bレンジを超えて着地させる — $510Mの直近売上と$10B超のOpenAIワラント+ローン構造が供給契約のアンカーとなる。初日の上昇幅は、唯一未解決の経験的レッグである。
text_locales.es: El lanzamiento de IPO de Cerebras del 4 de mayo a un objetivo de $26.6B (28M acciones a $115-$125) aterriza la mitad de valoración de la predicción de IPO de Cerebras (2 de mayo) por encima del rango $22-25B, con $510M de ingresos recientes y la estructura de warrants + préstamo OpenAI >$10B como ancla del contrato de suministro. La magnitud del primer día es la única pierna empírica pendiente.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 4 IPO launch ng Cerebras sa $26.6B target (28M shares sa $115-$125) ay naka-land sa valuation half ng Cerebras IPO prediction (Mayo 2) sa itaas ng prediction's $22-25B band, kasama ang $510M trailing revenue at >$10B OpenAI warrant + loan structure bilang supply-contract anchor. Ang first-day pop magnitude lamang ang natitirang empirical leg.

bridges.text: May 1's record S&P, Nasdaq, AAPL move, +$100B buyback, and Q3 guide upside on the $700B capex tape give the buyside the cleanest single-week ratification of the AI-capex thesis since 2020 going into the Cerebras roadshow. AMD's May 5 print and the May 8 jobs print frame the macro window cleanly between the record tape and the IPO pricing.

text_locales.en: May 1's record S&P, Nasdaq, AAPL move, +$100B buyback, and Q3 guide upside on the $700B capex tape give the buyside the cleanest single-week ratification of the AI-capex thesis since 2020 going into the Cerebras roadshow. AMD's May 5 print and the May 8 jobs print frame the macro window cleanly between the record tape and the IPO pricing.
text_locales.ja: 5月1日の記録的S&P、Nasdaq、AAPLの動き、+$100Bの自社株買い、Q3ガイダンス上振れが$700B capexテープに乗って、Cerebrasロードショーに向かう中で2020年以来最もクリーンな単一週のAI capexテーゼ批准を買い手側に与える。AMDの5月5日決算と5月8日の雇用統計が、記録的テープとIPO価格決定の間にマクロウィンドウをきれいに枠付ける。
text_locales.es: El récord del 1 de mayo S&P, Nasdaq, movimiento de AAPL, +$100B en recompra, y guía Q3 al alza sobre el tape de capex de $700B dan al lado comprador la ratificación más limpia en una sola semana de la tesis de capex de IA desde 2020 entrando al roadshow de Cerebras. La impresión de AMD del 5 de mayo y la impresión de empleos del 8 de mayo enmarcan la ventana macro limpiamente entre el tape récord y la fijación del precio del IPO.
text_locales.fil: Ang record S&P, Nasdaq, AAPL move ng May 1, +$100B buyback, at Q3 guide upside sa $700B capex tape ang nagbibigay sa buyside ng pinakamalinis na single-week ratification ng AI-capex thesis simula 2020 papasok sa Cerebras roadshow. Ang AMD May 5 print at ang May 8 jobs print ay bumubuo sa macro window nang malinis sa pagitan ng record tape at ng IPO pricing.

detail.description: **The May 1 record S&P 7,230.12 + Nasdaq 25,114.44 + April best-month-since-2020 + AAPL +3.28% to $280.25 + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape sets up the mid-May Cerebras IPO to price at or above the top of the $22-25B targeted range with a multi-day pop — the Apr 30 Apple +$100B buyback authorization + the Q3 guide (+14-17%) is the buyside ratification of the AI-capex-on-faith thesis, and the Cerebras roadshow lands into the cleanest single tape since 2020; pricing closer to the pre-IPO secondary $26-28B than the public S-1 $22-25B; first-day pop ≥30% with the underwriter syndicate (Morgan Stanley / Citi / Barclays / UBS) pulling allocation aggressively from the long-only side; the IPO becomes the cohort signal that the AI-infrastructure-build is fundable through public markets and not just private capex.** $510M 2025 revenue + $20B+/750MW OpenAI deal through 2028 + the 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration is priced in already; the swing factor is the May 1 record-tape ratification of the AI-capex thesis, which the buyside has been waiting for since the Apr 28 OpenAI-revenue-miss WSJ. The mid-May window also avoids competing with the May 8 Apr Jobs print + the May 5 AMD print; pricing should land in the pre-Cerebras quiet-period sweet spot. In plain language: A clean record stock tape makes the next AI-chip IPO likely to price above expectations. In plain language: In plain language:

La ventana de mediados de mayo también evita competir con la impresión Apr Jobs del 8 mayo + la impresión AMD del 5 mayo; el precio debería aterrizar en el punto dulce pre-Cerebras de período de silencio. En lenguaje claro: Una cinta limpia récord hace probable que la próxima IPO de chips de IA fije precio por encima de las expectativas. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:

Ang kalagitnaan-ng-Mayo window ay umiiwas din sa pakikipagkumpitensya sa May 8 Apr Jobs print + ang May 5 AMD print; ang pricing ay dapat lapag sa pre-Cerebras quiet-period sweet spot.

nodes.title: SEC drafts AI-revenue concept release; Big-3 ships AI-KPI footnote by Q4 2026
nodes.description: **By Q4 2026 the cohort buyside-pressure stack — Apr 30 AAPL Q3 guide +14-17% (vs 9.5% consensus) printed without a separate AI-services line + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + AAPL +$100B buyback authorization + Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item disclosure precedent + OpenAI $25B annualized + $2B/month run rate + 122M paid by 2026 with $8/month + ad pilot $100M-annualized opacity + Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22-25B targeted — forces the SEC to publish a concept release (Reg S-K amendment proposal) on audited AI-business KPI disclosure for hyperscalers and foundation labs filing public comparables; at least one Big-3 hyperscaler pre-emptively publishes an audited AI-business KPI segment in a 10-Q footnote, ahead of any rule finalization, to anchor the disclosure shape.** Forcing function is the disclosure-shape gap between the cohort's collective $700B capex commitment and the cohort's lack of audited AI-KPI footnote: the buyside is being asked to underwrite eight digits of AI capex per quarter without the separate-segment view the SEC already requires for cloud, gaming, and other reporting segments. The May 1 Cerebras IPO roadshow with public S-1 disclosure + the Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape + the Apr 29 MSFT $37B precedent are the operative anchor signals; SEC has already opened the regulatory window via the Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period (companion to climate-disclosure rulemaking), and AI-revenue disclosure is the natural next addition. In plain language: Investors are spending hundreds of billions on AI without seeing what they're getting back — the SEC will publish a draft rule asking companies to break it out. title.es: La SEC redacta concept release sobre ingresos de IA; Big-3 publica nota al pie de KPI de IA para Q4 2026
title.fil: Maglalabas ang SEC ng AI-revenue concept release; ipapadala ng Big-3 ang AI-KPI footnote pagsapit ng Q4 2026

description.en: **By Q4 2026 the cohort buyside-pressure stack — Apr 30 AAPL Q3 guide +14-17% (vs 9.5% consensus) printed without a separate AI-services line + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + AAPL +$100B buyback authorization + Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item disclosure precedent + OpenAI $25B annualized + $2B/month run rate + 122M paid by 2026 with $8/month + ad pilot $100M-annualized opacity + Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22-25B targeted — forces the SEC to publish a concept release (Reg S-K amendment proposal) on audited AI-business KPI disclosure for hyperscalers and foundation labs filing public comparables; at least one Big-3 hyperscaler pre-emptively publishes an audited AI-business KPI segment in a 10-Q footnote, ahead of any rule finalization, to anchor the disclosure shape.** Forcing function is the disclosure-shape gap between the cohort's collective $700B capex commitment and the cohort's lack of audited AI-KPI footnote: the buyside is being asked to underwrite eight digits of AI capex per quarter without the separate-segment view the SEC already requires for cloud, gaming, and other reporting segments. The May 1 Cerebras IPO roadshow with public S-1 disclosure + the Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape + the Apr 29 MSFT $37B precedent are the operative anchor signals; SEC has already opened the regulatory window via the Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period (companion to climate-disclosure rulemaking), and AI-revenue disclosure is the natural next addition. In plain language: Investors are spending hundreds of billions on AI without seeing what they're getting back — the SEC will publish a draft rule asking companies to break it out. description.ja: **2026年Q4までに、コホート買い手側圧力スタック — 4月30日AAPL Q3ガイダンス+14-17%(コンセンサス9.5%対比)が別のAIサービスラインなしで印字、$700Bの2026年Big-Tech AI capexテープ、AAPL +$100Bの自社株買い承認、4月29日MSFTの$37B AI run-rate単一ライン項目開示前例、OpenAIの$25B年換算 + $2B/月のrun rate + 2026年までに$8/月で122M有料 + 広告パイロット$100M年換算の不透明性、5月中旬にCerebras IPOが$22-25B目標 — がSECに、ハイパースケーラーとファウンデーションラボの公開比較対象提出に対する、監査済みAI事業KPI開示についてのコンセプトリリース(Reg S-K改正提案)の公表を強いる。少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラーが、規則最終化に先立って、開示形を錨付けするために監査済みAI事業KPIセグメントを10-Q脚注に先制公表する。** 強制力はコホートの集合的$700B capexコミットメントとコホートの監査済みAI-KPI脚注の欠如との間の開示形ギャップだ。買い手側は、SECが既にクラウド、ゲーム、その他の報告セグメントに要求している別個セグメントビューなしで、四半期当たり8桁のAI capexを引き受けることを要求されている。5月1日のCerebras IPOロードショーと公開S-1開示、4月28日のWSJ OpenAI収益テープ、4月29日のMSFT $37B前例が運用上の錨信号だ。SECは既に4月28日のReg S-K近代化コメント期間(気候開示規則制定の伴侶)を通じて規制窓を開いており、AI収益開示は自然な次の追加だ。平易な言葉で言えば: 投資家は何が返ってくるかを見ずにAIに数千億ドルを使っている — SECは企業にそれを内訳開示するよう求めるドラフト規則を公表する。
description.es: **Para Q4 2026, la pila de presión del lado comprador del cohorte — la guía Q3 de AAPL del 30 de abril +14-17% (vs consenso del 9.5%) impresa sin una línea separada de servicios de IA + el tape de capex de IA de Big-Tech 2026 de $700B + la autorización de recompra de +$100B de AAPL + el precedente de divulgación de línea única del run-rate de IA de $37B de MSFT del 29 de abril + OpenAI con $25B anualizados + run rate de $2B/mes + 122M pagos para 2026 a $8/mes + opacidad del piloto de anuncios de $100M anualizados + Cerebras con IPO a mediados de mayo apuntando a $22-25B — fuerza a la SEC a publicar un concept release (propuesta de enmienda al Reg S-K) sobre divulgación auditada de KPIs de negocio de IA para hyperscalers y laboratorios fundacionales que presentan comparables públicos; al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 publica preventivamente un segmento auditado de KPI de negocio de IA en una nota al pie de un 10-Q, antes de cualquier finalización de regla, para anclar la forma de divulgación.** La función forzante es la brecha de forma de divulgación entre el compromiso colectivo de capex de $700B del cohorte y la falta de una nota al pie auditada de KPI de IA del cohorte: se le pide al lado comprador que asegure ocho dígitos de capex de IA por trimestre sin la vista de segmento separado que la SEC ya requiere para nube, gaming, y otros segmentos reportables. El roadshow del IPO de Cerebras del 1 de mayo con divulgación pública S-1 + el tape del WSJ del 28 de abril sobre ingresos de OpenAI + el precedente de $37B de MSFT del 29 de abril son las señales operativas de anclaje; la SEC ya ha abierto la ventana regulatoria vía el período de comentarios de modernización del Reg S-K del 28 de abril (compañero a la regulación de divulgación climática), y la divulgación de ingresos de IA es la siguiente adición natural. En lenguaje sencillo: Los inversores están gastando cientos de miles de millones en IA sin ver lo que están obteniendo de vuelta — la SEC publicará un borrador de regla pidiendo a las empresas que lo desglosen.
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang cohort buyside-pressure stack — ang Apr 30 AAPL Q3 guide na +14-17% (vs 9.5% consensus) na inilabas nang walang hiwalay na AI-services line + ang $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + AAPL +$100B buyback authorization + ang Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item disclosure precedent + OpenAI $25B annualized + $2B/month run rate + 122M paid pagsapit ng 2026 sa $8/month + ad pilot $100M-annualized opacity + Cerebras IPO sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo na may target na $22-25B — ay magpipilit sa SEC na maglathala ng concept release (Reg S-K amendment proposal) tungkol sa audited AI-business KPI disclosure para sa hyperscalers at foundation labs na nagfa-file ng public comparables; hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler ang preemptive na maglalathala ng audited AI-business KPI segment sa 10-Q footnote, bago ang anumang rule finalization, upang i-anchor ang hugis ng disclosure.** Ang forcing function ay ang puwang sa hugis ng disclosure sa pagitan ng cohort's collective $700B capex commitment at ng kakulangan ng cohort sa audited AI-KPI footnote: hinihiling sa buyside na underwrite ang walong-digit na AI capex bawat quarter nang walang hiwalay na segment view na hinihingi na ng SEC para sa cloud, gaming, at iba pang reporting segments. Ang May 1 Cerebras IPO roadshow na may pampublikong S-1 disclosure + ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape + ang Apr 29 MSFT $37B precedent ay ang operative anchor signals; binuksan na ng SEC ang regulatory window sa pamamagitan ng Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period (kasama ng climate-disclosure rulemaking), at ang AI-revenue disclosure ang likas na susunod na karagdagan. Sa madaling salita: gumagastos ang mga investor ng daan-daang bilyon sa AI nang hindi nakikita kung ano ang nakukuha nila pabalik — maglalathala ang SEC ng draft rule na hihiling sa mga kompanya na ihiwalay ito.

By Q4 2026 an SEC concept release is expected on audited AI-KPI disclosure with one Big-3 hyperscaler pre-emptively publishing an AI-segment footnote.

bridges.text: Sunday Mag-7 previews name the May 21 Alphabet analyst day as the operative pricing event for the AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout, Wells Fargo Securities now expects Alphabet to ship a Q2 footnote mirroring Microsoft's fiscal Q1 2027 breakout, and Jefferies' CBRS coverage cites the SEC Corp Fin sample letter as removing the Reg FD selective-disclosure overhang.

text_locales.en: Sunday Mag-7 previews name the May 21 Alphabet analyst day as the operative pricing event for the AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout, Wells Fargo Securities now expects Alphabet to ship a Q2 footnote mirroring Microsoft's fiscal Q1 2027 breakout, and Jefferies' CBRS coverage cites the SEC Corp Fin sample letter as removing the Reg FD selective-disclosure overhang.
text_locales.ja: 日曜Mag-7プレビューは5月21日Alphabetアナリスト・デイをAIサービス10-Qフットノート・ブレイクアウトの作動価格決定イベントとして命名、Wells Fargo Securitiesは今やAlphabetにMicrosoftの会計Q1 2027ブレイクアウトをミラーするQ2フットノートを出荷することを期待する、そしてJefferiesのCBRSカバレッジはSEC Corp FinサンプルレターをReg FD選択的開示オーバーハング除去として引用する。
text_locales.es: Los previews Mag-7 dominicales nombran el día de analistas de Alphabet del 21 de mayo como el evento de pricing operativo para el desglose de footnote 10-Q AI Services, Wells Fargo Securities ahora espera que Alphabet envíe un footnote Q2 reflejando el desglose fiscal Q1 2027 de Microsoft, y la cobertura CBRS de Jefferies cita la carta muestra de SEC Corp Fin como eliminadora del overhang de divulgación selectiva Reg FD.

bridges.text: AMD's May 5 Q1 print plus Q2 guide plus Anthropic run-rate >$30B published via journalist channels plus the May 4 FIS + parallel-JV launches plus NVIDIA Blackwell at ~1,000 NVL72 racks/week tighten the structural force the SEC AI-KPI prediction (May 3) names: buyside underwriting ~$700B 2026 capex against bundled accelerator lines and unaudited run-rate cadence creates a multi-vehicle anchor for a uniform AI-business KPI disclosure regime.

text_locales.ja: AMDの5月5日 Q1決算 + Q2ガイダンス + ジャーナリスト・チャネル経由で公表された $30B 超のAnthropicランレート + 5月4日のFIS + 並行JVローンチ + 週約1,000台NVL72ラックのNVIDIA Blackwellが、SEC AI-KPI予測(5月3日)が指摘する構造的な強制力を引き締める: バンドルされたアクセラレーター・ラインと監査されていないランレート・ケイデンスに対するバイサイドの約 $700B 2026年capex引き受けが、統一されたAI事業KPI開示体制のためのマルチビークル・アンカーを生み出している。
text_locales.es: La impresión Q1 del 5 de mayo de AMD más la guía Q2 más la tasa de ejecución de Anthropic >$30B publicada vía canales periodísticos más los lanzamientos FIS + JV paralelos del 4 de mayo más NVIDIA Blackwell a ~1,000 racks NVL72/semana ajustan la fuerza estructural que la predicción SEC AI-KPI (3 de mayo) nombra: el lado comprador suscribiendo ~$700B de capex 2026 contra líneas agrupadas de aceleradores y cadencia de tasa de ejecución no auditada crea un ancla multi-vehículo para un régimen uniforme de divulgación de KPIs de negocio de IA.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 5 Q1 print ng AMD plus Q2 guide plus Anthropic run-rate >$30B na inilathala sa pamamagitan ng journalist channels plus ang May 4 FIS + parallel-JV launches plus NVIDIA Blackwell sa ~1,000 NVL72 racks/week ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinangalanan ng SEC AI-KPI prediction (May 3): ang buyside na nag-uunderwrite ng ~$700B 2026 capex laban sa bundled accelerator lines at unaudited run-rate cadence ay lumilikha ng multi-vehicle anchor para sa uniform AI-business KPI disclosure regime.
