detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: By Q3 2026 the May 8 reciprocity-perimeter expansion — Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI publishing a parallel memorandum-of-cooperation accepting AISI-administered TLO-range cyber-evaluation runs as satisfying their respective frontier-model voluntary-disclosure regimes (120-day placement window) inside 24 hours of the May 7 EU-UK joint memorandum, with Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC pre-committing to mirror language by Q3 2026 and the Mythos + GPT-5.5 results cited as the operational threshold — combined with HM Treasury's same-day extension of the public-sector LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause to a 30-day formal review naming Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, and Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants in a temporarily-suspended-vendors annex pending Mythos-class capability disclosure under the AI Procurement Common Standard, force the AISI-administered cyber-evaluation regime to consolidate as the operative gating criterion for sovereign + allied public-sector AI procurement across at least six jurisdictions before Q3 2026 closes. The forcing function is that once Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI lift the EU-UK template into the Indo-Pacific within one news cycle and a Five Eyes member (UK) names the Big-4 frontier-lab + hyperscaler-coding-assistant cohort by vendor in a procurement-freeze annex, the absence of a parallel US recognition pathway converts the FMRB executive order draft from a domestic-disclosure question into a market-access question for US-based labs. The most likely shape is a six-or-seven-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter (UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia, with New Zealand or South Korea as the seventh) treating an AISI-administered cyber-eval pass as a per-tenant Mythos-class capability disclosure, paired with a UK + EU + at-least-one-Indo-Pacific allied named-vendor procurement-gate annex tied to that pass. Bear case is that the FMRB EO ships first with §708-equivalent reciprocal recognition language and short-circuits the multilateral path; absent that, Q3 2026 lands the perimeter as the operative procurement gate.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q3までに、5月8日のレシプロシティ境界拡大—Singapore IMDAとJapan AISIが、5月7日のEU-UK共同覚書から24時間以内に、AISI管理下のTLOレンジ・サイバー評価ランがそれぞれのフロンティア・モデル任意開示レジームを満たすものとする並行した協力覚書を120日プレースメント・ウィンドウ付きで公表、Canada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCがオブザーバーとして調印し2026年Q3までにミラー言語をプリ・コミット、MythosとGPT-5.5の結果が運用上の閾値として引用される—が、HM Treasuryの同日延長による公的部門LLMコーディング・アシスタント調達一時停止の30日正式レビューへの拡張(AI Procurement Common Standardの下でのMythosクラス能力開示が条件の一時停止ベンダー附属書にAnthropic、OpenAI、Google Gemini Code Assist、Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Governmentテナントを命名)と組み合わさり、AISI管理下のサイバー評価レジームを少なくとも6管轄区域にまたがるソブリン + 同盟国の公的部門AI調達のための運用上のゲーティング基準として、2026年Q3が閉じる前に統合することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、ひとたびSingapore IMDAとJapan AISIがEU-UKテンプレートを1ニュース・サイクル以内にインド太平洋へ持ち上げ、Five Eyesメンバー(UK)が調達凍結附属書でBig-4フロンティア・ラボ + ハイパースケーラー・コーディング・アシスタント・コホートをベンダー名で命名すれば、並行する米国認知パスの不在がFMRB大統領令ドラフトを国内開示の問題から米国拠点ラボへの市場アクセス問題へと転換させることである。最も可能性の高い形状は6〜7管轄区域(UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia、第7としてNew ZealandまたはSouth Korea)のレシプロシティ境界がAISI管理下のサイバー評価通過をテナントごとのMythosクラス能力開示として扱い、UK + EU + 少なくとも1つのインド太平洋同盟国によるベンダー名付き調達ゲート附属書がその通過に紐づく。ベアケースはFMRB大統領令が§708相当の相互認知言語を伴って先に出荷され、多国間パスを短絡させること;それがなければ、2026年Q3に当該境界が運用上の調達ゲートとして着地する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 la expansión del perímetro de reciprocidad del 8 de mayo — Singapur IMDA + Japón AISI publicando un memorándum-de-cooperación paralelo aceptando ejecuciones de evaluación cyber de rango TLO administradas por AISI como satisfaciendo sus respectivos regímenes de revelación voluntaria de modelos frontera (ventana de colocación de 120 días) dentro de las 24 horas del memorándum conjunto EU-UK del 7 de mayo, con Canadá CCCS y Australia ASD ACSC pre-comprometiéndose a reflejar el lenguaje para Q3 2026 y los resultados de Mythos + GPT-5.5 citados como el umbral operacional — combinada con la extensión del mismo día de HM Treasury de la pausa de adquisición de asistentes de codificación LLM del sector público a una revisión formal de 30 días nombrando a Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, y Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants en un anexo de vendedores temporalmente suspendidos pendiente de revelación de capacidad clase Mythos bajo el AI Procurement Common Standard, fuerzan al régimen de evaluación cyber administrado por AISI a consolidarse como el criterio operativo de gating para adquisición soberana + aliada del sector público AI a través de al menos seis jurisdicciones antes de que cierre Q3 2026. La función forzante es que una vez que Singapur IMDA + Japón AISI elevan la plantilla EU-UK al Indo-Pacífico dentro de un ciclo de noticias y un miembro de Five Eyes (Reino Unido) nombra a la cohorte Big-4 de laboratorios frontera + asistente de codificación hyperscaler por vendedor en un anexo de congelación de adquisición, la ausencia de una ruta paralela de reconocimiento de EE.UU. convierte el borrador de orden ejecutiva del FMRB de una pregunta de revelación doméstica en una pregunta de acceso al mercado para los laboratorios con base en EE.UU. La forma más probable es un perímetro de reciprocidad de seis-o-siete jurisdicciones (Reino Unido + UE + Singapur + Japón + Canadá + Australia, con Nueva Zelanda o Corea del Sur como séptima) tratando una aprobación de eval cyber administrada por AISI como una revelación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant, emparejado con un anexo de puerta de adquisición de vendedor nombrado en Reino Unido + UE + al-menos-una jurisdicción aliada Indo-Pacífica atado a esa aprobación. El caso bajista es que el EO del FMRB se envíe primero con lenguaje de reconocimiento recíproco equivalente a §708 y haga corto-circuito en la senda multilateral; sin eso, Q3 2026 aterriza el perímetro como la puerta de adquisición operativa.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026, ang May 8 reciprocity-perimeter expansion — ang Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI na naglalathala ng parallel memorandum-of-cooperation na tumatanggap sa AISI-administered TLO-range cyber-evaluation runs bilang sumasapat sa kani-kanilang frontier-model voluntary-disclosure regimes (120-day placement window) sa loob ng 24 oras ng May 7 EU-UK joint memorandum, kasama ang Canada CCCS at Australia ASD ACSC na pre-committing na i-mirror ang language bago ang Q3 2026 at ang Mythos + GPT-5.5 results na binanggit bilang operational threshold — kasama ng same-day extension ng HM Treasury sa public-sector LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause papuntang 30-day formal review na nagngangalan sa Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, at Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants sa isang temporarily-suspended-vendors annex pending Mythos-class capability disclosure sa ilalim ng AI Procurement Common Standard, ay pumipilit sa AISI-administered cyber-evaluation regime na mag-consolidate bilang operative gating criterion para sa sovereign + allied public-sector AI procurement sa hindi bababa sa anim na jurisdictions bago magsara ang Q3 2026. Ang forcing function ay kapag ang Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI ay itinaas ang EU-UK template sa Indo-Pacific sa loob ng isang news cycle at isang Five Eyes member (UK) ay nagngangalan sa Big-4 frontier-lab + hyperscaler-coding-assistant cohort by vendor sa isang procurement-freeze annex, ang kawalan ng parallel US recognition pathway ay nag-co-convert sa FMRB executive order draft mula sa domestic-disclosure question papuntang market-access question para sa US-based labs. Ang most likely shape ay isang anim-o-pitong jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter (UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia, na may New Zealand o South Korea bilang ikapito) na itinuturing ang AISI-administered cyber-eval pass bilang per-tenant Mythos-class capability disclosure, na pinares sa UK + EU + at-least-one-Indo-Pacific allied named-vendor procurement-gate annex na nakatali sa pass na iyon. Ang bear case ay ang FMRB EO na unang ina-ship na may §708-equivalent reciprocal recognition language at nagpapaikli sa multilateral path; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 2026 sa perimeter bilang operative procurement gate.

description.en: **"27B Dense + 1M context" becomes the de facto standard for enterprise local LLMs in H2 2026.** Qwen3.6-27B demonstrates that the package — no MoE routing complexity, runs on a single RTX 4090, 1M context, Apache 2.0 — reaches flagship-grade coding ability. By Q3 2026, Mistral / Meta / DeepSeek / Google Gemma will each ship 20-30B Dense × 1M context × Apache/Llama-style models. The differentiators for 70B+ MoE narrow to multimodal understanding, tool breadth, and long-horizon reasoning. On-prem inference's default VRAM requirement shifts down from RTX 6000 48GB / H100 80GB to **RTX 4090 24GB / Apple M4 Max 64GB**. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「27B Dense + 1Mコンテキスト」が2026年下半期の企業向けローカルLLMのデファクト標準になる。** Qwen3.6-27Bは、MoEルーティングの複雑さなし、単一のRTX 4090で動作、1Mコンテキスト、Apache 2.0というパッケージで、フラッグシップ級のコーディング能力に到達することを実証した。2026年Q3までに、Mistral / Meta / DeepSeek / Google Gemmaはそれぞれ20-30B Dense × 1Mコンテキスト × Apache/Llamaスタイルのモデルをリリースする。70B+ MoEの差別化要素は、マルチモーダル理解、ツールの幅、長期推論に絞られる。オンプレミス推論のデフォルトVRAM要件は、RTX 6000 48GB / H100 80GBから**RTX 4090 24GB / Apple M4 Max 64GB**へと下がる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **"27B Dense + contexto de 1M" se convierte en el estándar de facto para LLMs locales empresariales en H2 2026.** Qwen3.6-27B demuestra que el paquete — sin complejidad de enrutamiento MoE, funciona en una sola RTX 4090, contexto de 1M, Apache 2.0 — alcanza capacidad de codificación de grado insignia. Para el Q3 2026, Mistral / Meta / DeepSeek / Google Gemma cada uno enviará modelos de 20-30B Dense × contexto de 1M × estilo Apache/Llama. Los diferenciadores para 70B+ MoE se reducen a comprensión multimodal, amplitud de herramientas y razonamiento de horizonte largo. El requisito predeterminado de VRAM para inferencia on-prem cambia de RTX 6000 48GB / H100 80GB a **RTX 4090 24GB / Apple M4 Max 64GB**. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **"27B Dense + 1M context" ay nagiging de facto standard para sa enterprise local LLMs sa H2 2026.** Ipinapakita ng Qwen3.6-27B na ang package — walang kompplikasyon ng MoE routing, tumatakbo sa iisang RTX 4090, 1M context, Apache 2.0 — ay umaabot sa flagship-grade coding ability. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang Mistral / Meta / DeepSeek / Google Gemma ay ipapadala bawat isa ng 20-30B Dense × 1M context × Apache/Llama-style models. Ang mga differentiator para sa 70B+ MoE ay liliit sa multimodal understanding, tool breadth, at long-horizon reasoning. Ang default na VRAM requirement para sa on-prem inference ay babagsak mula sa RTX 6000 48GB / H100 80GB papunta sa **RTX 4090 24GB / Apple M4 Max 64GB**. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

By Q3 2026, Mistral, Meta, DeepSeek, and Gemma are expected to ship comparable 20-30B Dense × 1M context models, shifting on-prem VRAM defaults to RTX 4090 / M4 Max.

summary_short_locales.en: Qwen3.6-27B Dense reaches flagship-grade coding (SWE-bench Verified 77.2%) on a single RTX 4090 with 1M context under Apache 2.0, beating its 397B MoE predecessor. By Q3 2026, Mistral, Meta, DeepSeek, and Gemma are expected to ship comparable 20-30B Dense × 1M context models, shifting on-prem VRAM defaults to RTX 4090 / M4 Max.
summary_short_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-27B DenseはApache 2.0ライセンスの下、1Mコンテキストで単一のRTX 4090上でフラッグシップ級のコーディング能力(SWE-bench Verified 77.2%)に到達し、前世代の397B MoEを上回った。2026年Q3までに、Mistral、Meta、DeepSeek、Gemmaが同等の20-30B Dense × 1Mコンテキストモデルをリリースし、オンプレミスVRAMのデフォルトをRTX 4090 / M4 Maxへとシフトさせると予想される。
summary_short_locales.es: Qwen3.6-27B Dense alcanza codificación de grado insignia (SWE-bench Verified 77.2%) en una sola RTX 4090 con contexto de 1M bajo Apache 2.0, superando a su predecesor MoE de 397B. Para el Q3 2026, se espera que Mistral, Meta, DeepSeek y Gemma envíen modelos comparables de 20-30B Dense × contexto de 1M, cambiando los valores predeterminados de VRAM on-prem a RTX 4090 / M4 Max.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Qwen3.6-27B Dense ay umabot sa flagship-grade coding (SWE-bench Verified 77.2%) sa iisang RTX 4090 na may 1M context sa ilalim ng Apache 2.0, na tinatalo ang 397B MoE predecessor nito. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, inaasahang ang Mistral, Meta, DeepSeek, at Gemma ay magpapadala ng katulad na 20-30B Dense × 1M context models, na maglilipat ng on-prem VRAM defaults sa RTX 4090 / M4 Max.

bridges.text: The Qwen 3.6 family at flagship-grade coding ability with 260K context and Apache 2.0 licensing is exactly the open-weight package the prediction's 27B-Dense + 1M-context thesis rests on; today's evidence carries it forward without breaking new ground on the single-RTX-4090 deployment frame. Anthropic retiring the 1M-context beta on the proprietary side is parallel reinforcement for context-length convergence.

Anthropic retiring the 1M-context beta on the proprietary side is parallel reinforcement for context-length convergence.
text_locales.ja: 260Kコンテキストとフラッグシップ級コーディング能力、Apache 2.0ライセンスを備えたQwen 3.6ファミリーは、予測の27B-Dense + 1Mコンテキストテーゼが依拠するまさにそのオープンウェイトパッケージである。本日のエビデンスは単一のRTX-4090デプロイ枠組みで新たな地平を開くことなくこれを引き継ぐ。Anthropicがプロプライエタリ側で1Mコンテキストベータを廃止したことは、コンテキスト長収束の並行強化である。
text_locales.es: La familia Qwen 3.6 con capacidad de coding de grado flagship con 260K de contexto y licenciamiento Apache 2.0 es exactamente el paquete open-weight sobre el que descansa la tesis 27B-Dense + 1M-contexto de la predicción; la evidencia de hoy la lleva adelante sin abrir terreno nuevo en el frame de despliegue en una sola RTX 4090. Anthropic retirando el beta de 1M de contexto en el lado propietario es refuerzo paralelo para la convergencia de longitud de contexto.
text_locales.fil: Ang Qwen 3.6 family sa flagship-grade coding ability na may 260K context at Apache 2.0 licensing ay eksaktong open-weight package na pinaghahangaan ng 27B-Dense + 1M-context thesis ng prediction; dinadala ng ebidensiya ngayon ito nang hindi sumusulong sa single-RTX-4090 deployment frame. Ang pag-retire ng Anthropic sa 1M-context beta sa proprietary side ay parallel reinforcement para sa context-length convergence.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: **"27B Dense + 1M context" becomes the de facto standard for enterprise local LLMs in H2 2026.** Qwen3.6-27B demonstrates that the package — no MoE routing complexity, runs on a single RTX 4090, 1M context, Apache 2.0 — reaches flagship-grade coding ability. By Q3 2026, Mistral / Meta / DeepSeek / Google Gemma will each ship 20-30B Dense × 1M context × Apache/Llama-style models. The differentiators for 70B+ MoE narrow to multimodal understanding, tool breadth, and long-horizon reasoning. On-prem inference's default VRAM requirement shifts down from RTX 6000 48GB / H100 80GB to **RTX 4090 24GB / Apple M4 Max 64GB**. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.description: **The "consumer-GPU coding agent" displaces the cloud-only coding API for ≥30% of dev workloads by Q3 2026.** Apr 22's Qwen3.6-27B (dense, beats 397B-A17B on SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s on RTX 3090 at Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + Apr 23 Ollama MLX preview (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode on M5 Max for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%-off API (**effectively ~28x cheaper than Claude Opus 4.7**) compose a **3-corner squeeze** on the proprietary frontier-API SaaS model. By Q3 2026, **enterprise dev tools default to a hybrid harness** — local Qwen 3.6-class for "coding, refactor, lint, test" + remote frontier API only for "long-horizon planning / multi-tool reasoning" — and all Big-3 IDEs (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) ship a **local-first toggle** by default. "Cloud-only coding agent" becomes a 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.es: **El "agente de codificación con GPU de consumo" desplaza a la API de codificación solo en la nube para ≥30% de las cargas de desarrollo para Q3 2026.** Qwen3.6-27B del 22 de abril (denso, supera a 397B-A17B en SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s en RTX 3090 a Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + el preview de Ollama MLX del 23 de abril (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode en M5 Max para Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro con API 75% de descuento (**efectivamente ~28x más barato que Claude Opus 4.7**) componen un **apretón de 3 esquinas** sobre el modelo SaaS de API de frontera propietaria. Para Q3 2026, **las herramientas de desarrollo empresariales adoptan por defecto un harness híbrido** — Qwen 3.6-class local para "codificación, refactor, lint, test" + API de frontera remota solo para "planificación de largo horizonte / razonamiento multi-herramienta" — y todos los IDE Big-3 (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) lanzan un **conmutador local-first** por defecto. "Agente de codificación solo en la nube" se convierte en un artefacto de la era de 2024. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "consumer-GPU coding agent" ay magpapalit sa cloud-only coding API para sa ≥30% ng dev workloads pagsapit ng Q3 2026.** Ang Apr 22 Qwen3.6-27B (dense, lumalampas sa 397B-A17B sa SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s sa RTX 3090 sa Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + Apr 23 Ollama MLX preview (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode sa M5 Max para sa Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%-off API (**effectively ~28x mas mura kaysa Claude Opus 4.7**) ay bumubuo ng **3-corner squeeze** sa proprietary frontier-API SaaS model. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang **enterprise dev tools ay default na sa hybrid harness** — local Qwen 3.6-class para sa "coding, refactor, lint, test" + remote frontier API lamang para sa "long-horizon planning / multi-tool reasoning" — at lahat ng Big-3 IDEs (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) ay magpapadala ng **local-first toggle** by default. Ang "Cloud-only coding agent" ay nagiging 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.en: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite at $0.25 per million tokens stacks with DeepSeek V4 Pro and Qwen 3.6 to keep the three-corner cost squeeze on cloud-only coding APIs alive into May. Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference parity and Bonsai-8B at 1.15 GB keep the on-device side of the hybrid harness moving in step with the price compression.
text_locales.ja: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Liteの$0.25/百万トークンが、DeepSeek V4 ProとQwen 3.6と積層して、5月までクラウド専用コーディングAPIへの三角コスト圧迫を維持する。Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論パリティとBonsai-8Bの1.15 GBが、価格圧縮と歩調を合わせてハイブリッドハーネスのオンデバイス側を動かし続ける。
text_locales.es: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite a $0.25 por millón de tokens se apila con DeepSeek V4 Pro y Qwen 3.6 para mantener vivo el apretón de costos de tres esquinas sobre las APIs de coding solo-nube hasta mayo. La paridad de inferencia de Unsloth 2026.4.8 y Bonsai-8B a 1.15 GB mantienen el lado on-device del harness híbrido moviéndose en sincronía con la compresión de precios.
text_locales.fil: Ang Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite sa $0.25 kada milyong tokens ay pinapatong sa DeepSeek V4 Pro at Qwen 3.6 upang panatilihin ang three-corner cost squeeze sa cloud-only coding APIs hanggang Mayo. Ang Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference parity at Bonsai-8B sa 1.15 GB ay nagpapanatili sa on-device side ng hybrid harness na kasabay ng price compression.

bridges.text: Foundry Local's Windows-native runtime, Unsloth's 20-30% inference speedup, and the Chinese open-weight stack together keep the consumer-GPU coding ceiling rising fast enough to ratify the predicted hybrid-harness shift inside enterprise IDEs.

text_locales.en: Foundry Local's Windows-native runtime, Unsloth's 20-30% inference speedup, and the Chinese open-weight stack together keep the consumer-GPU coding ceiling rising fast enough to ratify the predicted hybrid-harness shift inside enterprise IDEs.
text_locales.ja: Foundry LocalのWindowsネイティブランタイム、Unslothの20-30%推論高速化、中国のオープンウェイトスタックが、エンタープライズIDE内で予測されたハイブリッドハーネスシフトを批准するのに十分な速度でコンシューマーGPUコーディング天井を上げ続けている。
text_locales.es: El runtime nativo de Windows de Foundry Local, la aceleración de inferencia 20-30% de Unsloth, y la pila open-weight china juntos mantienen el techo de codificación de GPU de consumidor subiendo lo bastante rápido para ratificar el cambio predicho de harness híbrido dentro de los IDE empresariales.
text_locales.fil: Ang Windows-native runtime ng Foundry Local, ang 20-30% inference speedup ng Unsloth, at ang Chinese open-weight stack ay magkakasamang nagpapanatili ng pataas na consumer-GPU coding ceiling nang sapat na bilis upang i-ratify ang hinulang hybrid-harness shift sa loob ng enterprise IDEs.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's WinML execution-provider integration sustains the consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis on the local side, while Codex CLI 0.128.0's model-provider-owned discovery pulls in the opposite direction by binding tooling more tightly to cloud accounts. Mixed signal — the local stack is densifying but the cloud stack is also defending.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's WinML execution-provider integration sustains the consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis on the local side, while Codex CLI 0.128.0's model-provider-owned discovery pulls in the opposite direction by binding tooling more tightly to cloud accounts. Mixed signal — the local stack is densifying but the cloud stack is also defending.
text_locales.ja: Bonsai-8BのiPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090スループットに加え、Foundry LocalのWinML実行プロバイダー統合は、ローカル側でコンシューマーGPUコーディングエージェントテーゼを支えるが、Codex CLI 0.128.0のモデルプロバイダー所有のディスカバリーは、ツールをクラウドアカウントにより緊密に結合することで反対方向に引っ張る。混合シグナル ― ローカルスタックは高密度化しているが、クラウドスタックも防衛している。
text_locales.es: Bonsai-8B con throughput en iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 más la integración del execution-provider WinML de Foundry Local sostiene la tesis de consumer-GPU-coding-agent en el lado local, mientras que el discovery model-provider-owned de Codex CLI 0.128.0 tira en dirección opuesta atando el tooling más fuertemente a las cuentas cloud. Señal mixta — el stack local se está densificando pero el stack cloud también se está defendiendo.
text_locales.fil: Ang Bonsai-8B sa iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus ang WinML execution-provider integration ng Foundry Local ay sumusuporta sa consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis sa local side, habang ang model-provider-owned discovery ng Codex CLI 0.128.0 ay humahatak sa kabilang direksyon sa pamamagitan ng pagbubuklod ng tooling nang mas mahigpit sa cloud accounts. Mixed signal — ang local stack ay tumitindi ngunit ang cloud stack ay nagde-defend din.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B 1-bit at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's ~20MB native library on WinML execution providers and vLLM v0.19.0 land the consumer-GPU coding-agent stack densely enough to support the 30%-displacement framing the prediction calls for. The cost-per-token squeeze is real and Windows-default integration is now in reach.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B 1-bit at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's ~20MB native library on WinML execution providers and vLLM v0.19.0 land the consumer-GPU coding-agent stack densely enough to support the 30%-displacement framing the prediction calls for. The cost-per-token squeeze is real and Windows-default integration is now in reach.
text_locales.ja: iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090スループットでのBonsai-8B 1ビットに加え、WinML実行プロバイダ上のFoundry Localの約20MBネイティブライブラリとvLLM v0.19.0は、予測が求める30%置換枠組みを支えるのに十分密に消費者向けGPUコーディングエージェントスタックを着地させる。トークンあたりコストの圧縮は本物であり、Windowsデフォルト統合は今や手の届く範囲にある。
text_locales.es: Bonsai-8B 1-bit a throughput de iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 más la librería nativa de ~20MB de Foundry Local sobre execution providers de WinML y vLLM v0.19.0 aterrizan el stack de coding-agent en GPU-de-consumidor lo suficientemente densamente como para soportar el encuadre de 30%-de-desplazamiento que pide la predicción. La compresión de costo-por-token es real y la integración por defecto en Windows está ahora al alcance.
text_locales.fil: Ang Bonsai-8B 1-bit sa iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput kasama ang ~20MB native library ng Foundry Local sa WinML execution providers at ang vLLM v0.19.0 ay naglalapag ng consumer-GPU coding-agent stack na sapat ang lapot upang suportahan ang 30%-displacement framing na hinihingi ng prediction. Tunay ang cost-per-token squeeze at ang Windows-default integration ay malapit na.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B's 1.15 GB single-file deployment at 368 tok/s on RTX 4090, Unsloth's Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM training path, and Multica v0.2.18's vendor-neutral orchestrator deepen the on-device coding-agent stack the prediction stitches together. The 3-corner squeeze on cloud-only coding APIs continues to materialize on consumer hardware.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B's 1.15 GB single-file deployment at 368 tok/s on RTX 4090, Unsloth's Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM training path, and Multica v0.2.18's vendor-neutral orchestrator deepen the on-device coding-agent stack the prediction stitches together. The 3-corner squeeze on cloud-only coding APIs continues to materialize on consumer hardware.
text_locales.ja: Bonsai-8BのRTX 4090上1.15 GBシングルファイル・デプロイメント(368 tok/s)、UnslothのGemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAMトレーニング・パス、Multica v0.2.18のベンダー中立オーケストレーターが、予測が縫い合わせるオンデバイス・コーディング・エージェント・スタックを深化させる。クラウド限定コーディングAPIに対する3コーナー・スクイーズが、コンシューマー・ハードウェア上で物質化し続けている。
text_locales.es: El despliegue de archivo-unico de 1.15 GB de Bonsai-8B a 368 tok/s en RTX 4090, el path de entrenamiento Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM de Unsloth, y el orchestrator vendor-neutral de Multica v0.2.18 profundizan el stack de coding-agent on-device que la prediccion une. La presion de 3-esquinas sobre las APIs de codificacion solo-nube continua materializandose en hardware consumer.
text_locales.fil: Ang 1.15 GB single-file deployment ng Bonsai-8B sa 368 tok/s sa RTX 4090, ang Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM training path ng Unsloth, at ang vendor-neutral orchestrator ng Multica v0.2.18 ay nagpapalalim sa on-device coding-agent stack na pinagsasama-sama ng hula. Ang 3-corner squeeze sa cloud-only coding APIs ay patuloy na nag-mamaterialize sa consumer hardware.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B's on-device throughput, Unsloth's consumer-GPU fine-tuning maturation, and Multica's vendor-neutral orchestration all reinforce the structural conditions the displacement thesis depends on, with the local stack hardening in the same window the prediction expected.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B's on-device throughput, Unsloth's consumer-GPU fine-tuning maturation, and Multica's vendor-neutral orchestration all reinforce the structural conditions the displacement thesis depends on, with the local stack hardening in the same window the prediction expected.

text_locales.es: El throughput on-device de Bonsai-8B, la maduración de fine-tuning consumer-GPU de Unsloth, y la orquestación vendor-neutral de Multica refuerzan las condiciones estructurales en las que depende la tesis de desplazamiento, con el local stack endureciéndose en la misma ventana que esperaba la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Ang on-device throughput ng Bonsai-8B, ang consumer-GPU fine-tuning maturation ng Unsloth, at ang vendor-neutral orchestration ng Multica ay lahat nagpapatatag sa structural conditions na inaasahan ng displacement thesis, kasama ang local stack na tumitibay sa parehong window na inaasahan ng prediction.

detail.description: **The "consumer-GPU coding agent" displaces the cloud-only coding API for ≥30% of dev workloads by Q3 2026.** Apr 22's Qwen3.6-27B (dense, beats 397B-A17B on SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s on RTX 3090 at Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + Apr 23 Ollama MLX preview (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode on M5 Max for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%-off API (**effectively ~28x cheaper than Claude Opus 4.7**) compose a **3-corner squeeze** on the proprietary frontier-API SaaS model. By Q3 2026, **enterprise dev tools default to a hybrid harness** — local Qwen 3.6-class for "coding, refactor, lint, test" + remote frontier API only for "long-horizon planning / multi-tool reasoning" — and all Big-3 IDEs (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) ship a **local-first toggle** by default. "Cloud-only coding agent" becomes a 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.title: KV-cache-compression dtype ships as inference-stack deployment knob by Q4 2026
nodes.description: **By Q4 2026 KV-cache-compression dtype is exposed as a first-class deployment knob in every major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM all ship a `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (or equivalent) flag with TurboQuant + at least one alternative (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Apr 27-29 makes this a near-certainty: **TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 already in-tree** with a fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** at Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demoing multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** circulating before Google's official Python release lands in Q2 2026. The economic forcing function is the same Mag-7 capex tape the Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report just cracked: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that can move from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x. By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **By Q4 2026 KV-cache-compression dtype is exposed as a first-class deployment knob in every major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM all ship a `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (or equivalent) flag with TurboQuant + at least one alternative (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Apr 27-29 makes this a near-certainty: **TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 already in-tree** with a fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** at Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demoing multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** circulating before Google's official Python release lands in Q2 2026. The economic forcing function is the same Mag-7 capex tape the Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report just cracked: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that can move from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x. By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年Q4までに、KVキャッシュ圧縮dtypeが主要な全推論スタックでファーストクラスのデプロイメント・ノブとして公開される — vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLMのすべてが、TurboQuantと少なくとも1つの代替手段(KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention)を備えた`--kv-cache-dtype turboquant`(または同等)フラグを出荷する。** 4月27日〜29日の動向で、これはほぼ確実となった: **TurboQuantがICLR 2026 + Google Researchブログに掲載**、**SGLang PR #21419はすでにツリー内**で、フューズドカーネル書き換え(#23134)がbf16スループットの93〜105%に到達、**NVIDIA kvpress**はDecoding-Press成熟度に達し、**PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** がマルチエージェント共有プール量子化をデモ、**コミュニティのMLX + Triton + vLLMポート**が2026年Q2のGoogle公式Pythonリリース前から流通している。経済的な強制関数は、4月28日OpenAIミスのWSJレポートが直撃したのと同じMag-7 capexテープだ: メモリ帯域幅律速のロングコンテキストワークロードがFP16から3.5ビットに移行できれば、トークンあたりの実効コストを約5〜6倍削減できる。2026年Q4までに、ハイパースケーラーはBedrock/Azure/Vertexのトークン単価をオプトイン圧縮キャッシュ階層でゲートし、昨日のレポートが示した増分GPU capexのハードウェア上限テーゼは、GPU削減ではなくこのレバーを通じて締まっていく。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el Q4 2026 el dtype de compresion de KV-cache se expone como una palanca de despliegue de primera clase en cada stack de inferencia importante — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM todos envian un flag `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o equivalente) con TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** El 27-29 de abril lo convierte en una casi-certeza: **TurboQuant aterriza en ICLR 2026 + blog de Google Research**, **SGLang PR #21419 ya en el arbol** con una reescritura de kernel fusionado (#23134) alcanzando 93-105% del throughput de bf16, **NVIDIA kvpress** en madurez Decoding-Press, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demostrando cuantizacion de pool compartido multi-agente, y **ports de la comunidad MLX + Triton + vLLM** circulando antes de que aterrice el lanzamiento oficial Python de Google en el Q2 2026. La funcion forzante economica es la misma cinta de capex Mag-7 que el reporte WSJ del fallo de OpenAI del 28 de abril acaba de quebrar: cada workload de contexto largo limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pueda moverse de FP16 a 3.5-bit reduce el costo efectivo por token ~5-6x. Para el Q4 2026 los hyperscalers gatean el precio por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex sobre tiers opt-in de cache-comprimido, y la tesis del cap-de-hardware-sobre-capex-incremental-de-GPU del reporte de ayer se aprieta via esta palanca en lugar de via menos GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang KV-cache-compression dtype ay ilalabas bilang first-class deployment knob sa bawat major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM lahat ay maglalabas ng `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o katumbas) flag na may TurboQuant + kahit isang alternatibo (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Ang Apr 27-29 ay ginagawa itong halos kasiguraduhan: **TurboQuant ay lumapag sa ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 ay nasa-tree na** kasama ang fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) na umaabot ng 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** sa Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** na nag-demo ng multi-agent shared-pool quantization, at **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** na umiikot bago ang opisyal na Python release ng Google sa Q2 2026. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag-7 capex tape na binasag ng Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na maaaring lumipat mula FP16 papunta sa 3.5-bit ay nababawasan ang epektibong per-token cost ng ~5-6x. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang mga hyperscaler ay mag-gate ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing sa opt-in compressed-cache tiers, at ang hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis mula sa report kahapon ay tumitindi sa pamamagitan ng lever na ito sa halip na sa pamamagitan ng mas kakaunting GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

summary.es: **Para el Q4 2026 el dtype de compresion de KV-cache se expone como una palanca de despliegue de primera clase en cada stack de inferencia importante — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM todos envian un flag `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o equivalente) con TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** El 27-29 de abril lo convierte en una casi-certeza: **TurboQuant aterriza en ICLR 2026 + blog de Google Research**, **SGLang PR #21419 ya en el arbol** con una reescritura de kernel fusionado (#23134) alcanzando 93-105% del throughput de bf16, **NVIDIA kvpress** en madurez Decoding-Press, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demostrando cuantizacion de pool compartido multi-agente, y **ports de la comunidad MLX + Triton + vLLM** circulando antes de que aterrice el lanzamiento oficial Python de Google en el Q2 2026. La funcion forzante economica es la misma cinta de capex Mag-7 que el reporte WSJ del fallo de OpenAI del 28 de abril acaba de quebrar: cada workload de contexto largo limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pueda moverse de FP16 a 3.5-bit reduce el costo efectivo por token ~5-6x. Para el Q4 2026 los hyperscalers gatean el precio por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex sobre tiers opt-in de cache-comprimido, y la tesis del cap-de-hardware-sobre-capex-incremental-de-GPU del reporte de ayer se aprieta via esta palanca en lugar de via menos GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
summary.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang KV-cache-compression dtype ay ilalabas bilang first-class deployment knob sa bawat major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM lahat ay maglalabas ng `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o katumbas) flag na may TurboQuant + kahit isang alternatibo (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Ang Apr 27-29 ay ginagawa itong halos kasiguraduhan: **TurboQuant ay lumapag sa ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 ay nasa-tree na** kasama ang fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) na umaabot ng 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** sa Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** na nag-demo ng multi-agent shared-pool quantization, at **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** na umiikot bago ang opisyal na Python release ng Google sa Q2 2026. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag-7 capex tape na binasag ng Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na maaaring lumipat mula FP16 papunta sa 3.5-bit ay nababawasan ang epektibong per-token cost ng ~5-6x. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang mga hyperscaler ay mag-gate ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing sa opt-in compressed-cache tiers, at ang hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis mula sa report kahapon ay tumitindi sa pamamagitan ng lever na ito sa halip na sa pamamagitan ng mas kakaunting GPUs. detail.description: **By Q4 2026 KV-cache-compression dtype is exposed as a first-class deployment knob in every major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM all ship a `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (or equivalent) flag with TurboQuant + at least one alternative (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Apr 27-29 makes this a near-certainty: **TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 already in-tree** with a fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** at Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demoing multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** circulating before Google's official Python release lands in Q2 2026. The economic forcing function is the same Mag-7 capex tape the Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report just cracked: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that can move from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x. By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年Q4までに、KVキャッシュ圧縮dtypeが主要な全推論スタックでファーストクラスのデプロイメント・ノブとして公開される — vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLMのすべてが、TurboQuantと少なくとも1つの代替手段(KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention)を備えた`--kv-cache-dtype turboquant`(または同等)フラグを出荷する。** 4月27日〜29日の動向で、これはほぼ確実となった: **TurboQuantがICLR 2026 + Google Researchブログに掲載**、**SGLang PR #21419はすでにツリー内**で、フューズドカーネル書き換え(#23134)がbf16スループットの93〜105%に到達、**NVIDIA kvpress**はDecoding-Press成熟度に達し、**PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** がマルチエージェント共有プール量子化をデモ、**コミュニティのMLX + Triton + vLLMポート**が2026年Q2のGoogle公式Pythonリリース前から流通している。経済的な強制関数は、4月28日OpenAIミスのWSJレポートが直撃したのと同じMag-7 capexテープだ: メモリ帯域幅律速のロングコンテキストワークロードがFP16から3.5ビットに移行できれば、トークンあたりの実効コストを約5〜6倍削減できる。2026年Q4までに、ハイパースケーラーはBedrock/Azure/Vertexのトークン単価をオプトイン圧縮キャッシュ階層でゲートし、昨日のレポートが示した増分GPU capexのハードウェア上限テーゼは、GPU削減ではなくこのレバーを通じて締まっていく。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el Q4 2026 el dtype de compresion de KV-cache se expone como una palanca de despliegue de primera clase en cada stack de inferencia importante — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM todos envian un flag `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o equivalente) con TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** El 27-29 de abril lo convierte en una casi-certeza: **TurboQuant aterriza en ICLR 2026 + blog de Google Research**, **SGLang PR #21419 ya en el arbol** con una reescritura de kernel fusionado (#23134) alcanzando 93-105% del throughput de bf16, **NVIDIA kvpress** en madurez Decoding-Press, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demostrando cuantizacion de pool compartido multi-agente, y **ports de la comunidad MLX + Triton + vLLM** circulando antes de que aterrice el lanzamiento oficial Python de Google en el Q2 2026. La funcion forzante economica es la misma cinta de capex Mag-7 que el reporte WSJ del fallo de OpenAI del 28 de abril acaba de quebrar: cada workload de contexto largo limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pueda moverse de FP16 a 3.5-bit reduce el costo efectivo por token ~5-6x. Para el Q4 2026 los hyperscalers gatean el precio por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex sobre tiers opt-in de cache-comprimido, y la tesis del cap-de-hardware-sobre-capex-incremental-de-GPU del reporte de ayer se aprieta via esta palanca en lugar de via menos GPUs. prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang KV-cache-compression dtype ay ilalabas bilang first-class deployment knob sa bawat major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM lahat ay maglalabas ng `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o katumbas) flag na may TurboQuant + kahit isang alternatibo (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Ang Apr 27-29 ay ginagawa itong halos kasiguraduhan: **TurboQuant ay lumapag sa ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 ay nasa-tree na** kasama ang fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) na umaabot ng 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** sa Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** na nag-demo ng multi-agent shared-pool quantization, at **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** na umiikot bago ang opisyal na Python release ng Google sa Q2 2026. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag-7 capex tape na binasag ng Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na maaaring lumipat mula FP16 papunta sa 3.5-bit ay nababawasan ang epektibong per-token cost ng ~5-6x. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang mga hyperscaler ay mag-gate ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing sa opt-in compressed-cache tiers, at ang hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis mula sa report kahapon ay tumitindi sa pamamagitan ng lever na ito sa halip na sa pamamagitan ng mas kakaunting GPUs. nodes.description: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.

description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、すべての主要なローカルLLMエコシステム(vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM、Foundry Local)が統一された圧縮KVキャッシュデプロイメントノブ — TurboQuant + 少なくとも1つの代替案 — を公開し、Foundry Local(Microsoft、4月9日GA)はWindows ML / WinML実行プロバイダに紐付いたネイティブTurboQuant統合をWindowsデフォルト最適化として出荷する。** 4月27-29日のエビデンス:SGLang PR #21419がインツリー化、SGLang #23134のfused-Triton-decodeカーネル書き換えがbf16スループットの93–105%に到達、vLLM v0.19.0(4月2日)はtorch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / 非同期スケジューラがデフォルト + Model Runner V2、PolyKV(arxiv 2604.24971、4月27日)はマルチエージェント推論向けの共有非対称KVプール、NVIDIA kvpressはDecoding-Press成熟度、llama.cpp #20969のTurboQuant議論スレッドがアクティブ、Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論が20-30%高速化。Foundry Localは欠けていたエンタープライズWindowsエントリポイントである — Microsoftはこれをハードウェア対応のWinML実行プロバイダで任意のアプリにローカルAIをバンドルする約20MBのネイティブライブラリとして出荷しており、2026年Q2の明らかな次の一歩はFoundry CatalogでTurboQuantフラグを公開することである。経済的な強制要因はMag 7 capexテープと同じである:FP16から3.5ビットに移行するメモリ帯域幅律速の長文脈ワークロードはすべてトークンあたりの実効コストを約5-6倍削減し、Foundry Localはその切替をエンドデベロッパーに対して不可視にする。
description.es: **Para H2 2026 cada ecosistema mayor de LLM local (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) expone un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido — TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa — y Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA 9 abr) lanza integración nativa de TurboQuant atada a los execution providers de Windows ML / WinML como optimización por defecto en Windows.** Evidencia del 27-29 abr: el PR #21419 de SGLang está in-tree; la rescritura de fused-Triton-decode kernel de SGLang #23134 alcanza 93–105% del throughput bf16; vLLM v0.19.0 (2 abr) trae torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler por defecto + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, 27 abr) es un pool compartido asimétrico de KV para inferencia multi-agente; NVIDIA kvpress alcanza madurez en Decoding-Press; el hilo #20969 de discusión de TurboQuant en llama.cpp está activo; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inferencia 20-30% más rápida. Foundry Local es el punto de entrada empresarial-Windows que faltaba — Microsoft lo envía como una librería nativa de ~20MB que empaqueta IA local en cualquier app con execution providers de WinML adaptados al hardware, y el siguiente paso obvio para Q2 2026 es exponer un flag de TurboQuant en el Foundry Catalog. La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
summary.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang bawat pangunahing local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) ay maglalantad ng unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + hindi bababa sa isang alternatibo — at ang Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ay magpapadala ng native TurboQuant integration na nakatali sa Windows ML / WinML execution providers bilang Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 ebidensiya: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite na umabot sa 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool para sa multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress sa Decoding-Press maturity; aktibo ang llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% mas mabilis. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

summary_short_locales.fil: Ang parallel work sa SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp, at Microsoft's Foundry Local kasama ang TurboQuant + PolyKV + NVIDIA kvpress ay tumuturo sa unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob sa bawat pangunahing local-LLM stack pagsapit ng H2 2026, na ang Foundry Local ay nagpapadala ng native TurboQuant na nakatali sa WinML execution providers.

bridges.text: SGLang's measured throughput lead and day-0 model coverage plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering reinforce the precondition that the local-LLM ecosystem has the kernel-level performance maturity needed before a unified compressed-KV-cache knob lands across the stack.

text_locales.en: SGLang's measured throughput lead and day-0 model coverage plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering reinforce the precondition that the local-LLM ecosystem has the kernel-level performance maturity needed before a unified compressed-KV-cache knob lands across the stack.
text_locales.ja: SGLangの計測されたスループット優位とday-0モデル・カバレッジ + Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face共同エンジニアリングが、ローカルLLMエコシステムが、統一された圧縮KVキャッシュ・ノブがスタック全体に着地する前に必要なカーネルレベルの性能成熟度を持つという前提条件を強化している。
text_locales.es: La ventaja de rendimiento medida de SGLang y la cobertura de modelo day-0 más la ingeniería conjunta Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face refuerzan la precondición de que el ecosistema local-LLM tiene la madurez de rendimiento a nivel de kernel necesaria antes de que un knob unificado de KV-cache comprimido aterrice en la pila.
text_locales.fil: Ang sinukat na throughput lead at day-0 model coverage ng SGLang plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering ay nagpapatibay sa precondition na ang local-LLM ecosystem ay may kernel-level performance maturity na kailangan bago lumapag ang unified compressed-KV-cache knob sa buong stack.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年下半期までに、すべての主要なローカルLLMエコシステム(vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM、Foundry Local)が統一された圧縮KVキャッシュデプロイメントノブ — TurboQuant + 少なくとも1つの代替案 — を公開し、Foundry Local(Microsoft、4月9日GA)はWindows ML / WinML実行プロバイダに紐付いたネイティブTurboQuant統合をWindowsデフォルト最適化として出荷する。** 4月27-29日のエビデンス:SGLang PR #21419がインツリー化、SGLang #23134のfused-Triton-decodeカーネル書き換えがbf16スループットの93–105%に到達、vLLM v0.19.0(4月2日)はtorch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / 非同期スケジューラがデフォルト + Model Runner V2、PolyKV(arxiv 2604.24971、4月27日)はマルチエージェント推論向けの共有非対称KVプール、NVIDIA kvpressはDecoding-Press成熟度、llama.cpp #20969のTurboQuant議論スレッドがアクティブ、Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論が20-30%高速化。Foundry Localは欠けていたエンタープライズWindowsエントリポイントである — Microsoftはこれをハードウェア対応のWinML実行プロバイダで任意のアプリにローカルAIをバンドルする約20MBのネイティブライブラリとして出荷しており、2026年Q2の明らかな次の一歩はFoundry CatalogでTurboQuantフラグを公開することである。経済的な強制要因はMag 7 capexテープと同じである:FP16から3.5ビットに移行するメモリ帯域幅律速の長文脈ワークロードはすべてトークンあたりの実効コストを約5-6倍削減し、Foundry Localはその切替をエンドデベロッパーに対して不可視にする。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para H2 2026 cada ecosistema mayor de LLM local (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) expone un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido — TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa — y Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA 9 abr) lanza integración nativa de TurboQuant atada a los execution providers de Windows ML / WinML como optimización por defecto en Windows.** Evidencia del 27-29 abr: el PR #21419 de SGLang está in-tree; la rescritura de fused-Triton-decode kernel de SGLang #23134 alcanza 93–105% del throughput bf16; vLLM v0.19.0 (2 abr) trae torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler por defecto + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, 27 abr) es un pool compartido asimétrico de KV para inferencia multi-agente; NVIDIA kvpress alcanza madurez en Decoding-Press; el hilo #20969 de discusión de TurboQuant en llama.cpp está activo; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inferencia 20-30% más rápida. Foundry Local es el punto de entrada empresarial-Windows que faltaba — Microsoft lo envía como una librería nativa de ~20MB que empaqueta IA local en cualquier app con execution providers de WinML adaptados al hardware, y el siguiente paso obvio para Q2 2026 es exponer un flag de TurboQuant en el Foundry Catalog. La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang bawat pangunahing local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) ay maglalantad ng unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + hindi bababa sa isang alternatibo — at ang Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ay magpapadala ng native TurboQuant integration na nakatali sa Windows ML / WinML execution providers bilang Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 ebidensiya: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite na umabot sa 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool para sa multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress sa Decoding-Press maturity; aktibo ang llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% mas mabilis. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

nodes.description: **By H2 2026 the Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training with 20% less VRAM and 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — combined with the SGLang 29% throughput advantage on H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared with vLLM at ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support for MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + the Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) makes consumer-GPU training operationally equivalent to enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; expect ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI) to ship a managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier with managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool to close the consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap before AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Forcing function is the procurement-friction asymmetry: enterprises with internal Unsloth pilots already see 70%-VRAM-reduction economics on consumer GPUs, but enterprise security + governance demands a managed control plane that the open-source CLI doesn't provide; whichever hyperscaler ships first absorbs the migration. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI all have the runtime substrate; the missing piece is the fine-tuning-as-a-service surface that unifies the open-source kernel performance with managed-IAM enterprise governance. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **By H2 2026 the Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training with 20% less VRAM and 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — combined with the SGLang 29% throughput advantage on H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared with vLLM at ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support for MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + the Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) makes consumer-GPU training operationally equivalent to enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; expect ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI) to ship a managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier with managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool to close the consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap before AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Forcing function is the procurement-friction asymmetry: enterprises with internal Unsloth pilots already see 70%-VRAM-reduction economics on consumer GPUs, but enterprise security + governance demands a managed control plane that the open-source CLI doesn't provide; whichever hyperscaler ships first absorbs the migration. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI all have the runtime substrate; the missing piece is the fine-tuning-as-a-service surface that unifies the open-source kernel performance with managed-IAM enterprise governance. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、Unsloth 2026アップデートの波 — 12倍高速MoE学習 + 超ロングコンテキスト強化学習 + 1.8〜3.3倍高速 embedding / BERT / 分類器学習でVRAM 20%削減 + コンテキスト2倍長(Hugging Face共同エンジニアリング) + Unsloth Studio 3月17日 100%オフラインGGUF + Safetensorsランタイム + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garageファインチューニング・ガイド(RTXラップトップ性能2.5倍向上) — がSGLangのH100上での29%スループット優位(RadixAttentionプレフィックスキャッシュをvLLMと共有、約16,200 vs 約12,500 tok/s) + SGLangのMiMo-V2-Flash、Nemotron 3 Nano、Mistral Large 3、LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion、MiniMax M2へのday-0サポート + 4月28日〜5月3日のKVキャッシュarxiv波(SideQuest、DepthKV、KVFundaBench)と組み合わさり、コンシューマーGPU学習をエンタープライズGPU 2024ベースラインと運用上同等にする。1社以上のハイパースケーラー(AWS Bedrock fine-tuning、Azure AI Foundry、またはGoogle Vertex AI)が、コンシューマーGPU → エンタープライズ・ファインチューニング間のギャップを埋めるため、AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Igniteのサイクルまでに、マネージド・ランタイム + IAM + 監査 + コスト最適化GPUプールを伴うマネージドUnsloth-as-a-serviceティアを出荷することが期待される。** 強制関数は調達摩擦の非対称性: 内部Unslothパイロットを持つ企業はコンシューマーGPUで既にVRAM 70%削減の経済性を得ているが、エンタープライズのセキュリティ + ガバナンス要件には、オープンソースCLIでは提供できないマネージド・コントロールプレーンが必要となる。最初に出荷したハイパースケーラーが移行需要を吸収する。Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AIはいずれもランタイム基盤を持っており、欠けているピースは、オープンソースカーネル性能とマネージドIAMエンタープライズ・ガバナンスを統合するファインチューニング・アズ・ア・サービスのサーフェスである。In plain language: ローカルLLM学習は今や2倍高速でVRAMも70%少なくて済む — 近いうちに大手クラウドがそれをマネージドサービスとして貸し出すだろう。In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para H2 2026, la ola de actualización Unsloth 2026 — entrenamiento MoE 12x más rápido + Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo + entrenamiento de embedding / BERT / clasificador 1.8-3.3x más rápido con 20% menos VRAM y contexto 2x más largo (ingeniería conjunta con Hugging Face) + Unsloth Studio del 17 de marzo con runtime GGUF + Safetensors 100% offline + guía de fine-tuning RTX-AI Garage de NVIDIA DGX Spark (rendimiento de portátil RTX hasta 2.5x) — combinado con la ventaja de rendimiento del 29% de SGLang en H100 (caché de prefijo RadixAttention compartido con vLLM en ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + soporte day-0 de SGLang para MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + la ola arxiv KV-cache del 28 de abril al 3 de mayo (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) hace que el entrenamiento en GPU de consumo sea operativamente equivalente a la línea base de GPU empresarial de 2024; se espera que ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) entregue un nivel gestionado de Unsloth-as-a-service con runtime gestionado + IAM + auditoría + pool de GPU optimizado en costo para cerrar la brecha entre fine-tuning en GPU de consumo → empresarial antes de los ciclos de AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite.** La función forzante es la asimetría de fricción de adquisición: las empresas con pilotos internos de Unsloth ya ven la economía de reducción del 70% de VRAM en GPUs de consumo, pero la seguridad + gobernanza empresarial demanda un plano de control gestionado que el CLI open-source no proporciona; el hyperscaler que entregue primero absorbe la migración. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI tienen todos el sustrato de runtime; la pieza que falta es la superficie de fine-tuning-as-a-service que unifica el rendimiento del kernel open-source con la gobernanza empresarial de IAM gestionada. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training na may 20% less VRAM at 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — pinagsama sa SGLang 29% throughput advantage sa H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared sa vLLM sa ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support para sa MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + ang Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) ay ginagawang operationally equivalent ang consumer-GPU training sa enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; inaasahan na ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) ang magpapadala ng managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier na may managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool upang isara ang consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap bago ang AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Ang forcing function ay ang procurement-friction asymmetry: ang mga enterprises na may panloob na Unsloth pilots ay nakakita na ng 70%-VRAM-reduction economics sa consumer GPUs, ngunit ang enterprise security + governance ay humihingi ng managed control plane na hindi maibibigay ng open-source CLI; sinumang hyperscaler ang unang magpapadala ay sumusubsob sa migration. Ang Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI ay lahat may runtime substrate; ang nawawalang piraso ay ang fine-tuning-as-a-service surface na nagbubuklod sa open-source kernel performance sa managed-IAM enterprise governance. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:

summary_short_locales.fil: Ang 2026 wave ng Unsloth (12x MoE training, 1.8-3.3x faster BERT/embedding na may 20% less VRAM sa pamamagitan ng joint Hugging Face work) plus ang NVIDIA DGX Spark guidance at ang 29% H100 throughput lead ng SGLang ay nagpapatugma sa consumer-GPU training sa 2024 enterprise-GPU baseline. text_locales.es: El joint preprint de arxiv de Unsloth sobre router-only LoRA a traves de Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX y Kimi K2.6 recupera 71-78% de la precision full-LoRA con 8-13% de step-time y 11-16% de peak VRAM, con tres recetas follow-on mas un preprint de DeepMind que cierra la estabilidad de RL de long-context. detail.subtitle: Prediction · Tech
detail.description: **By H2 2026 the Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training with 20% less VRAM and 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — combined with the SGLang 29% throughput advantage on H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared with vLLM at ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support for MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + the Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) makes consumer-GPU training operationally equivalent to enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; expect ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI) to ship a managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier with managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool to close the consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap before AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Forcing function is the procurement-friction asymmetry: enterprises with internal Unsloth pilots already see 70%-VRAM-reduction economics on consumer GPUs, but enterprise security + governance demands a managed control plane that the open-source CLI doesn't provide; whichever hyperscaler ships first absorbs the migration. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI all have the runtime substrate; the missing piece is the fine-tuning-as-a-service surface that unifies the open-source kernel performance with managed-IAM enterprise governance. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年下半期までに、Unsloth 2026アップデートの波 — 12倍高速MoE学習 + 超ロングコンテキスト強化学習 + 1.8〜3.3倍高速 embedding / BERT / 分類器学習でVRAM 20%削減 + コンテキスト2倍長(Hugging Face共同エンジニアリング) + Unsloth Studio 3月17日 100%オフラインGGUF + Safetensorsランタイム + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garageファインチューニング・ガイド(RTXラップトップ性能2.5倍向上) — がSGLangのH100上での29%スループット優位(RadixAttentionプレフィックスキャッシュをvLLMと共有、約16,200 vs 約12,500 tok/s) + SGLangのMiMo-V2-Flash、Nemotron 3 Nano、Mistral Large 3、LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion、MiniMax M2へのday-0サポート + 4月28日〜5月3日のKVキャッシュarxiv波(SideQuest、DepthKV、KVFundaBench)と組み合わさり、コンシューマーGPU学習をエンタープライズGPU 2024ベースラインと運用上同等にする。1社以上のハイパースケーラー(AWS Bedrock fine-tuning、Azure AI Foundry、またはGoogle Vertex AI)が、コンシューマーGPU → エンタープライズ・ファインチューニング間のギャップを埋めるため、AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Igniteのサイクルまでに、マネージド・ランタイム + IAM + 監査 + コスト最適化GPUプールを伴うマネージドUnsloth-as-a-serviceティアを出荷することが期待される。** 強制関数は調達摩擦の非対称性: 内部Unslothパイロットを持つ企業はコンシューマーGPUで既にVRAM 70%削減の経済性を得ているが、エンタープライズのセキュリティ + ガバナンス要件には、オープンソースCLIでは提供できないマネージド・コントロールプレーンが必要となる。最初に出荷したハイパースケーラーが移行需要を吸収する。Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AIはいずれもランタイム基盤を持っており、欠けているピースは、オープンソースカーネル性能とマネージドIAMエンタープライズ・ガバナンスを統合するファインチューニング・アズ・ア・サービスのサーフェスである。In plain language: ローカルLLM学習は今や2倍高速でVRAMも70%少なくて済む — 近いうちに大手クラウドがそれをマネージドサービスとして貸し出すだろう。In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para H2 2026, la ola de actualización Unsloth 2026 — entrenamiento MoE 12x más rápido + Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo + entrenamiento de embedding / BERT / clasificador 1.8-3.3x más rápido con 20% menos VRAM y contexto 2x más largo (ingeniería conjunta con Hugging Face) + Unsloth Studio del 17 de marzo con runtime GGUF + Safetensors 100% offline + guía de fine-tuning RTX-AI Garage de NVIDIA DGX Spark (rendimiento de portátil RTX hasta 2.5x) — combinado con la ventaja de rendimiento del 29% de SGLang en H100 (caché de prefijo RadixAttention compartido con vLLM en ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + soporte day-0 de SGLang para MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + la ola arxiv KV-cache del 28 de abril al 3 de mayo (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) hace que el entrenamiento en GPU de consumo sea operativamente equivalente a la línea base de GPU empresarial de 2024; se espera que ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) entregue un nivel gestionado de Unsloth-as-a-service con runtime gestionado + IAM + auditoría + pool de GPU optimizado en costo para cerrar la brecha entre fine-tuning en GPU de consumo → empresarial antes de los ciclos de AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite.** La función forzante es la asimetría de fricción de adquisición: las empresas con pilotos internos de Unsloth ya ven la economía de reducción del 70% de VRAM en GPUs de consumo, pero la seguridad + gobernanza empresarial demanda un plano de control gestionado que el CLI open-source no proporciona; el hyperscaler que entregue primero absorbe la migración. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI tienen todos el sustrato de runtime; la pieza que falta es la superficie de fine-tuning-as-a-service que unifica el rendimiento del kernel open-source con la gobernanza empresarial de IAM gestionada. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training na may 20% less VRAM at 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — pinagsama sa SGLang 29% throughput advantage sa H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared sa vLLM sa ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support para sa MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + ang Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) ay ginagawang operationally equivalent ang consumer-GPU training sa enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; inaasahan na ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) ang magpapadala ng managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier na may managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool upang isara ang consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap bago ang AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Ang forcing function ay ang procurement-friction asymmetry: ang mga enterprises na may panloob na Unsloth pilots ay nakakita na ng 70%-VRAM-reduction economics sa consumer GPUs, ngunit ang enterprise security + governance ay humihingi ng managed control plane na hindi maibibigay ng open-source CLI; sinumang hyperscaler ang unang magpapadala ay sumusubsob sa migration. Ang Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI ay lahat may runtime substrate; ang nawawalang piraso ay ang fine-tuning-as-a-service surface na nagbubuklod sa open-source kernel performance sa managed-IAM enterprise governance. description.en: **GGUF supply chains are the new battleground.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (Jinja2 SSTI through GGUF, RCE) makes visible the fact that "model files themselves are carriers of executable code." By Q3 2026, Hugging Face / Ollama Library / ModelScope will require model-card + chat_template signature verification or sandboxed execution as a baseline; Foundry Local / Bedrock / vLLM will enable SSTI scanning by default at GGUF load time. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **GGUFのサプライチェーンが新たな戦場になる。** SGLang CVE-2026-5760(GGUF経由のJinja2 SSTIによるRCE)は、「モデルファイル自体が実行可能コードのキャリアである」という事実を可視化した。2026年Q3までに、Hugging Face / Ollama Library / ModelScopeはmodel-card + chat_templateの署名検証またはサンドボックス実行をベースラインとして要求するようになる。Foundry Local / Bedrock / vLLMはGGUFロード時のSSTIスキャンをデフォルトで有効化する。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Las cadenas de suministro de GGUF son el nuevo campo de batalla.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (SSTI de Jinja2 a través de GGUF, RCE) hace visible el hecho de que "los propios archivos de modelo son portadores de código ejecutable". Para el Q3 2026, Hugging Face / Ollama Library / ModelScope exigirán verificación de firma de model-card + chat_template o ejecución en sandbox como base; Foundry Local / Bedrock / vLLM activarán el escaneo de SSTI por defecto en el momento de carga de GGUF. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang GGUF supply chains ang bagong battleground.** Ginagawang nakikita ng SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (Jinja2 SSTI sa pamamagitan ng GGUF, RCE) ang katotohanan na "ang model files mismo ay carriers ng executable code." Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, hihilingin ng Hugging Face / Ollama Library / ModelScope ang model-card + chat_template signature verification o sandboxed execution bilang baseline; i-eenable ng Foundry Local / Bedrock / vLLM ang SSTI scanning bilang default sa oras ng GGUF load. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

because.fil: Naglalathala ang SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ng Jinja2 SSTI sa GGUF chat_template parsing na nagdudulot ng RCE sa model load.

given.en: GGUF files embed executable templates, so model artifacts function as carriers of arbitrary code.
given.ja: GGUFファイルは実行可能なテンプレートを埋め込んでいるため、モデルアーティファクトは任意コードのキャリアとして機能する。
given.es: Los archivos GGUF incrustan plantillas ejecutables, por lo que los artefactos del modelo funcionan como portadores de código arbitrario.
given.fil: Ang GGUF files ay nag-eembed ng executable templates, kaya ang model artifacts ay gumagana bilang carriers ng arbitrary code.

so_that.en: Hubs gate uploads behind signed model-cards and chat_templates, and serving runtimes scan for SSTI at GGUF load time.
so_that.ja: ハブは署名済みmodel-cardとchat_templateの背後でアップロードをゲーティングし、サービングランタイムはGGUFロード時にSSTIをスキャンする。
so_that.es: Los hubs filtran las cargas tras model-cards y chat_templates firmados, y los runtimes de servicio escanean en busca de SSTI en el momento de carga de GGUF.
so_that.fil: Ang hubs ay nag-gate ng uploads sa likod ng signed model-cards at chat_templates, at ang serving runtimes ay nag-scan para sa SSTI sa oras ng GGUF load.

plain_language.en: A bug in SGLang shows model files can hide harmful code, so big model hubs and inference servers will start checking them before running.
plain_language.ja: SGLangのバグはモデルファイルが有害コードを隠せることを示しており、大手モデルハブと推論サーバーは実行前にチェックを開始する。
plain_language.es: Un fallo en SGLang muestra que los archivos de modelo pueden ocultar código dañino, así que los grandes hubs de modelos y servidores de inferencia comenzarán a verificarlos antes de ejecutarlos.
plain_language.fil: Ipinapakita ng isang bug sa SGLang na maaaring magtago ang model files ng nakakapinsalang code, kaya magsisimulang i-check ng malalaking model hubs at inference servers ang mga ito bago patakbuhin.
